variations: Sleep debt can be repaid later. The quarterfinals only happen once.
My coworker thinks I'm grinding at work. Really I'm grinding through a quarterfinal that has nothing to do with me.

items.sourceNote: 八強 7/9-11 開打：法國對摩洛哥、西班牙對比利時、挪威對英格蘭、阿根廷對瑞士；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
八強戰今天正式開打，法國碰摩洛哥、西班牙對比利時、挪威撞英格蘭、阿根廷遇瑞士。
翻開這四場的時間，沒有一場對台灣是友善的，全部卡在凌晨到清晨。
剩下八支隊，代表只剩八場能讓我名正言順失眠了。
我一邊排明後天的熬夜行程，一邊有點感傷——
這個為別人的國家心跳加速的夏天，開始進入倒數了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個八強一開打就把接下來每個凌晨都空下來的球友
variations: 八強四場沒有一場好睡，但也沒有一場捨得錯過。
隊伍只剩八支，我能理直氣壯熬的夜，也只剩八個了。

en.content:
The quarterfinals kick off today: France vs Morocco, Spain vs Belgium, Norway vs England, Argentina vs Switzerland.
I checked the times for all four — not one of them is kind to us, every kickoff wedged somewhere between midnight and dawn.
Eight teams left means only eight matches left that let me lose sleep with a clear conscience.
Mapping out the next couple of predawns, I felt a small pang —
this summer of racing heartbeats for other people's countries has started counting down.
en.editorNote: For the friend who cleared every upcoming predawn the moment the quarterfinals began
variations: None of the four quarterfinals is easy to sleep through, and none is worth missing either.
Only eight teams left, which means only eight nights left I get to stay up for, guilt-free.

items.sourceNote: 挪威十六強 2-1 淘汰五屆冠軍巴西，哈蘭德率隊挺進八強；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
挪威二比一把五屆冠軍巴西送回家，這種新聞我看兩遍才敢相信。
那支我從小到大都當作足球代名詞的球隊，就這樣在凌晨被淘汰了。
我跟巴西沒有淵源，卻莫名替一個時代的結束感到失落。
世界盃最誠實的地方在於：獎盃數字再輝煌，也保護不了你這一夜；
過去有多強是歷史，今晚敢不敢拚才是現在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到傳統強隊被爆冷、比輸球的人還難過的朋友
variations: 五座冠軍擋不住一個凌晨的爆冷，這就是世界盃殘忍又迷人的地方。
巴西出局那晚我才懂，沒有一支球隊大到不會輸，包括我心裡的那支。

en.content:
Norway sent five-time champions Brazil home 2-1 — I had to read that twice before I believed it.
The team I've treated my whole life as a synonym for football, gone, just like that, at 3 AM.
I have no ties to Brazil, yet I felt an odd loss for the ending of an era.
The most honest thing about the World Cup: however glorious your trophy count, it can't protect you tonight.
How strong you were is history. Whether you dare to fight tonight is the present.
en.editorNote: For the friend who takes a traditional giant's upset harder than the losing team's own fans
variations: Five titles couldn't stop one predawn upset — that's what makes the World Cup so cruel and so magnetic.
The night Brazil went out, I finally understood no team is too big to lose, including the one in my heart.

items.sourceNote: 衛冕冠軍阿根廷十六強遭維德角逼進延長賽、驚險 3-2 過關；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
衛冕冠軍阿根廷，十六強差點被維德角掀翻，一路被逼進延長賽，最後三比二才險勝。
一個人口比一座城市還少的國家，把上屆冠軍逼到最後一刻。
我熬夜看的時候，一度真的以為要見證史上最大爆冷了。
那晚我學到：頭銜不會幫你贏球，衛冕者最怕的，
從來不是另一個強隊，是一支輸了也沒什麼好損失、於是敢把命拚上的隊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是幫弱隊加油、看衛冕冠軍冒冷汗最開心的朋友
variations: 維德角雖敗猶榮，把衛冕冠軍逼到延長賽，這種輸法比很多勝利更響亮。
最危險的對手，是那種輸了也無所謂、所以什麼都敢拚的隊。

en.content:
Defending champions Argentina almost got toppled by Cape Verde in the round of 16, dragged all the way to extra time before scraping through 3-2.
A country smaller than most cities pushed the reigning champions to the very last moment.
Staying up to watch it, I genuinely thought for a while I was about to witness the biggest upset ever.
What I learned that night: a title won't win the match for you. What a defending champion fears most
was never another giant — it's a team with nothing to lose that therefore dares to throw everything in.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always backs the underdog and loves watching the champions sweat
variations: Cape Verde lost with their heads high, pushing the champions to extra time — that kind of defeat rings louder than many wins.
The most dangerous opponent is the one who wouldn't mind losing, and therefore dares to risk everything.

items.sourceNote: 阿根廷十六強一度 0-2 落後埃及、梅西罰球被撲，最終逆轉 3-2；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
阿根廷對埃及，上半場一度零比二落後，連梅西的罰球都被門將撲掉。
那一刻我以為連他都要在這裡畫下句點了。
結果下半場，這支球隊一球一球追，硬是三比二把比賽翻了回來。
凌晨三點我看著這場逆轉突然懂了：
連最強的人都會被撲掉罰球、都會落後，差別只在於——他們落後之後，沒有停下來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個開局就落後、快要想放棄的朋友，落後不等於結束
variations: 梅西罰球被撲那一刻我心涼了半截，但真正的故事，是他失手之後球隊還敢往前追。
零比二不是終點，是這支球隊決定不認輸的起點。

en.content:
Argentina against Egypt: they went 0-2 down in the first half, and even Messi had his penalty saved.
For a moment I thought this was where even he would bow out.
Then in the second half the team clawed it back goal by goal and flipped it to a 3-2 win.
Watching that comeback at 3 AM, it hit me:
even the greatest miss penalties, even the greatest fall behind — the only difference is that after falling behind, they didn't stop.
en.editorNote: For the friend who fell behind early and is about to give up — behind isn't the end
variations: My heart sank when Messi's penalty was saved, but the real story is that after the miss, the team still dared to push forward.
0-2 wasn't the finish line. It was the starting line for a team that decided not to quit.

items.sourceNote: 八強前夕回顧：淘汰賽多場 PK 與絕殺，熬夜球迷身心俱疲卻捨不得停；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
八強前一晚，我攤在沙發上盤點這一個月：
看了多少場 PK、多少記補時絕殺、欠了多少永遠補不回來的睡眠。
身體早就在抗議，鏡子裡的黑眼圈也認不出自己了。
但我知道，等八強、四強、決賽一場場踢完，這個夏天就真的結束了。
所以我還是決定撐下去——累是真的，可是捨不得，更是真的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個撐到八強、身體快垮卻死都不肯提早收工的戰友
variations: 睡眠可以之後慢慢還，但這個夏天，錯過一場就真的沒了。
身體叫我去睡，賽程表叫我別走，最後我總是選擇跟賽程表站在一起。

en.content:
The night before the quarterfinals, I sprawled on the couch and took stock of the month:
how many shootouts I'd watched, how many stoppage-time winners, how much sleep I'd never get back.
My body's been protesting for weeks, and the eye bags in the mirror don't even look like mine anymore.
But I know that once the quarters, semis, and final are played out, this summer really ends.
So I've decided to push on anyway — the exhaustion is real, but not wanting it to end is even more real.
en.editorNote: For the comrade who made it to the quarterfinals, body falling apart but refusing to clock out early
variations: Sleep I can pay back slowly, but this summer — miss one match and it's genuinely gone.
My body tells me to sleep, the fixture list tells me to stay, and I keep siding with the fixture list.

items.sourceNote: 八強首戰法國 2-0 淘汰摩洛哥，率先晉級四強；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
八強第一場，法國二比零收掉摩洛哥，成了最先訂到四強機票的隊伍。
我一邊為晉級的球隊開心，一邊卻有點失落——
每晉級一隊，就代表這個夏天又少了幾支能陪我熬夜的球隊。
看世界盃到後段才懂：贏球的喜悅裡，永遠藏著一點「快結束了」的捨不得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到八強就開始倒數、捨不得夏天結束的朋友
variations: 率先晉級的隊伍最風光，但也代表接下來能熬的夜又少了一場。
四強名單每填上一個名字，我的睡前倒數就又逼近了一天。

en.content:
In the first quarterfinal, France closed out Morocco 2-0, the first side to book a ticket to the semis.
I was happy for the team advancing, and also a little hollow —
every team that goes through means a few fewer teams left to stay up with this summer.
Watching the World Cup this deep in, you learn: inside the joy of a win there's always a quiet ache of 'this is almost over.'
en.editorNote: For the friend who starts counting down at the quarterfinals, not ready for summer to end
variations: The first team through looks the most glorious, but it also means one fewer night left to stay up for.
Every name that fills the semifinal bracket pushes my bedtime countdown one day closer.

items.sourceNote: 瑞士 0-0 哥倫比亞、延長賽後 PK 4-3 過關，門將關鍵撲救；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
瑞士對哥倫比亞，正規九十分鐘零比零，延長三十分鐘還是零比零。
我從三點看到快五點，眼睛都快睜不開，比賽卻連一顆球都沒進。
最後 PK 大戰，門將撲掉關鍵一球，全場心臟差點停掉。
那一刻我終於明白，世界盃最折磨人的不是熬夜，
是熬了兩個小時，勝負要到最後一顆十二碼才揭曉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個陪你熬完整場零比零、最後還要一起承受 PK 大戰的難兄難弟
variations: 零比零撐到 PK，這種夜晚熬的不是球賽，是心臟。
一百二十分鐘沒進球，卻在最後五顆十二碼把我一整晚的睏意全嚇醒。

en.content:
Switzerland versus Colombia: 0-0 through ninety minutes, still 0-0 after thirty more.
I watched from 3 until nearly 5, eyes barely open, and not a single goal went in.
Then came the shootout, a keeper's save at the decisive moment, and the whole room nearly flatlined.
That's when it finally hit me: the most punishing thing about the World Cup isn't the lost sleep,
it's staying up two hours only for the result to hinge on the very last spot-kick.
en.editorNote: For the fellow sufferer who sat through the whole 0-0 with you and then survived the shootout too
variations: 0-0 all the way to penalties: on nights like that, it isn't the match you're staying up for, it's your own heart.
A hundred and twenty minutes without a goal, then five penalties that scared every last bit of drowsiness out of me.

items.sourceNote: 16 強打完剩 8 隊，摩洛哥對法國、英格蘭對挪威、西班牙對比利時、阿根廷對瑞士；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
從四十八隊，一路踢到只剩八隊。
我翻著手機裡的賽程表突然驚覺：能熬的夜，已經數得出來了。
剛開賽時覺得一整個夏天長得看不到盡頭，
現在卻開始捨不得每一場——因為每看完一場，就少一場。
這大概就是所有好東西的規律：越接近尾聲，越覺得時間不夠用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到只剩八隊、突然開始珍惜每一場的朋友
variations: 四十八隊變八隊，我的睡眠債還在，能還債的機會卻越來越少。
以前嫌賽程太長，現在嫌它太短，人就是這麼矛盾。

en.content:
From forty-eight teams, all the way down to just eight.
Scrolling my fixture list, it suddenly hit me: the nights left to stay up are now countable.
When it kicked off, the summer felt endless.
Now I don't want to let go of a single match, because every one I finish is one fewer left.
That's probably the rule for all good things: the closer to the end, the more you feel there's never enough time.
en.editorNote: For the friend who, down to the final eight, suddenly starts treasuring every single match
variations: Forty-eight teams down to eight: my sleep debt is still here, but the chances to repay it are running out.
I used to complain the schedule was too long. Now I complain it's too short. People are just contradictory like that.

items.sourceNote: 瑞士 72 年來首度打進八強、首次同屆連贏兩場淘汰賽；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
瑞士這次殺進八強，是他們七十二年來的頭一遭，
也是同一屆世界盃第一次連贏兩場淘汰賽。
我跟瑞士毫無淵源，卻在他們晉級那一刻，跟著鼻酸。
世界盃最動人的從來不是奪冠熱門照劇本走，
是一支等了七十二年的球隊，終於在凌晨四點的球場上，把歷史改寫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個專門為冷門球隊掉眼淚、最愛看歷史被改寫的朋友
variations: 等了七十二年的晉級，值得任何一個陌生人為它熬這一夜。
我不認識這支球隊，但我認得那種等了很久、終於等到的表情。

en.content:
Switzerland reaching the last eight this time is their first in seventy-two years,
and their first-ever back-to-back knockout wins in a single World Cup.
I have zero connection to Switzerland, yet the moment they went through, my eyes stung too.
The most moving thing about the World Cup was never the favorites winning to script.
It's a team that waited seventy-two years finally rewriting history on a pitch at 4 AM.
en.editorNote: For the friend who tears up for the underdogs and lives to watch history get rewritten
variations: A breakthrough seventy-two years in the making is worth any stranger losing a night's sleep over.
I don't know this team, but I know that look — the one that waited a long, long time and finally got there.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙對比利時八強賽落在美西中午開賽、對應台灣上班時段；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
西班牙對比利時這場八強，落在對面中午、我這邊剛好卡整個下午。
我盯著進度條式的工作進度，一邊偷開另一個視窗看比賽。
主管問我今天怎麼特別安靜，
我很想說：不是安靜，是我把所有力氣都拿去憋住進球那一聲歡呼了。
世界盃八強期間，最難的技能不是看懂戰術，是把想大叫的自己壓在辦公椅上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個八強賽卡上班、只能全程無聲吶喊的辦公室戰友
variations: 八強賽卡上班時段，最強的球迷是那種能面無表情看完一場淘汰賽的人。
辦公室看八強的最高境界：進球了，臉不能動，只有滑鼠握得死緊。

en.content:
The Spain-Belgium quarterfinal lands at noon over there, which parks itself right across my whole afternoon.
I stare at my progress-bar of a workload while sneaking the match open in another window.
My manager asks why I'm so quiet today.
What I want to say is: I'm not quiet, I'm spending every ounce of energy swallowing the shout that a goal deserves.
During the quarterfinals, the hardest skill isn't reading tactics. It's pinning the version of you that wants to scream to an office chair.
en.editorNote: For the office comrade stuck at work during a quarterfinal, reduced to silent screaming all match long
variations: When a quarterfinal cuts into work hours, the strongest fan is the one who can watch a knockout match with a completely straight face.
The peak of watching a quarterfinal at the office: a goal goes in, your face can't move, only your grip on the mouse tightens.

items.sourceNote: 法國 2-0 摩洛哥晉級四強，闖進八強的黑馬止步；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
法國二比零送走摩洛哥，一支闖進八強的黑馬，就這樣停在四強門口。
賽前我根本不是摩洛哥球迷，聽到終場哨音的那一刻卻莫名鼻酸。
世界盃最不講理的地方，是它讓你在短短幾場之內愛上一支陌生的球隊，
再親手把他們從你的夏天裡帶走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明不是摩洛哥球迷、卻為他們出局難過了一整個早上的朋友
variations: 被淘汰的從來不只是球隊，還有我這幾天悄悄押上去的感情。
黑馬停在八強，我的失落卻延長到了隔天上班。

en.content:
France sent Morocco home 2-0, and just like that a quarterfinal Cinderella stops at the door of the semis.
I wasn't even a Morocco fan before this, yet the final whistle left a lump in my throat.
The most unreasonable thing about the World Cup is how it makes you fall for a stranger of a team in just a few matches,
and then takes them out of your summer with its own hands.
en.editorNote: For the friend who isn't a Morocco fan yet moped all morning over their exit
variations: It's never just a team that gets knocked out. It's the feelings I quietly bet on them these past few days.
The underdog stops at the last eight, but my letdown gets extended into the next workday.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙靠梅里諾終場前絕殺 1-0 淘汰比利時，四強對上法國；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
西班牙靠著終場前梅里諾的一記絕殺，一比零氣走比利時，
四強直接對上剛淘汰摩洛哥的法國。
這哪是準決賽，根本是提早上演的決賽——兩支奪冠熱門，非死即傷。
我一邊興奮到睡不著，一邊已經開始心疼那支還沒踢就註定要出局的強隊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到西班牙對法國賽表、直接把當晚睡眠劃掉的朋友
variations: 最好看的對決往往來得比決賽還早，這就是世界盃的浪漫也是殘忍。
梅里諾補時那一腳，踢掉的是比利時，順便也踢掉了我當晚的睡眠計畫。

en.content:
A late Mikel Merino strike sent Spain past Belgium 1-0,
setting up a semifinal against the France side that had just knocked out Morocco.
Call it a semi if you want, but this is a final arriving early: two title favorites, and one of them has to die.
I'm too thrilled to sleep, and already aching for the powerhouse that's fated to go out before a ball is even kicked.
en.editorNote: For the friend who saw the Spain-vs-France fixture and immediately crossed that night's sleep off the calendar
variations: The best matchup often shows up earlier than the final. That's the World Cup's romance, and its cruelty.
Merino's stoppage-time strike knocked out Belgium, and took my sleep plans for the night out with it.

items.sourceNote: 阿根廷對瑞士八強賽，梅西衛冕之路、可能的最後一屆世界盃；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
阿根廷對瑞士這場八強，我熬夜的理由只有兩個字：梅西。
沒人知道這是不是他最後一屆世界盃，
所以只要他還在場上，我就捨不得閉上眼睛。
有些球員你會為了他熬夜，不是因為比賽多精彩，
而是因為你清楚，這樣的夜晚，看一場就少一場。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了見證傳奇最後身影、再睏都要撐著看完的朋友
variations: 熬夜看梅西不是為了輸贏，是為了以後能說一句：那年我在。
有些傳奇的夜晚，錯過就真的沒有下一次了。

en.content:
For the Argentina-Switzerland quarterfinal, my reason to stay up is one word: Messi.
Nobody knows if this is his last World Cup,
so as long as he's on the pitch, I can't bring myself to close my eyes.
Some players you stay up for not because the match is thrilling,
but because you know a night like this is one fewer every time you watch it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who pushes through any level of exhaustion to witness a legend's final act
variations: Staying up for Messi isn't about the result. It's so that someday you can say: I was there that year.
Some legendary nights, once you miss them, really don't come around again.

items.sourceNote: 挪威對英格蘭八強賽，哈蘭德首度站上世界盃大舞台；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
挪威對英格蘭這場八強，最讓我期待的是哈蘭德——
那個平常在聯賽把進球當呼吸的人，終於站上世界盃最大的舞台。
有些球員你等了好多年才在這裡看到，
凌晨爬起來只為確認一件事：他在最高的舞台上，還是那麼可怕嗎？
世界盃就是這樣，把你私藏很久的期待，一次全攤在凌晨的球場上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個等哈蘭德踢世界盃等到脖子都長了的朋友
variations: 有些球星在聯賽看膩了，卻還是想看他在世界盃上再證明一次。
熬夜的動力有時候很單純：就是想看那個進球如喝水的人，會不會在這裡失手。

en.content:
For the Norway-England quarterfinal, the thing I'm most hyped for is Haaland —
the guy who treats scoring like breathing in the league, finally on the biggest stage football has.
Some players you wait years to see here,
and you drag yourself up at dawn just to confirm one thing: on the highest stage, is he still that terrifying?
That's the World Cup — it lays out the hope you've hoarded for years, all at once, on a predawn pitch.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's been waiting so long to see Haaland at a World Cup they've grown a neck craning for it
variations: Some stars you've watched to boredom in the league, and you still want to see them prove it once more at a World Cup.
Sometimes the motivation to stay up is simple: you want to see whether the man who scores like it's nothing will finally slip up here.

items.sourceNote: 四強史上首次由 FIFA 排名前四全數包辦（法西英阿）；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
四強名單出爐，法國、西班牙、英格蘭、阿根廷，
剛好就是 FIFA 排名前四，史上第一次全員到齊。
沒有黑馬，沒有僥倖，能站到這裡的都是真本事。
我熬到現在才發現，撐到最後的不只是這四支隊，
還有我這條快要陣亡、但捨不得倒下的作息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一路熬到四強、看著超豪華對戰表既興奮又心疼自己的朋友
variations: 前四名全打進四強，這屆世界盃連爆冷的機會都懶得給我們了。
最強的四支隊活到最後，最累的一個球迷也活到最後，我們都算贏家。

en.content:
The final four are in: France, Spain, England, Argentina —
the exact top four in the FIFA rankings, all here for the first time ever.
No dark horses, no flukes. Everyone who made it earned it.
And I only just realized: it's not only these four teams that survived to the end,
it's also my half-dead sleep schedule that refuses to fall.
en.editorNote: For the friend who ground all the way to the semis and looks at the stacked bracket, thrilled and aching for themselves at once
variations: The top four all reached the semis — this World Cup can't even be bothered to hand us an upset anymore.
The four strongest teams made it to the end, and so did the most exhausted fan. We're all winners here.

items.sourceNote: 準決賽法國vs西班牙、英格蘭vs阿根廷，台灣時間 7/15、7/16 連兩天凌晨三點；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
準決賽兩場，法國對西班牙、英格蘭對阿根廷，
台灣時間七月十五、十六，連續兩天凌晨三點。
別人是週間五天班，我是週間兩天夜。
熬夜看球最殘忍的安排，不是三點開賽，
是它排在一起，連讓你補眠的那一天都不留給你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到準決賽連兩天凌晨、直接把那兩晚睡眠先劃掉的朋友
variations: 兩場神仙打架排在連續兩天，這是要我一次還清整個夏天欠的睡眠嗎。
上班連上五天叫辛苦，看球連熬兩天叫甘願，我兩種都在體驗。

en.content:
Two semifinals: France vs Spain, England vs Argentina,
Taiwan time July 15 and 16, back-to-back nights at 3 AM.
Other people work a five-day week. I'm pulling a two-night one.
The cruelest part of staying up for football isn't the 3 AM kickoff —
it's scheduling them on consecutive days, leaving you not even one night to catch up on sleep.
en.editorNote: For the friend who saw two straight predawn semis and crossed both nights of sleep off in advance
variations: Two heavyweight clashes on back-to-back nights — is this asking me to repay the whole summer's sleep debt at once?
Five days of work is called a grind. Two nights of football is called devotion. I'm living both.

items.sourceNote: 阿根廷 3-1 淘汰瑞士晉四強，衛冕軍挑戰逾60年無人達成的連霸；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
阿根廷三比一氣走瑞士，衛冕軍一路踢進四強，
再贏兩場，就是超過六十年沒人做到的連霸。
梅西這場沒進球，卻用一記助攻提醒大家他還在。
我熬夜看的其實不只是一場球，
是一段可能永遠不會再出現的歷史，正在凌晨三點慢慢寫成。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了見證阿根廷連霸夢、再睏都要守到終場的朋友
variations: 六十年沒人連霸，這種歷史等級的夜晚，睡覺實在太可惜。
梅西不進球也能讓全場屏息，這就是為什麼我甘願賠上整個凌晨。

en.content:
Argentina saw off Switzerland 3-1, and the champions have marched into the semis.
Two more wins and it's a back-to-back title no one has managed in over sixty years.
Messi didn't score this time, but one assist was enough to remind everyone he's still here.
What I'm really staying up for isn't just a match —
it's a piece of history that may never come again, being written slowly at 3 AM.
en.editorNote: For the friend who'll hold on till the final whistle, no matter how tired, to witness Argentina's repeat bid
variations: No one has repeated as champions in sixty years. A night of that magnitude is far too good to sleep through.
Messi can hold a whole stadium's breath without scoring. That's exactly why I'll gladly trade my entire predawn.

items.sourceNote: 決賽 7/19 MetLife、季軍賽 7/18 邁阿密，賽事進入尾聲；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
四強打完，剩下季軍賽和決賽，這個夏天的球，快要踢完了。
算一算，我還能為它熬夜的次數，一隻手就數得完。
奇怪的是，以前總盼著趕快睡飽，
現在卻開始捨不得每一個還有比賽的凌晨。
原來一件事最珍貴的時候，往往是它快要結束的時候。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合四強夜的限動，獻給每個算著還剩幾場、開始捨不得的球迷
variations: 剩沒幾場了，我一邊倒數，一邊偷偷希望決賽永遠不要來。
睡眠我隨時補得回來，這個能為球隊瘋狂的夏天，補不回來。

en.content:
The semis are done, and only the third-place match and the final remain — this summer's football is almost over.
Do the math and I can count the nights I have left to stay up for it on one hand.
The strange thing is, I used to long to just sleep in.
Now I can't bear to give up a single predawn that still has a match in it.
Turns out a thing is most precious right when it's about to end.
en.editorNote: Perfect for a semifinal-night story post — for every fan counting the matches left and starting to miss it already
variations: Only a few games left. I'm counting down, and secretly hoping the final never comes.
Sleep I can always make up. This summer of going crazy for a team, I can't.

items.sourceNote: 英格蘭 2-1 淘汰挪威，貝林漢梅開二度，哈蘭德止步八強；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
英格蘭二比一送走挪威，我熬夜本來是衝著哈蘭德來的，
結果那晚最亮的，是對面梅開二度的貝林漢。
世界盃就是這麼不受控——你為了某個人凌晨爬起來，
最後把掌聲全給了一個你根本沒準備要愛的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了 A 球員熬夜、卻不小心愛上 B 球員的朋友
variations: 熬夜看球最大的意外，是你等的人輸了，搶走你心的卻是另一個。
我為哈蘭德設好鬧鐘，貝林漢卻決定今晚由他發光。

en.content:
England edged Norway 2-1, and I'd set my alarm specifically for Haaland,
yet the brightest man on the pitch all night was Bellingham, with a brace at the other end.
The World Cup is uncontrollable like that — you drag yourself up at dawn for one player,
and hand all your applause to someone you never planned to fall for.
en.editorNote: For the friend who stayed up for player A and accidentally fell for player B
variations: The biggest surprise of a late match: the guy you waited for loses, and someone else steals your heart.
I set the alarm for Haaland. Bellingham decided the night would be his instead.

items.sourceNote: 阿根廷延長賽 3-1 瑞士，J・阿瓦雷茲 112 分鐘世界波；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
熬夜看球最怕聽到的三個字：延長賽。
你算好三點開賽、五點能睡，結果九十分鐘一比一，
比賽硬是又拖了半小時，把你最後一段睡眠也沒收。
阿根廷那場靠著一百一十二分鐘的世界波才分出勝負，
對球迷是史詩，對隔天要上班的我，是一張加班單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到「延長賽」三個字、就開始計算自己還能睡幾小時的朋友
variations: 九十分鐘沒分出勝負，先崩潰的不是球員，是我的生理時鐘。
延長賽對球隊是機會，對熬夜的我是多繳半小時的睡眠稅。

en.content:
The three scariest words when you're up late for football: extra time.
You'd planned for a 3 AM kickoff and sleep by 5, then it's 1-1 after ninety minutes,
and the match drags on another half hour, confiscating your last stretch of sleep.
Argentina's tie was only settled by a screamer in the 112th minute —
an epic for the fans, an overtime slip for the guy who has work in the morning.
en.editorNote: For the friend who hears 'extra time' and immediately starts calculating how many hours of sleep they have left
variations: Ninety minutes settled nothing, and the first to crack wasn't a player — it was my body clock.
Extra time is a chance for the teams and a half-hour sleep tax for the fan staying up.

items.sourceNote: 英格蘭對阿根廷準決賽，兩隊歷史宿怨（1986 上帝之手等）；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
英格蘭對阿根廷排進準決賽，光看到這組對戰，老球迷就先坐不住了。
從一九八六年那顆手，到後來一場又一場的恩怨，
這兩隊之間的故事，比很多看球的人年紀還長。
我對他們其實沒有立場，卻莫名被那股世仇的氣氛感染，
凌晨三點，像在追一部我沒參與、卻完全入戲的老片續集。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一聽到英格蘭對阿根廷、就開始翻歷史恩怨的資深球迷
variations: 有些對戰不用懂歷史也感受得到重量，英阿就是其中一組。
我沒經歷過那顆手，卻在凌晨三點替素未謀面的世仇緊張。

en.content:
England vs Argentina in the semifinal — just seeing that fixture, longtime fans can't sit still.
From that hand in 1986 to grudge after grudge since,
the story between these two is older than a lot of the people watching.
I've got no stake in either side, yet somehow that ancient-rivalry air gets to me,
and at 3 AM I'm hooked on a sequel to an old film I was never even in.
en.editorNote: For the veteran fan who hears 'England vs Argentina' and starts flipping through decades of history
variations: Some matchups carry a weight you feel without knowing the history. England-Argentina is one of them.
I never lived through that handball, yet at 3 AM I'm tense for a rivalry I've never been part of.

items.sourceNote: 季軍賽 7/18 邁阿密，兩支落敗準決賽隊碰頭；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
整屆熬過來，唯一一場我打算放過自己的，是季軍賽。
兩支剛輸掉準決賽的隊，在一場沒人真的想踢的比賽裡碰頭，
連他們自己看起來都很想回家。
這是整個夏天，我終於可以理直氣壯睡一場好覺的夜晚——
不是我不夠愛，是這場球，連球員都在幫我找藉口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個唯獨季軍賽決定睡飽、對此毫無罪惡感的朋友
variations: 世界盃唯一一場我選擇睡覺的比賽，剛好也是球員最想睡覺的比賽。
季軍賽的存在，是為了讓熬了一整個夏天的我，有一晚可以名正言順地投降。

en.content:
After a whole tournament of staying up, the one match I plan to let myself off for is the third-place game.
Two teams fresh off losing their semifinals meet in a match nobody really wants to play,
and even they look like they'd rather just go home.
This is the one night all summer I can, with a clear conscience, sleep properly —
it's not that I love it less; even the players are helping me find the excuse.
en.editorNote: For the friend who decides to sleep in for the third-place match only, and feels zero guilt about it
variations: The one World Cup match I choose to sleep through happens to be the one the players most want to sleep through too.
The third-place game exists so a fan who stayed up all summer gets one night to honorably surrender.

items.sourceNote: 四強法國、西班牙、英格蘭、阿根廷全是昔日世界盃冠軍；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
打到四強，剩下的四支全是拿過冠軍的老牌強權。
小組賽時我還在幫弱隊喊加油，
如今爆冷的隊伍全被淘汰，桌上只剩巨人對巨人。
童話結束了，接下來每一場，都是不睡也要看完的重量級對決。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個小組賽挺弱隊、四強卻只剩強隊可挑的朋友
variations: 四強沒有黑馬，只有四匹都想咬死對方的猛獸。
灰姑娘的故事在八強就散場了，四強開始，全是硬碰硬。

en.content:
By the semifinals, the four left standing are all former champions.
Back in the group stage I was cheering for the underdogs;
now every Cinderella has been knocked out, and it's just giants against giants.
The fairy tale is over. From here on, every match is a heavyweight bout I'll stay up to the last second for.
en.editorNote: For the friend who backed the underdogs in the group stage but has only powerhouses left to pick from now
variations: No dark horses in the semis — just four beasts that all want to tear each other apart.
The Cinderella story ended in the quarters. From the semifinals on, it's all heavy hitters.

items.sourceNote: 英格蘭延長賽 2-1 挪威、阿根廷延長賽 3-1 瑞士；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
八強兩場都踢進延長賽的那晚，我差點崩潰。
九十分鐘不夠，他們硬是又加了三十分鐘，
時鐘一路走到快五點。
球員在場上多跑三十分鐘，我在沙發上多熬三十分鐘，
我們一起用身體證明——這場比賽，真的很不想結束。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為快結束、結果被延長賽多留三十分鐘的難兄難弟
variations: 延長賽的三十分鐘，是球員的極限，也是我睡意的極限。
九十分鐘沒分出勝負，代價是我隔天上班直接進入殘血狀態。

en.content:
The night both quarterfinals went to extra time, I nearly lost it.
Ninety minutes wasn't enough — they tacked on another thirty,
and the clock crawled toward 5 AM.
The players ran an extra half hour on the pitch; I endured an extra half hour on the couch.
Together we proved, with our bodies, that this match really did not want to end.
en.editorNote: For the fellow sufferer who thought it was almost over, then got held hostage by thirty more minutes
variations: Extra time's thirty minutes are the players' limit — and the limit of my ability to stay awake.
Ninety minutes settled nothing, and the price was showing up to work the next day on empty.

items.sourceNote: 準決賽 7/15、7/16 台灣凌晨 3 點，決賽 7/20；賽事進入尾聲；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
算一算，剩下的凌晨三點沒剩幾個了。
兩場準決賽，一場決賽，然後這個夏天就要還我一個正常的作息。
奇怪的是，越接近尾聲，我越捨不得那個為了看球爬起來的自己。
原來我熬的不是夜，是一段再過幾天就會結束的日子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個發現世界盃快結束、突然開始珍惜每一場的朋友
variations: 只剩三個凌晨三點，我開始一場一場地數，像在數一段捨不得的假期。
決賽越近，我越希望這個失眠的夏天可以再長一點。

en.content:
Do the math and there aren't many 3 AM kickoffs left.
Two semifinals, one final, and then this summer hands me back a normal sleep schedule.
The strange thing is, the closer it gets to the end, the more I'll miss the version of me who got up just to watch.
Turns out it was never the sleep I was giving up — it was a stretch of days about to run out.
en.editorNote: For the friend who realized the World Cup is almost over and suddenly started treasuring every match
variations: Only three 3 AM nights left, and I'm counting them one by one, like the last days of a vacation I don't want to end.
The closer the final gets, the more I wish this sleepless summer could stretch a little longer.

items.sourceNote: 貝林罕關鍵表現助英格蘭晉級四強；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
有個我一週前還叫不出名字的球員，
昨晚一個人把整支球隊扛進了四強。
我明明跟他毫無關係，卻在凌晨四點為他握緊拳頭，
激動到像是他替我完成了什麼。
世界盃的魔法就是這樣——它讓一個陌生人，變成你熬夜的理由。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一夜之間多了一個本命球星、隔天到處安利的朋友
variations: 一週前我還不認識他，現在他進球我比誰都激動。
所謂英雄，就是那個讓你甘願為他多熬一場的陌生人。

en.content:
There's a player whose name I couldn't have told you a week ago,
and last night he single-handedly carried his whole team into the semifinals.
I have nothing to do with him, yet at 4 AM I was clenching my fist for him,
as thrilled as if he'd pulled off something on my behalf.
That's the magic of the World Cup: it turns a total stranger into your reason to stay up.
en.editorNote: For the friend who gained a favorite player overnight and spent the next day evangelizing about him
variations: A week ago I didn't know him. Now I'm more hyped than anyone when he scores.
A hero is just the stranger you'll gladly lose one more night of sleep for.

items.sourceNote: 四強法國、西班牙、英格蘭、阿根廷，觀眾各自選邊；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
四強都不是我的國家，但我還是得選一邊。
選球衣好看的？選球星我喜歡的？還是選那個我覺得比較可憐的？
最後我發現，我選的理由整場都在變，
看誰先進球，我的忠誠就先倒向誰。
世界盃教會我的事：沒有主隊的人，才選得最沒有壓力。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個四強沒有主隊、每場都臨時挑一隊支持的牆頭草朋友
variations: 沒有主隊的好處，是我可以每一場都重新談一次戀愛。
選誰不重要，重要的是我終於有一隊可以在凌晨三點大喊。

en.content:
None of the four semifinalists is my country, but I still have to pick a side.
The prettier kit? The player I like? Or the one I just feel a little sorry for?
Eventually I realized my reasons kept shifting all match long —
whoever scores first is who my loyalty tips toward.
What the World Cup taught me: the fan with no home team picks with the least pressure of all.
en.editorNote: For the fence-sitter friend with no team in the semis who adopts a new side every single match
variations: The upside of having no home team: I get to fall in love all over again every match.
Who I pick doesn't matter — what matters is finally having a side to scream for at 3 AM.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙 2-0 淘汰世界排名第一的法國，率先晉級決賽；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
賽前大家都說法國是奪冠大熱門，世界排名第一。
結果四強首戰，西班牙二比零，乾淨俐落把他們送回家。
我熬夜熬到一半才想起——我那張冠軍預測表，現在只剩一張廢紙。
世界盃最公平的地方，是它對你的預測，跟對強隊一樣毫不留情。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽前信誓旦旦說法國穩了、現在默默把預測表收起來的朋友
variations: 世界第一輸給世界第三，這就是我們熬夜的理由——因為誰都說不準。
我押的冠軍出局了，但我押的失眠，準時到帳。

en.content:
Before the match everyone called France the favorite — ranked number one in the world.
Then in the first semifinal, Spain sent them home 2-0, clean and clinical.
Halfway through my sleepless night I remembered: that bracket I filled out is now just scrap paper.
The fairest thing about the World Cup is that it's as merciless to your predictions as it is to the favorites.
en.editorNote: For the friend who swore France had it locked and is now quietly putting their bracket away
variations: World number one lost to world number three — which is exactly why we stay up: nobody can call it.
The champion I picked is out, but the insomnia I ordered arrived right on time.

items.sourceNote: 英格蘭對阿根廷四強戰，兩國世界盃恩怨從 1986 上帝之手到 1998 貝克漢紅牌；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今晚的四強，英格蘭對阿根廷，台灣時間又是凌晨三點。
這兩隊的世界盃恩怨，從八六年的「上帝之手」，一路吵到九八年貝克漢被紅牌，
每次交手都比連續劇還多戲。
我跟這兩國都沒關係，卻已經先幫他們把爆米花準備好了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了一場跟自己毫無關係的世仇對決、興奮到睡不著的朋友
variations: 英阿之戰從來不缺劇情，缺的只有我隔天上班的精神。
兩支跟我無關的球隊，卻讓我為了一段幾十年前的恩怨熬整夜。

en.content:
Tonight's semifinal, England versus Argentina, lands at 3 AM local time again.
The World Cup grudge between these two runs from the 1986 'Hand of God' all the way to Beckham's red card in '98 —
every meeting has more plot than a soap opera.
I have nothing to do with either country, yet I've already got the popcorn ready for them.
en.editorNote: For the friend too hyped to sleep over a bitter rivalry match that has nothing to do with them
variations: An England-Argentina match never lacks drama — the only thing it lacks is my energy at work the next day.
Two teams I have no stake in, and here I am losing a whole night over a grudge from decades ago.

items.sourceNote: 梅西本屆 8 球、生涯世界盃 21 球改寫紀錄，外界視為他最後一屆；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
梅西這屆已經進了好幾球，把世界盃生涯進球紀錄改寫成二十一顆，
大家都說，這很可能是他最後一屆世界盃了。
所以今晚我熬的不只是一場四強，
是想親眼看著一個時代，慢慢走到句點。
有些夜晚值得撐，是因為錯過了，就真的沒有下一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個說「看一場少一場」、把梅西每場都當最後一場在看的朋友
variations: 為一個傳奇的謝幕熬夜，是我這輩子少數不會後悔的失眠。
球星會退休，紀錄會被打破，但「我在現場看過」這件事不會。

en.content:
Messi has scored several goals this tournament, pushing his World Cup career record to twenty-one,
and everyone says this is very likely his last World Cup.
So tonight I'm not just staying up for a semifinal —
I'm staying up to watch an era quietly reach its final page.
Some nights are worth it because if you miss them, there really is no next time.
en.editorNote: For the friend who says 'one fewer left every time' and treats every Messi match like his last
variations: Losing sleep over a legend's farewell is one of the few nights of insomnia I'll never regret.
Stars retire and records fall, but 'I watched it live' is something no one can take back.

items.sourceNote: 2007 年梅西替嬰兒時期亞馬爾洗澡的老照片瘋傳，被稱世界盃時空膠囊；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
網路上瘋傳一張二〇〇七年的老照片：
年輕的梅西，正幫一個還是嬰兒的亞馬爾洗澡。
將近二十年後，那個嬰兒長成了世界盃舞台上的當家新星。
我看著照片，一邊算自己老了幾歲，
一邊發現——原來世界盃看久了，連時間都會回頭來提醒你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到那張洗澡照、默默開始懷疑自己年紀的朋友
variations: 當年被梅西抱著洗澡的嬰兒，現在自己成了世界盃主角，時間真的很敢。
看一張老照片就被提醒老了幾歲，這種傷害只有世界盃做得出來。

en.content:
An old photo from 2007 is going viral:
a young Messi bathing a baby who turns out to be Lamine Yamal.
Nearly twenty years later, that baby has grown into a headliner on the World Cup stage.
I stare at the photo, doing the math on how much older I've gotten,
and realize that watching enough World Cups means even time comes back to remind you.
en.editorNote: For the friend who saw that bath photo and quietly started questioning their own age
variations: The baby Messi once bathed is now a World Cup headliner. Time has some nerve.
Getting reminded of your age by a single old photo — only the World Cup can do that kind of damage.

items.sourceNote: 決賽 7/19 於紐澤西，賽事進入尾聲；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
打到四強，這個夏天也快熬到底了。
問題是，我的身體已經完全習慣凌晨三點清醒，
每天一到那個時間，眼睛就自動睜開，等著開賽。
再過幾天冠軍就出爐，比賽會結束，
但我怕，這顆被世界盃重新設定過的生理時鐘，不會跟著結束。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個擔心世界盃結束後、凌晨三點還是會自動醒來的朋友
variations: 比賽會有終場哨，我的作息不會，這才是真正的延長賽。
熬過一整個月，冠軍還沒出爐，我的睡眠已經先陣亡了。

en.content:
We're down to the semifinals, and this summer is almost fully run.
The problem is, my body has completely adjusted to being awake at 3 AM —
every night at that exact time, my eyes snap open, waiting for kickoff.
In a few days a champion will be crowned and the matches will end,
but I'm scared this body clock the World Cup reset won't end along with them.
en.editorNote: For the friend worried they'll still wake up automatically at 3 AM long after the World Cup is over
variations: The matches get a final whistle; my sleep schedule doesn't. That's the real extra time.
I survived a whole month, no champion crowned yet, and my sleep is already the first casualty.

items.sourceNote: 阿根廷 2-1 逆轉英格蘭，85 分鐘 Enzo、92 分鐘 Lautaro 補時連進兩球，梅西雙助攻；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
英格蘭領先到八十五分鐘，我都準備關電視去睡了。
結果阿根廷補時連灌兩球，九十二分鐘那顆頭槌，把整場翻了過來。
世界盃教我的最後一課：
千萬別在補時之前關掉螢幕，
因為最不甘心的，永遠是提早離場的那個人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個差點提早關電視、結果錯過絕殺的朋友
variations: 提早去睡的人，要用隔天一整個早上來後悔。
九十分鐘看起來要結束，其實好戲才正要開始，這就是我不敢先睡的原因。

en.content:
England led all the way to the 85th minute, and I was already reaching for the remote to go to bed.
Then Argentina scored twice in stoppage time — that 92nd-minute header flipped the whole match.
The last lesson the World Cup taught me:
never turn the screen off before stoppage time,
because the one who leaves early is always the one left with the most regret.
en.editorNote: For the friend who almost turned off the TV early and nearly missed the winner
variations: Whoever goes to bed early spends the entire next morning regretting it.
Ninety minutes looks like the end, but the best part is just starting — which is exactly why I don't dare sleep first.

items.sourceNote: 決賽底定西班牙對阿根廷，7/19 於 MetLife 球場，台灣時間 7/20 週一凌晨三點；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽底定，西班牙對阿根廷，這個夏天最後一場，台灣時間還是凌晨三點。
熬了一整個月，只剩這一夜。
我一邊期待冠軍出爐，一邊又有點捨不得——
因為這是今年最後一次，我有正當理由三點還醒著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合決賽倒數的限動，獻給每個既想看冠軍、又捨不得夏天結束的球迷
variations: 最後一場凌晨三點的比賽，看完就要跟這個時區說再見了。
冠軍會產生一個，但我們每個熬夜的人，都輸給了同一個對手——星期一早上。

en.content:
The final is set: Spain versus Argentina, the last match of the summer, still at 3 AM local time.
A whole month of staying up, and it all comes down to this one night.
I'm excited to see a champion crowned and a little heartbroken at the same time —
because this is the last time this year I'll have a legitimate excuse to be awake at 3.
en.editorNote: Perfect for a final-countdown story post — for every fan who wants to see the champion but can't bear the summer ending
variations: The last 3 AM match of the year. Once it's over, I have to say goodbye to this time zone.
There'll be one champion, but every one of us who stayed up loses to the same opponent: Monday morning.

items.sourceNote: 梅西四強雙助攻送阿根廷進決賽，力拚 1962 巴西後首次衛冕，外界視為他最後一屆；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
四強那晚，梅西一個人送出兩次助攻，硬是把阿根廷拖進決賽。
大家都說這很可能是他最後一屆，
而他正帶著球隊，去追一個從一九六二年之後就沒人做到的衛冕。
所以決賽這一夜我一定會撐著，
因為傳奇的最後一章，我不想用重播來讀。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把梅西每場都當最後一場、決賽說什麼都要熬的朋友
variations: 六十幾年沒人成功衛冕，他想在謝幕這年做到，這種故事值得失眠。
重播能補回比分，補不回『我陪他走到最後』的那份參與感。

en.content:
In the semifinal, Messi set up both goals himself and dragged Argentina into the final.
Everyone says this is very likely his last tournament,
and he's chasing a title defense no one has managed since 1962.
So I'll be up for the final no matter what,
because I don't want to read the last chapter of a legend on replay.
en.editorNote: For the friend who treats every Messi match as his last and will stay up for the final no matter what
variations: Nobody's defended the title in over sixty years, and he wants to do it in his farewell year — a story worth losing sleep over.
A replay can give you back the score, but not the feeling of having been there for the last chapter.

items.sourceNote: 季軍戰為兩支四強落敗的英格蘭與法國，賽事進入尾聲；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
季軍戰，英格蘭對法國，兩支剛在四強被淘汰、心還在痛的隊伍。
這種比賽公認最雞肋，球員興趣缺缺，觀眾也提不起勁。
但台灣時間又是半夜，而我還是打開了。
世界盃到了這個階段我才懂——
捨不得的不是哪一場，是這整個快要結束的夏天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個連公認最無聊的季軍戰都不願意錯過的重度球迷
variations: 連季軍戰都熬，不是因為好看，是因為看一場少一場。
最雞肋的比賽照樣熬夜看，這種病只有世界盃末期才會發作。

en.content:
The third-place playoff, England versus France — two teams just knocked out in the semis, wounds still fresh.
This match is famously pointless: the players look uninterested, the fans can't get excited.
But it's the middle of the night here again, and I opened it anyway.
Only at this stage did I finally get it —
what I can't let go of isn't any one match, it's this whole summer that's about to end.
en.editorNote: For the hardcore fan who won't even skip the famously boring third-place playoff
variations: I stay up even for the third-place game — not because it's good, but because there's one fewer left each time.
Losing sleep over the most pointless match on the calendar: a sickness that only flares up in the World Cup's final days.

items.sourceNote: 決賽台灣時間 7/20 週一凌晨三點，看完直接接上班日；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽台灣時間排在星期一凌晨三點。
看完直接天亮，然後——去上班。
我已經可以預見整間辦公室的樣子：
每個人頂著黑眼圈，用僅存的意識撐完週會，
嘴上不說，心裡都在為同一件事硬撐。
這大概是全公司一年裡，最有默契的一個早上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟你約好決賽隔天一起頂著黑眼圈上班的同事
variations: 決賽隔天的辦公室，是全台灣黑眼圈密度最高的地方。
看完決賽再上班，這不是敬業，是世界盃末期的集體瘋狂。

en.content:
The final lands at 3 AM Monday, local time.
You watch it straight through to sunrise, and then — you go to work.
I can already picture the whole office:
everyone with matching eye bags, running the Monday meeting on their last shred of consciousness,
nobody saying it out loud, all of us holding on for the same reason.
It's probably the most in-sync morning the whole company has all year.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who made a pact with you to show up with matching eye bags the day after the final
variations: The office the morning after the final has the highest concentration of eye bags in the country.
Watching the final and then clocking in isn't dedication. It's the collective madness of the World Cup's final days.

items.sourceNote: 決賽對戰組合出爐：西班牙 vs 阿根廷；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽組合終於出爐：西班牙對阿根廷。
一邊是傳控踢到讓人打瞌睡的藝術，一邊是逆轉逆到讓人心臟停跳的戲劇。
熬了一整個夏天，最後居然湊出這麼對味的一場。
凌晨三點，我對這兩隊其實都沒特別偏心，
只希望它踢得好看，好看到對得起我賠掉的這一夏睡眠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了決賽對戰組合，已經開始糾結該幫哪邊加油的朋友
variations: 西班牙的控球對上阿根廷的血性，這場光是想像就值得熬。
決賽組合出爐那刻我才確定：這個夏天的最後一夜，一定要清醒地看完。

en.content:
The final is set at last: Spain versus Argentina.
One side passes you into a pleasant nap, the other stages comebacks that stop your heart.
A whole summer of staying up, and it brewed exactly the right matchup.
At 3 AM I don't really favor either team —
I just want it to be good, good enough to justify the sleep I traded away all summer.
en.editorNote: For the friend already agonizing over which side to root for in the final
variations: Spain's possession against Argentina's grit — this one's worth staying up for on the concept alone.
The moment the matchup was confirmed, I knew: the last night of this summer, I'm watching wide awake.

items.sourceNote: 阿根廷準決賽 2-1 逆轉英格蘭，補時第 2 分鐘勞塔羅絕殺；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
英格蘭先進球那一刻，我已經默默準備關電視去睡了。
結果阿根廷第八十五分鐘扳平，補時第二分鐘再絕殺，二比一逆轉。
差一點我就錯過了整個夏天最戲劇的三分鐘。
這就是為什麼熬夜看球不能提早離席——
你以為結束了，比賽才正要開始教你做人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看球絕不敢提早關電視、被逆轉教育過太多次的朋友
variations: 領先不代表贏，提早睡才是真的輸，這場英格蘭替我上了一課。
補時絕殺的那一聲歡呼，值回我整個夏天所有的黑眼圈。

en.content:
The second England scored, I quietly reached for the remote to go to bed.
Then Argentina equalized in the 85th and won it in the second minute of stoppage time, 2-1.
I came within a click of missing the most dramatic three minutes of the whole summer.
This is exactly why you never leave a late match early —
the moment you think it's over is the moment it starts teaching you a lesson.
en.editorNote: For the friend who never dares turn off a match early, having been burned by too many comebacks
variations: A lead isn't a win, but going to bed early is a guaranteed loss. England taught me that one.
That stoppage-time roar was worth every eye bag I earned all summer.

items.sourceNote: 季軍賽 法國 vs 英格蘭 台灣時間 7/19 週日 05:00；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
季軍賽，兩支剛被淘汰的隊伍，法國對英格蘭，
台灣時間週日清晨五點開踢。
說真的，這場沒人是真的想看，
但身為熬了整個夏天的人，我還是默默把鬧鐘設好了。
季軍賽的存在，就是專門考驗誰是真愛、誰只是湊熱鬧。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個連季軍賽都不肯放過、堅持一場都要看完的硬核朋友
variations: 季軍賽就像吃到最後一口已經飽的甜點——不是餓，是捨不得。
淘汰賽都熬過來了，一場季軍賽哪能因為想睡就投降。

en.content:
The third-place match: two teams just knocked out, France versus England,
kicking off at 5 AM Sunday, local time.
Honestly, nobody actually wants to watch this one,
but as someone who's stayed up all summer, I quietly set the alarm anyway.
The third-place match exists purely to test who's a true fan and who was just along for the ride.
en.editorNote: For the hardcore friend who won't even skip the third-place match and insists on watching every last game
variations: The third-place match is like the last bite of dessert when you're already full — not hunger, just refusal to let go.
I survived the whole knockout run. I'm not surrendering to a third-place match just because I'm sleepy.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙 2-0 法國，奧亞薩巴爾點球、波羅進球；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
西班牙二比零收拾法國那場，
沒有絕殺、沒有神轉折，就是穩穩地控球、穩穩地贏。
我原本嫌它太悶，看到快睡著，
直到終場才懂：真正的強大，是把一場比賽踢到毫無懸念。
有些勝利很吵，有些勝利很安靜，這場屬於後者。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嫌傳控足球太無聊、卻又不得不佩服的朋友
variations: 把比賽踢到沒有意外，本身就是一種可怕的實力。
西班牙這場贏得很安靜，安靜到我差點睡著，卻也安靜到無法反駁。

en.content:
The night Spain saw off France 2-0,
there was no last-gasp winner, no wild twist — just calm possession and a calm win.
I thought it was too dull, nearly dozed off,
and only understood at the final whistle: true dominance is playing a match into total certainty.
Some wins are loud, some are quiet. This one was the quiet kind.
en.editorNote: For the friend who finds tiki-taka boring but can't help respecting it
variations: Playing a match until there are no surprises left is a terrifying kind of strength in itself.
Spain won this one so quietly I almost fell asleep — and so quietly there was nothing to argue with.

items.sourceNote: 決賽台灣時間 7/20 週一凌晨三點，梅西可能最後一屆世界盃；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽這一夜，很可能是梅西最後一屆世界盃的最後一場。
凌晨三點，我為一個跟我毫無關係的人捨不得，
捨不得他退場，也捨不得這個熬了整夏的自己。
看他踢完這一場，好像也在跟我的這個夏天告別。
有些人的謝幕，值得你賠上最後一夜的睡眠，好好看到最後一秒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合決賽夜的限動，獻給每個為了看某個球員最後一舞而熬夜的球迷
variations: 為一個素未謀面的人捨不得，這大概是世界盃教我最溫柔的一件事。
決賽哨音一響，結束的不只是比賽，還有一整代人一起熬過的那些三點。

en.content:
This final could be the last match of Messi's last World Cup.
At 3 AM, I'm reluctant to let go of a person I have nothing to do with —
reluctant to see him walk off, and reluctant to lose the version of me who stayed up all summer.
Watching him finish this one feels like saying goodbye to my whole summer too.
Some curtain calls are worth trading your last night of sleep to watch, right down to the final second.
en.editorNote: Perfect for a final-night story post — for every fan staying up to catch a certain player's last dance
variations: Feeling wistful over a stranger might be the gentlest thing the World Cup has ever taught me.
When the final whistle blows, it isn't just the match that ends — it's all those 3 AMs a whole generation stayed up for together.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃掀起「戒斷綜合征」全球球迷集體不捨；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束的第一個晚上，我照樣撐到凌晨三點。
打開電視，才想起——已經沒有比賽了。
熬了一整個夏天，突然被還給我的這幾個小時，
我反而不知道該拿它們怎麼辦。
原來最難熬的一夜，不是有比賽的那些，是沒有比賽的第一夜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃一結束、反而開始失眠的朋友
variations: 整個夏天嫌熬夜累，真的結束了，又開始想念那個累。
凌晨三點的空白，比凌晨三點的比賽還難熬。

en.content:
The first night after the World Cup ended, I stayed up till 3 AM out of habit.
I turned on the TV and remembered — there's no match anymore.
After a whole summer, those few hours were suddenly handed back to me,
and I had no idea what to do with them.
Turns out the hardest night wasn't any of the ones with a game. It was the first one without.
en.editorNote: For the friend who, the moment the World Cup ended, started having trouble sleeping
variations: All summer I complained the late nights were exhausting. Now that it's over, I miss being that tired.
The emptiness of 3 AM is harder to sit through than any 3 AM match ever was.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃後遺症 作息紊亂難以歸位；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃都結束三天了，我的生理時鐘還沒收到通知。
每天凌晨三點準時睜眼，習慣性地想找遙控器，
然後才想起，沒有比賽要看了。
身體記住的東西，比我以為的還頑固。
一個夏天養成的作息，不會因為決賽哨聲一響就自動歸零。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃結束後、還在凌晨三點自動醒來的朋友
variations: 教會身體凌晨三點起床只花了一週，教它別再起床，可能要一整個月。
賽程表已經沒了，我的生理時鐘還在照它跑。

en.content:
The World Cup's been over for three days, and my body clock still hasn't gotten the memo.
Every night at 3 AM my eyes snap open, hand reaching for the remote out of habit,
and then I remember there's no match to watch.
What the body memorizes is more stubborn than I gave it credit for.
A sleep schedule built over one summer doesn't reset itself the moment the final whistle blows.
en.editorNote: For the friend who still wakes up automatically at 3 AM now that the World Cup is over
variations: Teaching my body to wake at 3 AM took a week. Teaching it to stop might take a month.
The fixture list is gone. My body clock is still running on it.

items.sourceNote: 防世界盃後遺症 讓生活重拾正軌 收心；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃一結束，我好像被強制登出了某個世界。
過去一個月，我的話題、我的作息、我的情緒，全繞著一顆球轉。
現在球停了，我得重新學怎麼當一個作息正常、準時上班、晚上會睡覺的人。
最難的從來不是熬夜，是熬完之後，把自己調回原廠設定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃結束後、一時之間不知道生活重心該擺哪的朋友
variations: 熬夜有賽程表可以撐，收心沒有，全靠自己硬調回來。
世界盃教會我犧牲睡眠，卻沒教我結束後怎麼把它要回來。

en.content:
The moment the World Cup ended, I felt like I'd been force-logged-out of some world.
For a month, my conversations, my sleep, my moods — all of it orbited a single ball.
Now the ball has stopped, and I have to relearn how to be a person with a normal schedule, who shows up to work and sleeps at night.
The hard part was never the staying up. It's resetting yourself to factory settings once it's done.
en.editorNote: For the friend who, now that the World Cup's over, doesn't quite know where to point their life
variations: Staying up had a fixture list to carry you through. Winding down has nothing — you reset yourself by hand.
The World Cup taught me to sacrifice sleep. It never taught me how to claim it back afterward.

items.sourceNote: 熬夜看球後遺症 黑眼圈/暗瘡/身體代價；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束了，該來的帳單也一起寄到了。
黑眼圈沒消、冒了幾顆痘、咖啡越喝越沒感覺，
體重還悄悄多了看球配宵夜的那幾公斤。
這一個月的熱血都是先享受、後付款，
而現在，是身體開始跟我對帳的時候了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃結束後、開始默默還睡眠債、戒宵夜的朋友
variations: 一個夏天的熬夜，身體都幫我記帳，一筆都沒少。
看球的時候有多快樂，還債的時候就有多誠實。

en.content:
The World Cup is over, and the bill it ran up arrived right along with it.
The eye bags haven't faded, a few pimples showed up, the coffee stopped working,
and there are a couple of extra pounds from all those matches watched with midnight snacks.
A month of adrenaline was all enjoy-now, pay-later,
and now it's time for my body to go over the books with me.
en.editorNote: For the friend quietly repaying their sleep debt and swearing off midnight snacks now that the World Cup's over
variations: My body kept a ledger of every late night this summer, and it didn't miss a single one.
However much fun the matches were, paying the debt back is exactly that honest.

items.sourceNote: 決賽西班牙 1-0 阿根廷，費蘭·托雷斯延長下半場開賽 37 秒破門；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽零比零悶到延長賽，我眼皮已經快撐不住。
延長下半場才開賽三十七秒，費蘭·托雷斯一腳把整個夏天結束掉。
如果我早十分鐘去睡，我會錯過那顆唯一的球。
這個夏天教我的最後一件事：撐住，通常不是為了看到什麼，
是為了不讓自己在最後一刻才後悔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個決賽撐到延長賽、剛好看到致勝球的朋友，一起炫耀你們沒有先睡
variations: 一百二十分鐘只進一球，而那一球剛好在我差點放棄的下一分鐘。
熬到延長賽的人，領到了這個夏天最後一份獎勵。

en.content:
The final was scoreless and dragging into extra time, and my eyelids were done.
Thirty-seven seconds into the second extra period, Ferran Torres ended the whole summer with one swing.
If I'd gone to bed ten minutes earlier, I'd have missed the only goal there was.
Last thing this summer taught me: hanging on usually isn't about what you'll see —
it's about not regretting it at the very last minute.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who stuck it out through extra time and caught the winner — brag together about not going to bed
variations: One goal in a hundred and twenty minutes, and it landed the minute after I nearly gave up.
Everyone who made it to extra time collected the summer's last reward.

items.sourceNote: 梅西 39 歲，決賽落敗後在場上落淚，本屆 8 球 4 助攻、生涯世界盃 21 球；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
終場哨響，鏡頭帶到梅西轉身面對看台，
三十九歲的他，就這樣在球場中央哭了。
這屆他八球四助攻，比誰都拚，最後還是差一球。
凌晨五點的客廳，我也跟著紅了眼眶——
不是因為輸贏，是因為我剛好看見一個時代，在我眼前收尾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完決賽默默不說話、只回你一句「有點捨不得」的朋友
variations: 他哭的不是這場比賽，是再也沒有下一屆的那個事實。
有些人的謝幕沒有冠軍，但整個球場都站起來了。

en.content:
The whistle blew, the camera found Messi turning toward the stands,
and at thirty-nine he just stood there in the middle of the pitch and wept.
Eight goals and four assists this tournament — he gave more than anyone — and still came up one short.
At 5 AM in my living room, my eyes went red too,
not over the result, but because I happened to watch an era close right in front of me.
en.editorNote: For the friend who went quiet after the final and only replied, 'that one hurts a little'
variations: He wasn't crying over the match. He was crying over there not being a next one.
Some farewells don't come with a trophy, and the whole stadium stands up anyway.

items.sourceNote: 羅德里獲金球獎，梅西雖 8 球 4 助攻仍未獲獎；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
金球獎最後給了羅德里，不是進最多球的梅西。
我盯著螢幕想了三秒，然後想到我自己的年度考績。
原來不管在哪個舞台，
最拚的那個，跟拿到獎的那個，本來就不一定是同一個人。
差別只在於，人家輸了有整座球場鼓掌，我只有一封系統通知信。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個年度考績剛出爐、覺得努力沒被看見的同事
variations: 數據最漂亮的不一定得獎，這件事足球和職場的規則一模一樣。
獎盃會發給誰是別人決定的，你這一年拚成什麼樣，只有你自己算得清。

en.content:
The Golden Ball went to Rodri, not to the guy who scored the most.
I stared at the screen for three seconds, then thought about my own annual review.
Turns out it doesn't matter what stage you're on:
the one who works hardest and the one who takes home the award were never guaranteed to be the same person.
The only difference is he lost in front of a stadium that applauded. I got an automated email.
en.editorNote: For the coworker whose performance review just landed and who feels the effort went unseen
variations: Best numbers doesn't mean best award. Football and office politics run the same rulebook.
Someone else decides who gets the trophy. Only you can count what the year actually cost you.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙睽違 2010 年後第二座世界盃冠軍；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
西班牙上一次捧起這座盃，是二○一○年。
中間隔了十六年，換了一整批球員，也換了一整批球迷。
有些等待，長到你已經不敢說出口，怕自己聽起來太傻。
然後某個凌晨，它就這樣兌現了。
世界盃真正殘忍又溫柔的地方，是它從來不保證，但它偶爾會發生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合決賽後的限動，也很適合傳給那個等一件事等很久、快撐不住的朋友
variations: 十六年不是一個數字，是一整代人的青春加上一夜沒睡。
沒人保證會等到，但等到的人都知道，那一刻值得所有的凌晨。

en.content:
The last time Spain lifted this trophy was 2010.
Sixteen years in between — a whole new squad, and a whole new generation of fans.
Some waits get so long you stop saying them out loud, in case you sound foolish.
And then one night, at some absurd hour, the thing just happens.
That's what's cruel and kind about the World Cup: it promises nothing, but occasionally it delivers.
en.editorNote: Great for a post-final story post, and for the friend who's been waiting a long time on something and is running out of patience
variations: Sixteen years isn't a number. It's a generation's youth plus one sleepless night.
Nobody guaranteed it would come. Everyone it came for knows it was worth every 3 AM.

items.sourceNote: 下一屆 2030 世界盃由摩洛哥、葡萄牙、西班牙合辦，跨三大洲；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽結束沒幾個鐘頭，就有人開始查下一屆了。
二〇三〇，摩洛哥、葡萄牙、西班牙合辦，橫跨三大洲。
四年，聽起來好遠，遠到我現在完全想像不到那時候的自己。
但我知道，等時間一到，我還是會為了一群陌生人，乖乖把鬧鐘調回凌晨三點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個決賽才剛看完、就已經在期待下一屆的朋友
variations: 這個夏天才剛結束，倒數四年的鬧鐘已經在心裡默默按下。
四年後換一批球員、一批球迷，唯一不變的，是我又會為它熬夜。

en.content:
The final wasn't even a few hours old before people started looking up the next one.
2030 — Morocco, Portugal, and Spain, spread across three continents.
Four years sounds so far off, far enough that I can't picture who I'll be by then.
But I know that when the time comes, I'll dutifully set my alarm back to 3 AM for a bunch of strangers all over again.
en.editorNote: For the friend who barely finished watching the final and is already looking forward to the next tournament
variations: This summer just ended, and the four-year countdown is already quietly ticking in my head.
In four years it'll be new players and new fans. The only constant is that I'll lose sleep over it again.

items.sourceNote: 亞馬爾角逐本屆世界盃最佳年輕球員獎，新生代崛起；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
梅西在場中央落淚的同一個夜晚，另一頭，十八歲的亞馬爾正捧著新人獎。
一個時代在謝幕，另一個時代剛按下開始鍵。
世界盃最迷人的地方，是它從不留白——
有人揮手道別的那一秒，鏡頭已經轉向下一個要接棒的人。
這場我熬的夜，剛好夾在兩個世代的交接點上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一邊捨不得老將、一邊已經開始期待新星的朋友
variations: 老將的最後一屆，往往就是新星的第一屆，足球從不浪費任何一個夜晚。
看著新人捧獎才發現，我熬夜看的不只是比賽，是一整條時間軸。

en.content:
The same night Messi wept in the center circle, at the other end an eighteen-year-old Yamal was collecting the young player award.
One era taking its bow, another just hitting start.
The most captivating thing about the World Cup is that it never leaves a gap —
the second someone waves goodbye, the camera's already turned to whoever's picking up the torch.
The night I stayed up for landed right on the seam between two generations.
en.editorNote: For the friend torn between mourning the veterans and already being excited for the next star
variations: A veteran's last tournament is often a young star's first. Football never wastes a single night.
Watching the kid lift the award, I realized I hadn't just stayed up for a match — I'd stayed up for a whole timeline.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙封王遊行逾百萬球迷湧馬德里街頭至西貝萊斯廣場；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
西班牙奪冠隔天，馬德里街頭湧進上百萬人，
紅色球衣一路擠到西貝萊斯廣場，敞篷巴士被歡呼聲淹沒。
我在地球另一邊的沙發上，隔著螢幕看這場我永遠到不了的派對，
卻莫名跟著鼻酸。
原來為一支不是自己國家的隊伍熬了整個夏天，到最後，連他們的快樂都想分一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看奪冠遊行看到眼眶泛紅、自己都覺得莫名其妙的朋友
variations: 到不了現場沒關係，隔著一個時區，我還是替他們高興得亂七八糟。
這場遊行跟我一點關係都沒有，但我熬的那些夜，好像也在裡面。

en.content:
The day after Spain won, over a million people flooded the streets of Madrid,
a sea of red jerseys packed all the way to Cibeles, the open-top bus drowning in cheers.
I watched this party I'll never make it to from a couch on the other side of the planet,
and my nose stung anyway.
Turns out that after staying up all summer for a team that isn't even mine, in the end I wanted a small share of their joy too.
en.editorNote: For the friend who teared up watching the victory parade and couldn't quite explain why
variations: I'll never make it there in person, but a whole time zone away I'm still a mess of happy for them.
This parade has nothing to do with me, and yet all those nights I stayed up feel like they're somewhere in it.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後球迷收拾心情與生活；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束的隔天，我開始清手機。
那三個時鐘、兩個賽程 app、一個倒數程式，一個一個刪掉。
每刪一個，就像把這個夏天關掉一盞燈。
刪到最後我停了一下——
手機是清乾淨了，可是被這一個月填滿的那塊地方，一時之間還空著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽事一結束、默默把一堆世界盃 app 都移除的朋友
variations: 裝的時候是為了不錯過任何一場，刪的時候才發現，真正捨不得的是那份期待。
手機恢復原狀只要三分鐘，我的心恢復原狀，好像沒那麼快。

en.content:
The day after the World Cup ended, I started cleaning out my phone.
The three clocks, the two fixture apps, the countdown timer — deleting them one by one.
Each one felt like switching off another light on this summer.
Near the end I paused —
the phone was clean again, but the space this month had filled sat empty for a while.
en.editorNote: For the friend who quietly uninstalled a pile of World Cup apps the moment the tournament ended
variations: I installed them so I wouldn't miss a match. Deleting them, I realized what I'd miss was the anticipation.
Restoring the phone took three minutes. Restoring me is taking a little longer.

items.sourceNote: 美加墨主辦 台灣場次落清晨到上午 上班族用特休看球；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我今年的特休，沒拿去出國，也沒拿去補眠。
全砸在幾個清晨五點開賽的場次上——
請一天假，只為了看完球、再心安理得地睡到中午。
同事以為我去旅行了，
其實我只是把整年最寶貴的假，換成了幾顆別人踢進的球。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把特休排在世界盃賽程、而不是連假的同事
variations: 別人的特休換來一趟旅行，我的特休換來一場凌晨的比賽，跟一整天的黑眼圈。
年假只剩三天，我一天都沒留給自己，全留給了一群跟我不同國的球員。

en.content:
This year's vacation days didn't go to a trip, or to catching up on sleep.
I blew them all on a few matches that kicked off at 5 in the morning —
taking the day off just so I could watch to the end, then sleep till noon with a clear conscience.
My coworkers assumed I went traveling.
Really, I just traded my most precious days of the year for a few goals somebody else scored.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who scheduled their PTO around the World Cup fixtures instead of a long weekend
variations: Other people spend their days off on a vacation. I spent mine on a 5 AM match and a full day of eye bags.
Three vacation days left, and I saved none for myself — all of them went to a bunch of players from another country.

items.sourceNote: 台北酒吧開幕戰凌晨三點約百人爆滿 決賽延長營業；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點，我沒待在家，反而跑去一間擠滿人的運動酒吧。
一百多個陌生人，穿著八國球衣，為同一顆球一起吼。
進球那一刻，整間店的人同時跳起來，
我抱住旁邊一個完全不認識的人。
平常這個時間，路上一個人都沒有——
只有這裡，把全城睡不著的怪人，通通收在了一起。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個約你凌晨去酒吧看球、說「在家看沒 fu」的朋友
variations: 我跟旁邊那桌從頭到尾沒交換過名字，卻一起經歷了這個夏天最激動的九十分鐘。
凌晨三點還醒著的人，在家叫失眠，在這間酒吧叫戰友。

en.content:
3 AM, and I wasn't home — I was in a packed sports bar instead.
A hundred-something strangers in the jerseys of eight different countries, roaring at the same ball.
The second we scored, the whole place leapt up at once,
and I was hugging someone I'd never met in my life.
At this hour the streets outside are empty —
only this room had gathered up every sleepless weirdo in the city.
en.editorNote: For the friend who dragged you to a 3 AM bar because 'watching at home just isn't the same'
variations: The table next to me and I never traded names, but we lived through the most electric 90 minutes of the summer together.
Awake at 3 AM at home, they call it insomnia. Awake at 3 AM in this bar, they call it comrades.

items.sourceNote: 台灣場次多在清晨 家人熟睡 戴耳機靜音看球;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點，全家都睡了，我戴著耳機縮在沙發前。
進球那一刻，我張大嘴、握緊拳頭、跳了起來——
卻硬是沒發出半點聲音。
這是世界盃教會我的絕技：
情緒可以拉到滿格，音量卻要維持在零。
最激動的歡呼，我全都無聲地喊完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了不吵醒家人、練成一身「靜音歡呼」功夫的球迷
variations: 別人進球是全場沸騰，我進球是全身用力、一聲不吭，深怕吵醒隔壁房。
耳機裡是滿場的吶喊，我的客廳裡，只有我一個人無聲地瘋。

en.content:
3 AM, the whole family asleep, and I'm curled in front of the couch with earbuds in.
The moment we scored, I threw my mouth wide open, clenched my fists, jumped up —
and made absolutely no sound at all.
That's the trick the World Cup taught me:
your emotions can max out while your volume stays at zero.
Every one of my biggest cheers, I screamed in total silence.
en.editorNote: For the fan who mastered the art of the 'silent celebration' to keep from waking the household
variations: For everyone else a goal means the whole room erupts. For me it means every muscle tensing and not a single sound, terrified of waking the next room.
The roar of a full stadium in my earbuds, and in my living room, just me, going quietly insane.

items.sourceNote: 上午場沒法看只能錄影 躲一整天比分卻被同事爆雷;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
上午那場沒法看，只能先設定錄影，
然後展開一整天的躲避戰——群組關靜音、社群不敢滑、體育推播全部封鎖。
結果午休一抬頭，同事一句「那顆絕殺超扯」，
我一整個上午的忍耐，就這樣被三個字報銷了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是不小心爆雷、還一臉無辜的同事
variations: 錄影躲了一整天，最後敗給茶水間一句無心的「輸了齁」。
這屆最難防守的不是對方前鋒，是身邊那張守不住比分的嘴。

en.content:
I couldn't watch the morning match, so I hit record and spent the whole day playing defense —
group chat muted, feeds off-limits, every sports alert blocked.
Then at lunch a coworker goes, "That last-second winner was insane,"
and a whole morning of self-control died in one sentence.
en.editorNote: Send to the coworker who always spoils it, then looks genuinely surprised you're upset
variations: Dodged spoilers all day, only to lose to a casual "rough result, huh?" by the coffee machine.
The toughest defense this tournament wasn't against their striker — it was against the guy who can't keep a score to himself.

items.sourceNote: 設了鬧鐘卻睡過頭 錯過最想看的一場;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我設了三個鬧鐘，發誓這場一定要看。
結果一個都沒把我叫醒，睜眼已經是早上七點。
打開手機，比分定了，絕殺也進了，全世界都看過了，只有我沒有。
熬得住整個夏天的凌晨，卻敗給最想看的那一場。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個信誓旦旦要陪你看、結果自己先睡死的戰友
variations: 三個鬧鐘全陣亡，我用最慘的方式錯過了最精彩的一場。
熬夜看球的最高懲罰，不是睏，是睡過那場你最在乎的。

en.content:
I set three alarms and swore I'd catch this one.
Not one of them woke me — I opened my eyes and it was already 7 AM.
Final score locked, the winner scored, the whole world had seen it. Everyone but me.
I survived a summer of 3 AMs, then slept through the one match I wanted most.
en.editorNote: Send to the buddy who promised to watch with you and passed out first
variations: Three alarms, all casualties. I missed the best match in the worst way possible.
The cruelest punishment for a night-owl fan isn't being tired — it's sleeping through the one that mattered.

items.sourceNote: 為一支不是自己國家的隊買球衣 只穿一個夏天的紀念;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
熬了幾個禮拜，我做了一件連自己都解釋不了的事——
上網訂了一件球衣，一支不在我國家、我上個月還不會拼名字的隊。
它掛在衣櫃裡，我大概一輩子只會穿這一個夏天。
但只要看到它，我就想起那些沒有人陪、卻捨不得睡的凌晨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個衣櫃裡也有一件說不清為什麼會買的客隊球衣的朋友
variations: 我為一支叫不全隊員名字的球隊，買了一件只穿一個夏天的球衣。
那件球衣不值錢，值錢的是它記得我熬過的每一個三點。

en.content:
After weeks of this, I did something I can't even explain to myself —
I ordered a jersey online. A team that isn't mine, whose name I couldn't spell last month.
It'll hang in my closet, and I'll probably only ever wear it this one summer.
But every time I see it, I remember those 3 AMs nobody stayed up for but me.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who also owns a foreign team's shirt they can't quite explain buying
variations: I bought a jersey for a team whose roster I can't name, to wear for exactly one summer.
The shirt was cheap. What's priceless is that it remembers every 3 AM I survived.

items.sourceNote: 另一半成為世界盃遺孀 容忍一整個夏天的熬夜;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這一個月，我的另一半升格成「世界盃遺孀」。
凌晨三點我為別人的球隊尖叫，白天補眠打呼，宵夜盤子堆到流理台。
她沒生氣，只是默默把我的鬧鐘往後調了十分鐘，
留了一句：「看完記得關電視，還有，我也想你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個容忍你熬夜看球一整個夏天的另一半，說聲謝謝
variations: 陪我熬過整個夏天的不是球隊，是那個被我冷落還幫我留宵夜的人。
世界盃結束那天，最該頒獎的不是冠軍，是我家那位「遺孀」。

en.content:
For a whole month, my partner got promoted to "World Cup widow."
At 3 AM I screamed for other people's teams; by day I snored off the sleep debt, snack plates piling in the sink.
She never got mad — just quietly nudged my alarm ten minutes later
and left a note: "Turn off the TV when you're done. Also, I miss you."
en.editorNote: Send to the partner who put up with your all-summer match habit — say thanks
variations: What actually got me through the summer wasn't a team — it was the person I ignored who still saved me a midnight snack.
The day the World Cup ended, the real trophy belonged to the 'widow' back home.

items.sourceNote: 賽後討論一個月熱潮退去 臨時球迷回歸日常;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束五天，辦公室的足球專家全部消失了。
上個月那個把陣型講得頭頭是道的同事，今天連冠軍是誰都要想一下。
一個月前我們聊越位、聊換人、聊誰該進名單，
現在話題已經自動切回房價跟午餐吃什麼。
熱情退得比我想像中快，
只剩我還在偷偷回味那些沒人再提起的凌晨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃一結束，比誰都快忘記球隊名字的同事
variations: 上個月全公司都是總教練，這個月連冠軍隊都要想三秒。
潮水退了才看得出來，誰是真的睡不著，誰只是跟著大家一起醒著。

en.content:
Five days after the final, every soccer expert in the office has vanished.
The coworker who could break down formations last month had to pause today to remember who won.
A month ago we argued offside calls, substitutions, who should've made the squad.
Now the conversation has snapped back to rent and where to get lunch.
The hype drained faster than I expected —
and I'm the only one still quietly replaying 3 AMs nobody else brings up.
en.editorNote: Send to the coworker who forgot every team name the second the tournament ended
variations: Last month everyone was a manager. This month it takes them three seconds to name the champions.
When the tide goes out you find out who actually couldn't sleep and who was just awake with the crowd.

items.sourceNote: 104 場總進場約 681 萬人創紀錄，美國決賽跨平台約 6280 萬人收看;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這屆一百零四場比賽，進場的人加起來將近六百八十萬。
光是決賽那一晚，美國就有六千多萬人守著同一顆球。
我不在球場，也不在那些數字的黃金時段裡，
我只是在地球另一邊的沙發上，凌晨三點，一個人。
但我知道，在那個大到看不出我的統計裡，
一定也藏著幾百萬個跟我一樣捨不得睡的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個身邊沒人陪看球、卻知道全世界都有同伴的球迷
variations: 我只是幾百萬分之一，但那個夏天，我們是同時醒著的。
統計數字記不住我的名字，卻記得那晚有多少人捨不得關電視。

en.content:
Across 104 matches this tournament, nearly 6.8 million people walked through the turnstiles.
On the night of the final alone, over 60 million in the US were locked onto the same ball.
I wasn't in a stadium, and I wasn't in anybody's prime-time numbers.
I was on a couch on the other side of the planet, 3 AM, alone.
But somewhere inside a count too big to show my one square,
there were millions of people who couldn't bring themselves to sleep either.
en.editorNote: For the fan who watches alone but knows the whole world is up with them
variations: I was one in several million, but that summer, we were all awake at the same time.
The stats don't remember my name. They do remember how many of us refused to turn off the TV.

items.sourceNote: 賽後整理手機 滿是對著電視拍的模糊照片;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今天整理手機相簿，一路滑回六月。
全是對著電視拍的糊照片：計分板、慢動作重播、還有我自己的腳跟茶几。
每一張的時間都印著凌晨三點多。
畫質爛到根本認不出誰是誰，
我卻一張都刪不掉——
因為它們拍下的不是比賽，是那個還熬得住的我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個相簿裡也存滿電視螢幕糊照、捨不得刪的球迷
variations: 照片糊成一團，記憶卻清楚得要命。
別人的夏天相簿是海邊跟煙火，我的是一格一格的電視螢幕。

en.content:
Cleaned out my camera roll today and scrolled all the way back to June.
Nothing but blurry photos of a TV: the scoreboard, a slow-mo replay, my own feet and the coffee table.
Every timestamp reads a little past 3 AM.
The quality is so bad you can't tell one player from another,
and I still can't delete a single one —
because what they caught wasn't the match. It was the version of me that could still stay up.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose photos are all blurry TV screens they refuse to delete
variations: The photos are a smudge. The memory is painfully sharp.
Other people's summer albums are beaches and fireworks. Mine is one TV screen after another.

items.sourceNote: 決賽後看球群組集體安靜 賽事結束沒話題;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃期間，那個看球群組一天可以刷五百則。
誰進球、誰該被換下、誰的預測又落空，吵得沒完沒了。
決賽到現在五天，群組一則新訊息也沒有。
我點進去往上滑，看著那些凌晨三點的對話，
突然很想說點什麼，
又想不出來，沒有比賽的時候，我們還能聊什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到那個決賽後就集體安靜的看球群組，把大家叫醒
variations: 群組最後一則訊息停在「結束了」，然後就真的結束了。
最捨不得的其實不是比賽，是那個一天能吵五百則的我們。

en.content:
During the tournament that watch-party group chat could rack up 500 messages a day.
Who scored, who should've been subbed, whose bracket died this time — it never stopped.
It's been five days since the final and there hasn't been a single new message.
I opened it and scrolled up through all those 3 AM conversations,
suddenly wanting to say something,
and realizing I don't know what we talk about when there's no match on.
en.editorNote: Drop this into the watch-party group chat that's gone silent since the final
variations: The last message in the chat is "well, that's it," and then it really was.
What I miss isn't the games. It's the us that could send 500 messages about them in a day.

items.sourceNote: 賽事帶動小孩開始踢球 熱潮留下的影響;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今天經過樓下公園，多了幾個踢球的小孩。
其中一個穿著一看就是夜市買的紅色球衣，
一邊帶球一邊自己配旁白，然後對著空氣揮拳慶祝。
一個月前，這裡只有溜滑梯跟跳格子。
比賽是結束了，
但它顯然在某些人心裡，才剛剛開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完世界盃就開始想找顆球來踢的人
variations: 大人熬完夜就散了，小孩看完球才真的開始。
這個夏天最後留下的不是比分，是公園裡多出來的那顆球。

en.content:
Walked past the park downstairs today and there were kids playing soccer.
One of them in a red jersey you can tell came off a night-market rack,
dribbling while doing his own commentary, then throwing a fist pump at nobody.
A month ago this place was just slides and hopscotch.
The tournament is over,
but for some people it clearly only just started.
en.editorNote: For the person who finished the World Cup and immediately went looking for a ball
variations: The grown-ups stayed up and then moved on. The kids watched and are only now beginning.
What this summer really left behind wasn't a scoreline. It was the extra ball in the park.

items.sourceNote: 賽後身體時鐘還停在凌晨三點 生理時鐘難調回;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
比賽結束一個禮拜了，
昨晚我沒設鬧鐘，凌晨三點還是自己醒了。
睜開眼，習慣性伸手要找遙控器，
才想起來今天沒有球可以看。
身體記得那個時間，可是那個時間已經沒有理由存在了。
原來熬夜熬到最後，最難調回來的不是作息，是那份期待。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃結束後、半夜還是會自己醒來的朋友
variations: 沒有鬧鐘，身體卻準時三點醒——它還在等一場不會再來的比賽。
作息可以慢慢調，難調的是那個一到三點就會亮起來的期待。

en.content:
It's been a week since the tournament ended,
and last night I didn't set an alarm but still woke up at 3 AM.
Eyes open, my hand reached for the remote out of habit,
then I remembered there's no match on tonight.
My body still knows the time. The time just doesn't have a reason anymore.
Turns out the hardest thing to reset after weeks of this isn't the sleep. It's the anticipation.
en.editorNote: For the friend who still snaps awake at 3 AM now that the World Cup is over
variations: No alarm, and my body still woke at 3 — still waiting on a match that isn't coming.
The sleep schedule you can fix. What's hard is the thing in you that used to light up at 3 AM.

items.sourceNote: CNN 賽後「情緒宿醉」報導 晚上突然沒有期待;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
以前每天下班都在倒數——再撐幾小時就有球看。
現在下班回家，洗完澡，坐在沙發上，
打開電視，一個一個台轉過去，
沒有一個是我在等的。
原來這一個月，真正撐著我熬夜的，
不是足球，是「今晚還有件事值得等」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃結束後、晚上突然不知道要幹嘛的朋友
variations: 不是想念比賽，是想念每個傍晚都還有件事值得倒數的感覺。
電視轉了一圈，才發現最難填的不是時段，是那份期待。

en.content:
I used to count down every day after work — just a few more hours till kickoff.
Now I get home, shower, sit down on the couch,
flip through the channels one by one,
and not a single one is the thing I'm waiting for.
Turns out what really got me through those late nights this past month
wasn't the soccer. It was having something to look forward to tonight.
en.editorNote: For the friend who suddenly doesn't know what to do with their evenings now the Cup's over
variations: It's not the matches I miss. It's every evening having something to count down to.
Flipped through every channel and realized the hard part isn't the empty slot — it's the missing anticipation.

items.sourceNote: 本屆閉幕 下屆 2030 世界盃四年後;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
冠軍捧起獎盃那一刻，主播說了句：「四年後，我們再見。」
四年。
四年後我幾歲、在哪座城市、跟誰一起看，我都不知道。
只知道到時候一定又會有人喊：「這場一定要熬夜。」
然後我又會像個傻子一樣，準時爬起來。
這不是結束，這是下一次倒數的開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完決賽有點空虛、又已經在期待下屆的朋友
variations: 「四年後見」聽起來很遠，但真愛的人已經開始倒數了。
散場不是說再見，是先各自回去，然後四年後在同一個凌晨重逢。

en.content:
The moment they lifted the trophy, the commentator said, "See you in four years."
Four years.
Where I'll be, how old I'll be, who I'll watch it with — I have no idea.
All I know is someone will say, "This one, we have to stay up for it,"
and I'll drag myself up right on time, like a fool, all over again.
This isn't an ending. It's the start of the next countdown.
en.editorNote: For the friend who felt a little empty after the final and is already looking forward to 2030
variations: "See you in four years" sounds far away, but the real fans already started the countdown.
The lights go up and we don't say goodbye — we just head home and reunite at the same 3 AM in four years.

items.sourceNote: 賽後球衣收進衣櫃 回歸上班日常;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今天早上開衣櫃，那件穿了一個月的球衣被我掛回最裡面，
前面重新掛上襯衫跟西裝褲。
洗好、摺好、收起來，動作很輕，
像在幫一段很吵很快樂的日子闔上門。
明天又要準時進辦公室、開會、回訊息。
世界盃教會我一件事：
穿什麼不重要，重要的是那個穿著它、凌晨還醒著的自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把世界盃球衣收回衣櫃、隔天要收心上班的朋友
variations: 球衣掛回最裡面，襯衫掛回最外面——夏天結束的儀式感就是這麼樸素。
收起的不是一件球衣，是那個為了熱愛、什麼都豁出去的自己。

en.content:
Opened the closet this morning and hung that jersey — the one I lived in for a month — all the way to the back,
dress shirts and slacks back in front of it.
Washed, folded, put away, all very gently,
like closing the door on a loud, happy stretch of days.
Tomorrow it's back to clocking in on time, meetings, replying to messages.
The World Cup taught me one thing:
it's not about what you wear. It's about that version of you who wore it and was still awake at 3 AM.
en.editorNote: For the friend putting the World Cup jersey away and bracing to be a functioning adult again tomorrow
variations: Jersey to the back, dress shirts to the front — that's the whole quiet ritual of summer ending.
What you're putting away isn't a jersey. It's the you who threw everything into something you loved.

items.sourceNote: 決賽門將撲救 11 次仍輸球 拚盡全力仍敗;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽那個輸球的門將，撲了十一球，是史上最多。
他一個人擋下整晚的攻勢，撐到延長賽，
最後還是被一顆球攻破，跪在草皮上。
有時候你已經做到最好，甚至超出所有人的預期，
結果還是輸了。
但沒有人會記得你輸，大家記得的是你撐了那麼久、擋了那麼多。
盡力到這種程度，本身就已經贏了一種東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拚盡全力、結果還是沒成功、正在自責的朋友
variations: 撲十一球還是輸，但那十一球沒有一球是白費的。
有些失敗，比很多人的成功更讓人肅然起敬。

en.content:
The keeper who lost the final made eleven saves — the most ever.
He held off an entire night of attacks on his own, dragged it into extra time,
and still got beaten by one shot, dropping to his knees on the grass.
Sometimes you do everything right, even more than anyone expected,
and you still lose.
But nobody remembers the loss — they remember how long you held, how much you stopped.
Giving everything to that degree is already winning at something.
en.editorNote: For the friend who gave it everything, came up short anyway, and is being hard on themselves
variations: Eleven saves and still a loss — but not one of those eleven was wasted.
Some defeats command more respect than a lot of people's wins.

items.sourceNote: 決賽場上梅西對亞馬爾說「照著我的路走，未來屬於你們這一代」，2007 年梅西幫嬰兒亞馬爾洗澡的照片形成完整循環;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
十九年前，梅西幫一個嬰兒洗過澡。
那個嬰兒，就是決賽場上跟他對位、把他晃過的那個十九歲。
終場哨響，老的那個抱住新的那個，在他耳邊說：
「照著我的路走，未來是你們的。」
真正厲害的人，不是死守著位子不放，
是知道什麼時候，把接力棒交到對的人手裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在交接工作、或準備把某個舞台讓給後輩的人
variations: 冠軍會換人拿，但那句「未來是你們的」，比獎牌還重。
他輸了決賽，卻贏了一件更難的事：優雅地把時代交出去。

en.content:
Nineteen years ago, Messi gave a baby a bath.
That baby grew into the nineteen-year-old who lined up against him in the final and dribbled right past.
When the whistle blew, the old one held the new one and said into his ear:
"Keep going my way — the future belongs to your generation."
The truly great ones don't cling to the seat.
They know exactly when to hand the baton to the right person.
en.editorNote: For anyone handing off a project, or making room on the stage for whoever comes next
variations: The trophy changes hands, but 'the future is yours' outweighs any medal.
He lost the final and won something harder: passing the era on with grace.

items.sourceNote: 戒斷世界盃的解方之一：找下一個期待，2027 女足世界盃在巴西登場;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束後那種空，不是因為沒球看，
是因為突然沒有一件事，讓你願意熬夜等它。
心理師說，戒斷最快的解方，是趕快找下一個期待。
好消息是：明年女足世界盃在巴西。
人活著要有一個「還在前面等你」的東西，
不然日子會過得像沒設鬧鐘的凌晨，醒著，卻不知道為了什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽事結束後突然覺得生活很空、不知道接下來要期待什麼的朋友
variations: 治療空虛最好的藥，是行事曆上還有一件讓你興奮的事。
球賽會結束，但只要還有下一個值得熬夜的，就還撐得住。

en.content:
That emptiness after the World Cup isn't about having no games left.
It's suddenly having nothing you'd stay up all night waiting for.
Therapists say the fastest cure for the withdrawal is to line up the next thing to look forward to.
Good news: the Women's World Cup is in Brazil next year.
A person needs one thing that's still 'up ahead, waiting for you' —
otherwise the days feel like a 3 AM with no alarm set: awake, but not sure what for.
en.editorNote: For the friend who feels weirdly hollow now that it's over and doesn't know what to look forward to next
variations: The best cure for empty is one thing on the calendar you're still excited about.
The tournament ends, but as long as there's a next thing worth staying up for, you're fine.

items.sourceNote: 戒斷世界盃的解方之二：重看經典賽事（墨西哥對英格蘭、決賽等），即使已知結果;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
戒斷太痛，我又把那場經典重看了一遍。
奇怪的是，我明明知道最後誰進球、誰跪在草皮上，
看到那一刻，心臟還是照樣揪一下。
原來那晚的快樂，從來不是因為不知道結局。
是因為那九十分鐘，你把整顆心都放進去了。
有些東西重看一百遍還是會心動，那就代表它是真的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽事結束後，半夜偷偷把舊比賽重播出來看的球迷
variations: 已經知道結局還是看得屏住呼吸，這種東西一輩子沒幾樣。
重看不是為了懸念，是為了再感受一次當時那個投入的自己。

en.content:
The withdrawal got bad, so I rewatched that classic match again.
The strange part: I already know who scores, who ends up on their knees in the grass —
and my chest still tightens at the exact same moment.
Turns out the joy that night was never about not knowing the ending.
It was that for ninety minutes, you put your whole heart in.
Some things still move you on the hundredth watch. That's how you know they were real.
en.editorNote: For the fan quietly cueing up an old match at midnight now that it's all over
variations: Holding your breath at a result you already know — you don't get many things like that in a life.
A rewatch isn't about suspense. It's feeling that all-in version of yourself one more time.

items.sourceNote: 本屆結束後 這個熬夜的夏天將成為多年後回憶的一段;改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
很多年以後，你大概不會記得每一場的比分，
不會記得誰點球、誰吃紅牌。
但你會記得那個夏天，你為了一支不是自己國家的隊，凌晨三點爬起來，
記得那個一起熬夜、一起大叫、隔天頂著黑眼圈上班的人。
真正留下來的從來不是結果，
是那段「我們一起瘋過」的時間。
這個夏天，已經被你收進以後想起會笑的那一格了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個陪你熬過整個世界盃夏天的人，當作賽季結束的收尾
variations: 比分會忘，但「那年夏天我們一起熬夜」不會。
多年後想起這個夏天，你記得的不是誰贏，是身邊那個一起沒睡的人。

en.content:
Years from now, you probably won't remember every score,
who took the penalty, who saw red.
But you'll remember the summer you got up at 3 AM for a team that wasn't even yours,
and the person who stayed up with you, yelled with you, showed up to work with the same dark circles.
What actually stays was never the result.
It's the stretch of time when 'we went a little crazy together.'
This summer just got filed into the drawer of memories that make you smile later.
en.editorNote: Send to whoever stayed up through the whole World Cup summer with you — a little end-of-season sign-off
variations: You'll forget the scores. You won't forget 'that summer we stayed up together.'
Years later, what you remember isn't who won — it's the person who lost sleep beside you.

items.sourceNote: 「世界盃寡婦」football widow 現象；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃這一個月，我朋友自稱「世界盃寡婦」。
她說老公人在客廳，靈魂卻在球場，
喊得比賽誰進球都比喊她名字大聲。
我勸她：與其在旁邊生氣，不如坐下來跟他一起罵裁判。
感情能不能撐過世界盃，看的不是誰讓步，
是那個熬夜的人，願不願意在你睏的時候，把音量轉小一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一到世界盃就變單身、被另一半晾在旁邊的朋友
variations: 世界盃寡婦的自救法：打不過就加入，一起熬夜一起罵。
真正的體貼不是不看球，是你睡著時他默默把聲音關小。

en.content:
For this one month, my friend calls herself a World Cup widow.
Her husband's body is on the couch, but his soul is on the pitch —
he shouts louder at a goal than he's ever shouted her name.
I told her: instead of sulking beside him, sit down and boo the ref together.
Whether a relationship survives the World Cup isn't about who gives in.
It's whether the one staying up will turn the volume down a notch when you're finally sleepy.
en.editorNote: For the friend who goes 'single' every World Cup, left on the couch while their partner watches
variations: World Cup widow survival tip: if you can't beat them, join them — stay up and heckle together.
Real thoughtfulness isn't skipping the match. It's quietly turning the sound down once you've fallen asleep.

items.sourceNote: Panini 2026 貼紙冊 980 格、重複抽到、以物易物；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
今年的球星貼紙冊有九百八十格，據說是史上最厚一本。
我興沖沖買了一堆包來拆，結果拆出第七張一模一樣的門將。
整本就差最後一格，那一格偏偏全世界都缺。
收集的殘忍在這裡：你離完成只差一步，
但那一步，得靠運氣、靠交換、靠一個願意把手上多的那張讓給你的人。
有些空格，不是花錢就補得起來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個貼紙冊只差一張、逢人就問「你有沒有多的」的收集狂
variations: 拆貼紙包的世界盃哲學：重複的越拆越多，想要的永遠差那一張。
整本就缺一格——原來完整這件事，最後都卡在同一個地方。

en.content:
This year's sticker album has nine hundred and eighty slots — reportedly the fattest one ever.
I tore into a stack of packs and pulled the same goalkeeper for the seventh time.
The whole book is one slot from done, and of course that's the one nobody in the world can find.
Here's the cruelty of collecting: you're a single step from finished,
but that step comes down to luck, to trading, to someone willing to hand you their spare.
Some empty slots you just can't fill with money.
en.editorNote: For the collector who's one sticker short and asks everyone they meet 'got any doubles?'
variations: The World Cup wisdom of ripping packs: the ones you have keep multiplying, the one you want never shows.
One slot from complete — turns out 'finished' always jams at the exact same spot.

items.sourceNote: 台灣從未打進世界盃、只能當中立球迷選一隊；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
台灣從來沒打進過世界盃。
所以我們沒有一定要贏的隊，只有自己挑來愛的隊。
有人選球衣好看的，有人選前男友討厭的隊的對手，
我選的那隊，只因為十六強那晚它踢得像不要命。
沒有國家隊的球迷，其實擁有一種自由：
你愛上一支隊，純粹因為它打動你，跟血統、跟護照，一點關係都沒有。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每屆世界盃都要重新「選妃」、挑一支隊來愛的無隊球迷
variations: 沒進世界盃的好處：全世界的隊都可以是你的隊。
我們愛一支隊的理由很單純——它打動了你，不是因為它掛你的國旗。

en.content:
Taiwan has never made it to the World Cup.
So we don't have a team we're bound to root for — only ones we pick and fall for ourselves.
Some choose by the prettiest kit, some root against an ex's favorite team,
and mine? I picked it because one round-of-16 night it played like it had nothing to lose.
Fans without a national team actually get a kind of freedom:
you love a team purely because it moves you — nothing to do with bloodline or passport.
en.editorNote: For the team-less fan who has to 'pick a bride' every World Cup and adopt someone to cheer for
variations: The upside of never qualifying: every team in the world can be your team.
We love a team for the simplest reason — it moved you, not because it flies your flag.

items.sourceNote: 偽球迷跟風、臨時惡補球員名字融入話題；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
老實說，四年前我連越位是什麼都不懂。
世界盃一開打，我連夜惡補三個球員的名字，就為了在群組聊天不落隊。
有人笑偽球迷跟風，我倒覺得沒什麼好丟臉——
這世界願意為一件事臨時抱佛腳、想跟大家一起熱血的人，已經不多了。
真球迷、偽球迷，那晚一起在客廳大叫的時候，其實沒有差。
熱鬧本來就是留給願意加入的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃才臨時惡補、被朋友笑「偽球迷」的跟風夥伴
variations: 偽球迷的自白：規則我不太懂，但那份想一起熱血的心是真的。
真球迷偽球迷，進球那一刻叫得一樣大聲，就沒有分別了。

en.content:
Honestly, four years ago I didn't even know what offside meant.
The moment the World Cup started, I crammed three players' names overnight just to keep up in the group chat.
People mock bandwagon fans, but I don't think there's much to be ashamed of —
not many people are willing to cram for something just to feel the buzz alongside everyone else.
