Real fan, fake fan — the night we're all screaming in the living room, there's no difference.
The fun was always reserved for the ones willing to join in.
en.editorNote: For the bandwagon buddy who crammed at the last minute and got called a 'fake fan' by friends
variations: Confession of a fake fan: I don't really get the rules, but wanting in on the buzz is real.
Real fan, fake fan — the second the goal goes in, we scream just as loud. That's the whole difference gone.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃四年一次、要等下一屆的漫長；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束的隔天，有人問我下一屆什麼時候。
我算了算：四年。
四年後我又老了四歲，那些熬夜的球星可能已經退役，
今天陪我看球的人，也不知道還在不在身邊。
世界盃教會我的，其實不是足球，
是有些相聚四年才一次，所以每一次一起熬的夜，都別嫌它累。
下次哨聲響起前，好好把人生過成值得再熬一次的樣子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個世界盃一結束就開始倒數下一屆、捨不得結束的球迷
variations: 四年一次的提醒：能一起熬夜看球的人，別等到下一屆才珍惜。
世界盃真正教的不是足球，是四年才一次的東西，要用力記得。

en.content:
The day after the World Cup ended, someone asked me when the next one is.
I did the math: four years.
Four years older, and by then some of those stars I stayed up for may have retired,
and the person who watched with me tonight — who knows if they'll still be around.
What the World Cup really taught me wasn't football.
It's that some reunions come only once every four years, so never resent a single night you stayed up together.
Before the next whistle blows, live a life worth losing sleep over all over again.
en.editorNote: For the fan who starts counting down to the next tournament the second this one ends, hating to let go
variations: A once-every-four-years reminder: don't wait until the next tournament to treasure the people you stay up with.
The World Cup's real lesson isn't football — it's that what comes only once every four years, you hold onto hard.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃決賽後約一個月各大聯賽新球季開打；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束的那天，我以為足球就這樣關機了。
結果查了一下才發現，新球季八月就開打，中間只隔一個月。
一個月，剛好夠我把睡眠債還一還、把作息調回來，
然後再心甘情願地走回同一個坑。
原來空虛是有期限的，這大概是我這幾天聽到最好的消息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給世界盃一結束就覺得生活失去重心、需要一個新倒數的球迷
variations: 空虛也是有保存期限的——新球季八月見。
世界盃關機不代表足球關機，這只是一個月的中場休息。

en.content:
The day the World Cup ended, I figured football had powered off for good.
Then I looked it up: the new club season kicks off in August, about a month away.
A month is exactly enough time to pay back the sleep debt, get my body clock straight,
and then walk right back into the same hole on purpose.
Turns out the emptiness has an expiry date. Best news I've heard all week.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose whole routine collapsed when the tournament ended and who needs a new countdown
variations: Turns out the emptiness has a shelf life — club football is back in August.
The World Cup shutting down isn't football shutting down. It's a one-month halftime.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後球迷如何填補空窗、聯賽同樣有半夜場次；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
我還在跟家人保證：世界盃結束了，我以後一定早睡。
然後轉頭默默打開新球季的賽程表，
發現有些場次，照樣排在台灣的半夜。
原來這一個月我練出來的不是體力，是藉口。
熬夜從來不會結束，它只是換一件球衣，再來找你一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給嘴上說要早睡、手指卻已經在查下一場開賽時間的人
variations: 我戒掉的不是熬夜，只是世界盃這個藉口。
世界盃會結束，半夜開賽的比賽不會。

en.content:
I keep promising everyone that now the World Cup is over, I'll be in bed by eleven.
Then I quietly pull up the new season's fixture list
and find plenty of kickoffs still landing in the middle of the night my time.
So what I actually built up this past month wasn't stamina. It was excuses.
Staying up never ends. It just changes shirts and comes back for you.
en.editorNote: For the person swearing they'll sleep early while already checking the next kickoff time
variations: I didn't quit late nights. I just lost the World Cup as my excuse.
The World Cup ends. Games that start at 3AM are forever.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃球星賽後各自歸隊、新球季重新登場；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這個夏天，我記住了六個六月時完全唸不出來的名字。
終場哨一響，他們就散回世界各地的球會，換上我不熟的球衣。
於是我做了一件有點傻的事：把六個名字抄進備忘錄，
打算新球季開打之後，一個一個把他們找回來。
世界盃真正留給球迷的從來不是冠軍，是一份可以追很久的名單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給在世界盃期間對某個球員一見鍾情、想繼續追下去的新球迷
variations: 世界盃留給我的不是冠軍，是一張可以追四年的名單。
夏天記住的名字，秋天要在別的球衣上一個一個找回來。

en.content:
This summer I learned six names I couldn't have pronounced in June.
The second the final whistle went, they scattered back to clubs across the world, into shirts I don't know.
So I did something faintly ridiculous: I typed all six into my notes app,
planning to hunt them down one by one once the new season starts.
What the World Cup really leaves a fan isn't a champion. It's a list you can follow for years.
en.editorNote: For the new fan who fell for one player mid-tournament and wants to keep watching him
variations: The World Cup didn't leave me a champion. It left me a list I can follow for four years.
The names you memorize in summer, you go find in other shirts by autumn.

items.sourceNote: 本屆世界盃獎金創新高、冠軍隊約可分得五千一百萬美元；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
新聞說這屆的冠軍獎金創了新高，五千一百萬美金。
我也算了一下自己這個夏天的收穫：
兩個黑眼圈、一件大概穿不到四次的球衣，還有一整串群組吵架紀錄。
帳面上我輸得很徹底，
但如果要我再熬一次，我大概還是會把鬧鐘設在兩點五十。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給熬完一整屆、被家人問「這樣到底值不值得」的球迷自嘲用
variations: 冠軍拿走五千一百萬，我拿走一個夏天的黑眼圈，我們都覺得值得。
認真算 CP 值的話熬夜完全不划算，但我下次還是會乖乖設鬧鐘。

en.content:
The reports say this tournament's winners' payout was the biggest ever: 51 million dollars.
So I added up what I got out of the exact same summer:
two dark circles, a shirt I'll wear maybe four times, and a group chat full of arguments.
On paper I lost badly.
Ask me to do it again and I'd still set the alarm for 2:50AM.
en.editorNote: Self-deprecating line for the fan who survived the whole tournament and got asked if it was worth it
variations: They took home 51 million, I took home a summer of dark circles, and we both think we came out ahead.
The math on staying up is terrible. I'm setting the alarm again anyway.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後的失落感與作息回歸；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束後的第一個週末，我一路睡到中午。
沒有鬧鐘，沒有補時，沒有任何人在螢幕裡奔跑。
睡飽的感覺很好，好到有點空。
我這才發現，撐著我過完這一個月的從來不是睡眠，
是每天都有一件事，值得我少睡兩個小時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給世界盃結束後終於睡飽、卻莫名有點失落的人
variations: 睡飽很好，只是再也沒有什麼值得我晚睡了。
撐住那一個月的不是睡眠，是每天都有件事值得少睡兩小時。

en.content:
First weekend after the World Cup, I slept clean through to noon.
No alarm, no stoppage time, nobody running around inside a screen.
Sleeping in felt great. Great in a strangely hollow way.
That's when it hit me: what carried me through the past month was never sleep.
It was having something, every single day, worth losing two hours over.
en.editorNote: For the person who finally caught up on sleep after the tournament and felt oddly flat about it
variations: Being fully rested is nice. There's just nothing worth staying up for anymore.
What got me through that month wasn't sleep — it was having something worth losing two hours over.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後球迷回望熬夜作息、失去日常儀式感的空窗期；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃那一個月，我幾乎每晚兩點四十都出現在巷口那間超商。
一罐提神飲料、一包餅乾，偶爾加一顆茶葉蛋。
大夜班的店員從來沒問我要去哪，只有一次抬頭說：「今天幾點開始？」
昨天下午我經過，他在補貨，看了我一眼，沒有認出我。
這個夏天最清楚我在熬什麼的人，連我的名字都不知道。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給那些熬夜被陌生人默默看在眼裡、卻連名字都沒交換過的緣分
variations: 凌晨兩點四十的超商，是那一個月我唯一準時報到的地方。
他不知道我支持哪一隊，卻比誰都清楚我那個月幾點沒睡。

en.content:
For that one month, I showed up at the corner store at 2:40AM almost every night.
One energy drink, one bag of chips, sometimes an egg from the counter.
The overnight clerk never asked where I was going. Once he just looked up and said, "What time's kickoff?"
I walked past yesterday afternoon. He was restocking shelves, glanced at me, and didn't recognize me.
The person who knew exactly what I was staying up for never learned my name.
en.editorNote: For the quiet bond with a stranger who witnessed all your late nights without ever knowing you
variations: That 2:40AM corner store was the one place I was never late for all month.
He had no idea which team I backed, but he knew exactly which nights I didn't sleep.

items.sourceNote: 報導指世界盃帶動大量串流訂閱，賽後退訂潮受關注，部分觀眾決賽後立刻取消、部分再留兩三個月；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
為了世界盃訂的那個轉播方案，昨天寄來了續訂提醒。
新聞說有人一看完決賽就馬上退訂，也有人打算再留兩三個月。
我把游標移到「取消訂閱」上面，停了大概三十秒。
按下去，這個夏天就真的關帳了；不按，我等於在為一件已經沒有的事付錢。
最後我沒按——就當是這個夏天的房租，我想再多繳一期。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給世界盃結束後，手指停在退訂按鈕上遲遲按不下去的人
variations: 比賽七月十九號就結束了，我的世界盃結束在按下退訂的那一天。
多繳一期訂閱費，就當是這個夏天的房租。

en.content:
The streaming plan I signed up for just to watch the World Cup sent me a renewal notice.
Apparently some people cancelled the second the final whistle blew; others are keeping it a couple more months.
I held the cursor over "Cancel subscription" for about thirty seconds.
Click it and the summer is officially closed. Don't click it and I'm paying for something that no longer exists.
I didn't click. Call it one more month of rent on a summer I'm not ready to move out of.
en.editorNote: For anyone hovering over the cancel button after the tournament and refusing to press it
variations: The tournament ended on July 19. My World Cup ends the day I hit cancel.
One more billing cycle. Call it rent on a summer I'm not done with.

items.sourceNote: 本屆為四十八隊、一百零四場的新賽制，賽後各項紀錄與賽果已整理成表；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
剛剛無聊，點開了這屆的賽程總表。
一百零四場、一整個夏天，被收成一頁乾乾淨淨的表格：
日期、球隊、比分，一格一格對齊。
我從第一場滑到最後一場，花不到二十秒。
表格上沒有一欄寫著我那晚幾點睡、為誰喊到破音，
也沒有一格記得我從沙發上站起來的那幾次。
被存進歷史的是比分，留在我身上的是別的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 給賽後翻開賽程表、發現一整頁數字裝不下自己那一個月的人
variations: 一整個夏天，一百零四場，滑完不到二十秒。
歷史記住的是比分，我記住的是那些比分沒寫進去的部分。

en.content:
Got bored just now and pulled up the full fixture list for this tournament.
One hundred and four matches, an entire summer, folded into one tidy table:
date, teams, score, every cell neatly aligned.
I scrolled from the first match to the last in under twenty seconds.
There's no column for what time I got to bed, or whose name I shouted my voice out over,
and no cell that remembers the times I shot up off the couch.
What got filed into history was the scores. What stayed with me was something else.
en.editorNote: For the fan who opened the results table afterwards and found a page of numbers can't hold their month
variations: A whole summer, 104 matches, scrolled through in under twenty seconds.
History kept the scores. I kept everything the scores left out.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後歐洲轉會市場進入高潮，體育版話題從比賽轉向身價；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束沒幾天，體育版就換了一整批標題。
上個月大家在算誰跑了幾公里，這個月全在算誰值幾千萬。
那個讓我凌晨三點從沙發上跳起來的名字，
現在被印在轉會傳聞裡，後面接著一串我唸不完的數字。
球員從一份工作直接轉場到下一份，
只有我還停在原地，把那顆球重播了第八次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完世界盃、現在每天刷轉會新聞的朋友
variations: 熱血退場，價碼進場。體育版換季，換得比天氣還快。
我還在想那顆球有多美，市場已經在想那雙腳值多少錢。

en.content:
Days after the final, the sports pages swapped out every headline.
Last month we were counting how many kilometers he covered. This month it's how many millions he's worth.
The name that had me off the couch at 3 AM
now sits inside a transfer rumor, trailed by a number I can't say out loud.
The players clocked out of one job and straight into the next.
I'm the only one still parked here, replaying that goal for the eighth time.
en.editorNote: For the friend who finished the World Cup and now refreshes transfer news every morning
variations: The passion clocked out, the price tag clocked in. Sports pages change season faster than the weather.
I'm still thinking about how beautiful that goal was. The market is already thinking about the fee.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後球星陸續回球會展開季前備戰，假期極短；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
查了才知道，有些球星已經回球會報到，開始跑季前訓練了。
哨聲響完沒幾天，人家的假期就到期。
我這邊還在還睡眠債，鬧鐘設了又關，白天走路像沒插電。
看球的比踢球的還累，講出去大概沒人信。
但只有我們這種人懂——
那不是累，是還捨不得從那個夏天下班。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上說要早睡、身體卻還沒調回來的看球夥伴
variations: 球員都回去上工了，只有我還在放世界盃的補假。
他們一個月踢幾場，我一個月熬幾十夜，很難說誰比較猛。

en.content:
Looked it up: some of them are already back at their clubs, running preseason drills.
The whistle blew days ago and their holiday is over.
Meanwhile I'm still paying off sleep debt, setting alarms and killing them, walking around unplugged.
The people watching came out more wrecked than the people playing. Nobody would believe that.
But we know what it actually is.
Not exhaustion. Just not being ready to clock out of that summer.
en.editorNote: For the friend who swore they'd go to bed early and whose body hasn't gotten the memo
variations: The players are back at work. I'm the only one still on World Cup leave.
They played a handful of matches in a month. I stayed up for dozens of nights. Call it a draw.

items.sourceNote: 本屆賽事高溫下的補水暫停成為討論焦點；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
這屆天氣熱，比賽中間常常停下來讓球員補水。
那短短一分多鐘，是我整場唯一敢離開沙發的時間——
衝廁所、開冰箱、順手把宵夜的空盒收一收，再滑回原位。
現在沒有球看了，我一整個晚上都可以自由走動，
卻反而不知道要走去哪。
原來被一場比賽切成好幾段的夜晚，比完整的夜晚還好過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次補水暫停都要用跑的衝廁所的看球夥伴
variations: 補水暫停不是給球員的，是給我這種已經憋了半小時的球迷的。
以前的夜晚有中場、有補水暫停；現在整晚一片空白，反而不知道怎麼分配。

en.content:
It ran hot this tournament, so matches kept stopping to let players drink.
That one short minute was the only window I trusted to leave the couch —
sprint to the bathroom, raid the fridge, clear the midnight-snack boxes, slide back into my spot.
Now there's nothing on and I can get up whenever I like,
and somehow there's nowhere to go.
Turns out a night chopped into segments was easier to get through than a whole empty one.
en.editorNote: For the watch-buddy who sprinted to the bathroom every single water break
variations: That water break was never for the players. It was for the fan who'd been holding it for half an hour.
Nights used to come with a halftime and a water break. Now it's one blank stretch and I don't know how to spend it.

items.sourceNote: 賽事提供罕見的全球共同體驗，結束後共同話題消失；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
上個月，全世界像是同時打開了同一個頻道。
電梯裡、計程車上、剪頭髮的時候，一句「昨晚有看嗎」就能撐十分鐘。
現在同一句話問出去，只換來一個禮貌的笑。
大家的手機又滑回各自的世界，演算法各推各的。
我最想念的，其實不是比賽本身，
是那一個月，連對陌生人都有話可以說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個懷念「全世界都在看同一件事」的朋友
variations: 共同話題只租給我們一個月，到期就自動收回。
世界盃最難得的不是冠軍，是那句連陌生人都接得下去的『昨晚有看嗎』。

en.content:
For one month, the whole planet had the same channel open.
In the elevator, in a cab, in the barber's chair — "did you catch it last night?" bought you ten easy minutes.
Ask that today and you get a polite smile.
Everyone has scrolled back into their own feed, each algorithm serving its own thing.
What I miss isn't really the football.
It's the month where I had something to say to strangers.
en.editorNote: For the friend who misses when the entire world was watching one thing at once
variations: We only rented that shared conversation for a month, and the lease just ran out.
The rarest thing the tournament gave us wasn't a champion. It was a question any stranger could answer.

items.sourceNote: 賽後戒斷建議之一是玩足球電玩或重看比賽；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
戒斷到第幾天我也數不清了，昨晚我打開足球遊戲，自己重開了一屆世界盃。
選了那支我陪到最後的隊，一路推進決賽，親手把那顆沒進的球補了進去。
螢幕上煙火放完，我坐在椅子上，突然覺得有點好笑。
贏是贏了，可是旁邊沒有人跟我一起吼，
也沒有隔天頂著黑眼圈上班的代價。
那個夏天最好玩的部分，遊戲根本模擬不出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個買了足球遊戲想安慰自己、結果玩完更空虛的朋友
variations: 遊戲裡我想贏幾次就贏幾次，就是少了凌晨三點心臟快跳出來的那種感覺。
能重來的比賽都不夠刺激，因為真正的那一場，一輩子只播一次。

en.content:
I've lost count of what day of withdrawal this is. Last night I booted up a football game and ran my own World Cup.
Picked the team I'd stayed up for all summer, dragged them to the final, and scored the goal that never went in.
The fireworks played, I sat there, and it struck me as slightly funny.
I won, sure. But nobody was yelling beside me,
and there was no black-eyed morning to pay for it.
The best part of that summer is the exact part a game can't render.
en.editorNote: For the friend who bought a football game to fill the gap and felt emptier afterwards
variations: In the game I can win as often as I like. It just never makes my heart try to leave my chest at 3 AM.
A match you can replay isn't the same thrill. The real one only ever airs once.

items.sourceNote: 賽後情緒宿醉報導；以囤貨剩貨為題自行原創

zh-tw.content:
六月開賽前，我在賣場扛了一箱提神飲料回家，二十四罐，當時覺得剛剛好。
昨天整理櫃子，翻出剩下的十一罐，效期到明年三月。
我算了一下：一整個夏天，我喝掉十三個凌晨。
剩下的這十一罐現在完全沒有用途，白天喝，晚上就換它不讓我睡。
它們安安靜靜地擺在那裡，像十一個沒有比賽可以配的夜晚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了看球囤貨、現在對著一堆剩貨發呆的朋友
variations: 效期還有七個月，可是我熬夜的理由，上個月就過期了。
囤的時候怕不夠，現在才知道，不夠的從來不是飲料。

en.content:
Before it all kicked off in June, I hauled a case of energy drinks home from the store. Twenty-four cans. Felt about right at the time.
Cleaning out the cabinet yesterday, I found eleven still in there, good until next March.
So I did the math: one whole summer, thirteen 3 AMs.
The other eleven have no job now. Drink one in the daytime and it just keeps you up for nothing.
They sit there quietly, like eleven nights with no match to go with them.
en.editorNote: For the friend who stocked up for the tournament and is now staring at the leftovers
variations: Seven months left on the expiry date. My reason to stay up expired last month.
I stocked up scared of running short. Turns out the thing running short was never the drinks.

items.sourceNote: 賽後空窗期報導；以影音推薦演算法為題自行原創

zh-tw.content:
世界盃那個月，我一打開影音 App，首頁整排都是十大進球、賽後訪問、慢動作重播。
這幾天它推的越來越少，昨天甚至冒出一支教人煎荷包蛋的影片。
連演算法都判定我不看球了。
它其實沒有錯——我確實已經三天沒有搜尋任何一支球隊。
只是被系統這樣默默翻篇，我才第一次那麼具體地感覺到：真的結束了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個發現首頁不再推球賽、突然有點失落的朋友
variations: 我還沒準備好，首頁已經先幫我把那個夏天下架了。
演算法忘記你的速度，永遠比你自己快。

en.content:
For that one month, every time I opened the video app the front page was nothing but top-ten goals, post-match interviews, slow-mo replays.
The last few days it's been serving me less and less, and yesterday a how-to-fry-an-egg video showed up.
Even the algorithm has decided I'm done with football.
It isn't wrong. I haven't typed a single team name into a search bar in three days.
But getting quietly moved on by a recommendation feed is the first time it's felt real that the thing is over.
en.editorNote: For the friend who noticed the feed stopped serving highlights and felt weirdly hollow
variations: I wasn't ready yet, and my homepage had already taken that summer down.
An algorithm always forgets you faster than you forget yourself.

items.sourceNote: 報導提到賽事創造共同的日常節奏；改寫為鄰居視角原創

zh-tw.content:
那一個月的凌晨，我常常聽見隔壁棟傳來一聲吼。
不用看比分我也知道：有人進球了，而且那顆球對他很重要。
我不知道他是誰、住幾樓，連他長什麼樣子都沒看過。
但每次那聲吼穿過來，我就知道這一區不是只有我還醒著。
現在半夜只剩冷氣運轉的聲音。
我最想念的其實不是比賽，是那個素未謀面、卻跟我同時醒著的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個隔著一道牆、跟陌生人一起熬完整個夏天的朋友
variations: 我們從來沒說過話，卻一起熬了整個夏天的夜。
那聲吼比任何推播都快：不用看螢幕，我就知道進球了。

en.content:
For that one month, most nights I'd hear a roar come out of the building next door.
I never had to check the score. Somebody scored, and it clearly mattered to him.
I don't know who he is, what floor he's on, never once saw his face.
But every time that shout carried over, I knew I wasn't the only one on this block still awake.
Now the loudest thing at 3 AM is the air conditioner.
What I miss isn't really the football. It's the stranger who happened to be awake at the same hour as me.
en.editorNote: For the friend who spent a summer watching alongside a neighbor they never met
variations: We never exchanged a word, and we stayed up through an entire summer together.
That shout beat every notification. I didn't need the screen to know it went in.

items.sourceNote: 賽後回歸日常的報導；以看球裝備分期付款為題自行原創

zh-tw.content:
開賽前一週，我把家裡看了八年的電視換掉，刷了十二期。
理由很正當：這麼大的賽事，畫面不能糊。
現在比賽打完了，帳單還有九期。
那台大螢幕現在每天播的是新聞跟三十秒短影音，大材小用得有點好笑。
可是每次開機那一瞬間，我還是會想起六月的某個晚上，
一群人擠在客廳，為一個離我們很遠的國家鬼吼鬼叫。
九期而已，我覺得划算。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了世界盃升級裝備、現在還在繳分期的朋友
variations: 電視是分期買的，那個夏天倒是一次付清。
帳單提醒我還要繳九個月，也順便提醒我，那個夏天真的存在過。

en.content:
A week before kickoff I replaced the TV we'd had for eight years. Twelve monthly payments.
The logic was airtight: an event that big, you can't watch it blurry.
The tournament's done and there are nine payments left.
These days that enormous screen shows the news and thirty-second clips, which is a little ridiculous.
But every time it powers on, I think about that night in June,
a bunch of us crammed into the living room, screaming for a country nowhere near us.
Nine more payments. Still a bargain.
en.editorNote: For the friend who upgraded the setup for the World Cup and is still paying it off
variations: The TV came in installments. That summer I got in one go.
The billing reminder says nine months to go. It also reminds me that summer really happened.

items.sourceNote: 賽後生活回歸日常的報導；以開賽前的辦公室賭注為題自行原創

zh-tw.content:
六月開賽前，我跟同事賭了一杯手搖，賭誰能捧盃。
他押地主隊，我押一支我其實叫不出幾個球員的隊，兩個人都講得很有把握。
結果冠軍不是他選的，也不是我選的。
那杯飲料到現在沒有人提起，
因為一提，就等於承認那個吵得很開心的夏天已經收攤了。
有些賭注本來就不是為了贏，
是為了讓兩個人有理由，多聊三十天的球。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽前跟你亂賭一通、賭注到現在還沒兌現的同事
variations: 最後輸的是我們兩個，因為冠軍誰都沒猜中。
那杯飲料一直欠著，欠著欠著就變成一種紀念品。

en.content:
Before the tournament started in June, a coworker and I bet a bubble tea on who'd lift the trophy.
He took a host nation. I took a team whose players I couldn't name. Both of us sounded very sure.
The champion turned out to be neither.
Neither of us has mentioned the drink since,
because mentioning it means admitting that loud, happy summer has closed up shop.
Some bets were never about winning.
They just gave two people a reason to talk football for thirty straight days.
en.editorNote: For the coworker you made a reckless June bet with and never settled up
variations: We both lost, since neither of us called it right.
That drink is still owed. At this point the debt is basically a souvenir.

items.sourceNote: 決賽場地賽後移除為世界盃鋪設的真草皮、換回人工草供美式足球球季使用；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽那座球場在紐澤西，為了世界盃特地鋪上一整片真草皮。
哨聲響完沒幾天，草皮就被一塊一塊搬走，場地要還給秋天的美式足球球季。
七月十九號那個晚上，全世界不知道有幾億人盯著那塊草，
現在它已經不在那裡了。
最盛大的東西，往往拆得最快。
留得比較久的，反而是我在自己家客廳記住的那幾分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配決賽場地的照片，或寫在整理夏天回憶的貼文裡
variations: 草皮可以搬走，那個凌晨我從沙發上跳起來的樣子搬不走。
球場換回它原本的用途，我也差不多該換回原本的作息了。

en.content:
The final was played in New Jersey, on real grass laid down just for the World Cup.
Days after the whistle, that grass was hauled out tray by tray. The field goes back to football in the fall.
On July 19, hundreds of millions of people were staring at that patch of green.
Now it isn't there anymore.
The biggest things get dismantled the fastest.
What lasts longer is the few minutes I remember from my own living room.
en.editorNote: Pairs with a photo of the final, or a post looking back on the summer
variations: You can roll up the grass. You can't roll up the way I jumped off that couch.
The stadium got its old job back. I should probably get my old sleep schedule back.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙全屆八場只失一球，創下冠軍隊最少失球紀錄；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
翻資料才發現，西班牙這屆八場球只丟了一球，是歷屆冠軍裡失球最少的。
八場、一整個夏天，對手只攻破他們一次。
我看著這個數字，順手算了一下自己：
熬了三十幾個凌晨，被生活攻破的次數大概是它的三十倍。
但守得住從來不是因為沒人來攻，
是因為每次球逼到面前，你都還願意站在那裡，不往後退。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在工作硬撐期發，把防守紀錄借來當自我打氣
variations: 一整屆只丟一球，靠的不是運氣，是八場都沒有鬆掉的那口氣。
我這個夏天守得沒有他們好，但至少每一場我都有站上場。

en.content:
Looked it up: Spain conceded exactly one goal in eight matches, the fewest ever by a World Cup winner.
Eight games, a whole summer, and opponents got through them once.
I stared at that number and did the math on myself:
thirty-odd nights awake, and life got through me maybe thirty times more often.
Holding the line was never about nobody attacking.
It's that every time the ball came at them, they still stood there instead of backing off.
en.editorNote: Good for a grind-week post, borrowing a defensive record as a pep talk
variations: One goal in a whole tournament isn't luck. It's eight games of never letting the breath out.
I didn't defend my summer that well, but I showed up for every match.

items.sourceNote: 賽後空窗期與球迷情緒報導；以手機行事曆的比賽提醒為題自行原創

zh-tw.content:
昨天整理手機行事曆，才發現六月設的那一整排比賽提醒還在。
凌晨兩點五十、三點、五點……一格一格，排得比我上班的行程還滿。
我一場一場往下滑，滑到七月十九號那一格，後面就空了。
本來想全部刪掉，最後手指停住，一個也沒刪。
那些現在已經不是提醒了，
是我這輩子加過最心甘情願的班，留下來的紀錄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個到現在還沒把比賽提醒刪掉的球友
variations: 刪掉只要三秒，我卻在那頁停了十分鐘。
行事曆七月十九號之後空白一片，那大概就是空虛的形狀。

en.content:
Cleaning up my phone calendar yesterday, I found the whole stack of match alerts I set back in June.
2:50 a.m., 3:00, 5:00. Block after block, fuller than my actual work schedule.
I scrolled down game by game until July 19, and after that there was nothing.
I meant to delete all of them. My thumb stopped. I deleted none.
They're not reminders anymore.
They're the log of the most willing overtime I've ever worked.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who still hasn't cleared the match alerts off their phone
variations: Deleting them takes three seconds. I sat on that screen for ten minutes.
The calendar is blank after July 19. That blank space is roughly the shape of the emptiness.

items.sourceNote: 賽後生活重回正軌相關報導；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
巷口那間熱炒店，六月掛出一條紅布條：「本店有轉播，看球免加價」。
八月了，布條還掛在那裡，被太陽曬到有點褪色。
老闆大概只是懶得拆，
但我每次經過都會抬頭看一眼——
這條街上，只剩它還記得那個夏天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟你在同一間店看過球、現在各自回去加班的朋友
variations: 最先熱鬧起來的是店家，最後一個收攤的也是。
布條褪色的速度，比大家忘記的速度慢很多。

en.content:
The place on my corner hung a banner in June: "Matches shown here, no cover charge."
It's August. The banner is still up, sun-faded at the edges.
The owner probably just hasn't gotten around to taking it down.
But I look up at it every time I walk past —
on this whole street, it's the last thing still remembering that summer.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend you watched a match with at that place, now back to working late separately
variations: The shops got loud first. They're also the last ones to pack up.
That banner is fading way slower than everyone's memory of it.

items.sourceNote: 球隊淘汰後球衣五折出清、尺寸被掃光相關報導；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
六月我用原價買下那件球衣，那時候覺得值得。
昨天經過同一間店，它躺在出清籃裡，五折，還有一整排尺寸沒人拿。
我站在那裡看了幾秒，沒有很想再買一件。
貴的從來不是那塊布，
是六月那個還相信他們會一路贏下去的我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個也在賽前衝動下單、現在假裝沒看到出清價的球迷朋友
variations: 同一件衣服，六月是信仰，八月是庫存。
我買的不是球衣，是那時候還沒被淘汰的期待。

en.content:
I paid full price for that jersey in June. It felt worth it then.
Walked past the same store yesterday — it's in the clearance bin, half off, every size still on the rack.
I stood there a few seconds. Didn't want another one.
The expensive part was never the fabric.
It was the version of me in June who still believed they'd go all the way.
en.editorNote: For the friend who also panic-bought a jersey and is now pretending not to see the sale tag
variations: Same shirt: a belief system in June, dead stock in August.
I didn't buy a jersey. I bought a hope that hadn't been knocked out yet.

items.sourceNote: 賽後球迷戒斷、集體不捨相關報導；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
六月那陣子撿到一隻貓，我腦子裡全是球，就用當時最喜歡的球員幫牠取了名字。
那名字很難唸，帶我媽去看獸醫的時候她唸了三次都不對。
比賽早就結束了，那位球員也回去踢他的聯賽了，
可是這個名字每天還要被我喊十幾次。
這個夏天最後留在我家的，不是冠軍，是一隻叫錯名字也會回頭的貓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在世界盃期間衝動幫寵物、Wi-Fi 或新盆栽取球員名字的朋友
variations: 熱血會退，名字不會。牠要跟著這個名字過完一輩子。
全家只有牠不知道，自己是以一個外國人的名字活著。

en.content:
I took in a stray cat back in June, when my brain was 100% football, so I named her after my favorite player at the time.
It's a hard name. My mom has now mispronounced it three separate times at the vet.
The tournament ended weeks ago. That player is back at his club.
But the name still gets shouted around my apartment a dozen times a day.
What this summer actually left at my place wasn't a trophy. It was a cat who comes running even when you say it wrong.
en.editorNote: For the friend who impulse-named a pet, a Wi-Fi network, or a new plant after a player in June
variations: The hype fades. The name is stuck for the next fifteen years.
She's the only one in the house who doesn't know she's living under a foreign guy's name.

items.sourceNote: 賽後作息與情緒回落相關報導；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我這禮拜六晚上有沒有空。
以前我會先說「等我查一下」，然後對著賽程表算幾點開賽、幾點能到、幾點要閃人。
這次我直接回：「都可以。」
打完那三個字，我愣了一下。
原來我懷念的不只是比賽，
還有那個「有事非趕不可」的自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個現在週末全空、卻反而不知道要幹嘛的球友
variations: 「都可以」三個字，是這個夏天結束最安靜的證據。
行程全空的自由，我拿到手才發現沒有想像中好用。

en.content:
A friend asked if I'm free Saturday night.
I used to say "let me check" — then do the math on kickoff time, travel time, when I'd have to bail.
This time I just typed: "Any time works."
Then I sat there staring at it.
Turns out what I miss isn't only the matches.
It's being the guy who had somewhere he absolutely had to be.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose weekends are wide open now and somehow worse for it
variations: "Any time works" is the quietest proof that the summer is over.
I got all my evenings back and immediately had no idea what they were for.

items.sourceNote: 球迷觀賽迷信與儀式的普遍現象；情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
六月那個月，我有一整套規矩：
一定坐沙發最左邊、杯子不能換、領先的時候不准起來上廁所。
有一場我中途去倒水，回來就被追平，從此我連腳都不太敢動。
昨天新聞重播那顆冠軍球，我人是站著看的，手上還拿著剛倒的水。
那些規矩，早就沒有用武之地了。
原來所謂迷信，只是我想替一件我完全插不上手的事，出一點力。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看球有一堆規矩、現在規矩全失業的朋友
variations: 我的那些規矩，在七月十九號那天一起退休了。
它們沒救過任何一場球，但撐住了我整整一個月的焦慮。

en.content:
All June I had a rulebook.
Far-left cushion of the couch. Never switch mugs. Nobody stands up while we're ahead.
One night I got up for water and we conceded before I sat back down, so after that I barely moved my feet.
Yesterday a replay of the winning goal came on and I watched the whole thing standing, glass in hand.
Every one of those rules is unemployed now.
Turns out superstition was just my way of trying to help with something I had zero control over.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose whole matchday ritual is suddenly out of a job
variations: My rulebook retired on July 19 along with everything else.
Those rules never saved a single match, but they carried my nerves for a month.

items.sourceNote: 下屆賽事於二〇三〇年舉行的時間差；家庭情境原創

zh-tw.content:
我姪子五歲，決賽那晚在我家沙發上睡著，整場什麼都沒看到。
前幾天他突然問我：「那個大家一直在看的球，什麼時候還會有？」
我說，四年後。
他掰著手指算，算到一半放棄，抬頭問我那時候他幾歲。
九歲。
九歲那年，會是他自己記得住的第一屆。
我忽然很想活到那個夏天，坐在同一張沙發上，換我陪他熬夜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給家裡有小孩、忽然發現自己正在養下一屆球迷的人
variations: 這屆是我的，下一屆可能是他人生的第一屆。
四年很久，久到剛好夠一個小孩長成球迷。

en.content:
My nephew is five. He fell asleep on my couch during the final and missed every minute of it.
This week he suddenly asked when the ball thing everybody kept watching was coming back.
Four years, I told him.
He counted on his fingers, gave up halfway, and asked how old he'd be by then.
Nine.
Nine is old enough to remember it himself. His first one.
And now I really want to be around that summer, same couch, staying up with him instead.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just realized they're raising the next tournament's fan
variations: This one was mine. The next one might be his first.
Four years is long — long enough for a kid to turn into a fan.

items.sourceNote: 決賽零比零撐進延長賽、第一〇五分鐘才破門的比賽節奏；感想原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽那場，前面一百零四分鐘，記分板都掛著零比零。
旁邊的人一直碎念「這場好悶」，中場休息還去把碗洗了。
第一百零五分鐘，球進了，全世界同時炸開。
後來我一直在想那一百零四分鐘——
不是什麼都沒發生，是它一直在替那一球鋪路。
我們平常大概也是這樣：卡在零比零的那一段，最容易以為自己在浪費時間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個覺得最近毫無進展、快要放棄的人
variations: 零比零不是沒有故事，是故事還沒走到那一格。
決賽最重要的是第一百零五分鐘，但前面那一百零四分鐘也不是白過的。

en.content:
For the first 104 minutes of the final, the scoreboard said nil-nil.
The guy next to me kept muttering that it was a boring game. He did the dishes at halftime.
Minute 105, the ball went in, and the whole planet came apart at once.
I keep going back to those 104 minutes.
They weren't empty. They were the runway.
Most of life is the nil-nil stretch, and that's exactly the part where you're most tempted to call it wasted.
en.editorNote: For someone convinced nothing is moving and thinking about quitting
variations: Nil-nil isn't a missing story. The story just hasn't reached that minute yet.
Minute 105 decided it, but the 104 before it were doing the work.

items.sourceNote: 賽事期間生活延宕、賽後待辦回堆的常見情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
六月開賽之後，我發明了一句萬用咒語：「等世界盃結束再說。」
牙醫、只翻了三頁的書、那封拖著沒回的信，通通排到比賽後面。
現在世界盃真的結束了，清單還躺在原地，一件都沒少。
我攤開來看了很久，
才承認世界盃根本不是原因，
它只是我這一個月最好用的藉口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把所有事都推到賽後、結果賽後也沒動的人
variations: 世界盃結束了，我的藉口也跟著到期了。
擋住我的從來不是比賽，是我自己。

en.content:
Once June started, I had a magic phrase for everything: after the World Cup.
The dentist, the book I got three pages into, the email I've been dodging — all of it went behind the tournament.
The tournament is genuinely over now. The list hasn't moved. Not one item.
I looked at it for a long time
before admitting the World Cup was never the reason.
It was just the best excuse I had all month.
en.editorNote: For the person who parked everything until after the final and still hasn't started
variations: The tournament ended and my excuse expired with it.
It was never the matches getting in my way.

items.sourceNote: 賽後戒斷與球迷留戀情緒相關報導；手機情境改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
決賽那晚我隨手截了一張圖，順手設成鎖定畫面。
三個禮拜過去了，我一天大概解鎖八十次，就等於看它八十次。
前幾天同事瞄到，問我怎麼還沒換。
我說懶。
其實是每次按下去的那半秒，我又回到那個還什麼都沒結束的凌晨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個桌布、頭貼、群組名稱都還停在六月的朋友
variations: 不是懶得換，是還不想換。
一天八十次的小小重播，只有我自己知道。

en.content:
I grabbed a screenshot the night of the final and set it as my lock screen without thinking.
Three weeks later, I unlock my phone maybe eighty times a day, which means I look at it eighty times a day.
A coworker noticed this week and asked why I hadn't changed it yet.
I said I was too lazy.
Really it's that for half a second every time, I'm back at 3AM with nothing over yet.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose wallpaper, avatar, and group chat name are all still stuck in June
variations: Not too lazy to change it. Just not ready to.
Eighty tiny replays a day, and nobody else knows.

items.sourceNote: 賽後熱度快速退場、生活回到日常的普遍現象；賣場情境原創

zh-tw.content:
六月的時候，賣場一進門就是一整排世界盃的貨架：
球衣、零食，還有那種插在飲料杯上的小旗子。
昨天我再去，同一個位置變成開學文具，鉛筆盒堆得比我還高。
店員說這叫換季，很正常。
我知道很正常。
只是沒想到，拆掉一個夏天、打包、換上新的，用不到一個下午。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個發現全世界都翻頁了、只有自己還停在原地的人
variations: 那排貨架的壽命，比我的低潮短很多。
換季是店裡的事，我這邊的季還沒換完。

en.content:
In June, the front of my grocery store was one long tournament aisle:
jerseys, snack towers, those tiny flags you stick in a drink.
I went back yesterday and the exact same spot is back-to-school supplies, pencil cases stacked taller than me.
An employee called it a seasonal reset. Totally normal.
I know it's normal.
I just didn't expect a whole summer to be dismantled, boxed, and replaced in under an afternoon.
en.editorNote: For anyone who noticed the world moved on while they're still standing in June
variations: That aisle had a shorter lifespan than my post-tournament slump.
The store changed seasons. I haven't finished mine.

items.sourceNote: 賽後新球迷延續熱情、投入實際踢球的相關報導；個人情境原創

zh-tw.content:
看了整整一個月的球之後，我做了一件很衝動的事：報名公司附近的成人足球隊。
第一次去，我在場上跑了大概十二分鐘就開始扶膝蓋。
有人傳球給我，我很有誠意地把球送給了對面。
隔天下樓梯全程要抓扶手，走路像剛學會。
但那晚我睡得比整個七月都好。
原來我想要的不只是看別人跑，我也想親自喘一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完比賽突然很想動一動、卻一直沒去報名的人
variations: 看球一個月，體能原地不動，熱血倒是滿出來。
那十二分鐘，是我這輩子離職業選手最近的一次。

en.content:
After a solid month of watching, I did something impulsive: I signed up for a rec league near my office.
First session, I lasted about twelve minutes before I was standing there holding my knees.
Someone passed me the ball and I generously delivered it to the other team.
Next morning I needed the handrail to get down the stairs.
But I slept better that night than any night in July.
Turns out I didn't just want to watch people run. I wanted to be out of breath too.
en.editorNote: For the person who got the itch to actually play and still hasn't signed up
variations: A month of watching did nothing for my fitness and everything for my delusions.
Twelve minutes is the closest I will ever get to being a professional.

items.sourceNote: 賽事結束後辦公室氣氛與痕跡殘留的普遍情境；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
公司茶水間的白板上，六月有人畫了一張手寫的對戰表。
十六強之後就沒人更新了，被淘汰的隊伍旁邊還留著紅色的叉。
白板右下角現在寫的是這禮拜訂便當的截止時間，
上面那張表，沒人擦，也沒人補完。
每次去裝水我都會看一眼。
有些東西不是被特別留下來的，是大家都不想當那個先動手擦掉的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給辦公室裡那個世界盃痕跡還沒收掉、誰都不好意思先動手的同事
variations: 沒人更新，也沒人擦掉，就這樣掛著。
擦掉只要三秒，但誰都不想當那個人。

en.content:
Back in June somebody drew a bracket on the whiteboard in our office kitchen.
Nobody updated it past the round of 16, so the knocked-out teams still have red X's next to them.
The bottom corner now says when lunch orders close this week.
The bracket above it hasn't been erased and hasn't been finished.
I glance at it every time I refill my water.
Some things don't survive because anyone saved them. They survive because nobody wants to be the one who wipes them off.
en.editorNote: For the coworker sitting next to the office's last remaining tournament relic
variations: Nobody's updating it. Nobody's erasing it. It just hangs there.
It'd take three seconds to wipe, and not one of us will do it.

items.sourceNote: 球迷臨時習得戰術詞彙的普遍情境；自嘲角度原創

zh-tw.content:
我剛剛聽見自己講出一句「他們中場太鬆了」。
講完我自己愣了三秒——三天前，我連球在畫面的哪一邊都要先找一下。
回想了一下，上一次這幾個字從我嘴裡出來，是四年前的同一段日子。
原來這種專業是有保存期限的，
而我的期限，剛好是四年。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個第三天就開始講戰術、上個月還把球隊名字唸錯的人
variations: 我的足球專業，開封後四年內有效。
上一次我這麼懂球，也是在一個熬夜的季節。

en.content:
Tactics vocabulary I did not own last week just walked out of my mouth: "their midfield is way too loose."
I froze for three seconds after saying it. Three days ago I still had to hunt for which side of the screen the ball was on.
I checked my memory. The last time those words showed up in a sentence of mine was four years ago, almost the same week.
Turns out this kind of expertise comes with a shelf life.
Mine is exactly four years.
en.editorNote: For the friend breaking down formations by day three of watching
variations: My football expertise expires four years after opening.
Last time I knew this much about the game, I was also very tired.

items.sourceNote: 熬夜看球隔天在會議上撐場的普遍情境；點頭被指派工作的橋段原創

zh-tw.content:
熬夜看完球，早上那場會我全程都在點頭。
不是同意，是身體自己找到了一個最像清醒的姿勢。
主管每講完一句，我就慎重地點一下，
點得比全場都用力，像一個對什麼都很有想法的人。
散會十分鐘後，信箱多了一封信：
恭喜，那件事現在是我的了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個熬夜隔天在會上點頭點到把專案點回自己身上的同事
variations: 我點的不是頭，是睡意在幫我打節拍。
全場看起來最投入的那個，其實一個字都沒聽進去。

en.content:
Nodding was my entire contribution to the morning meeting after staying up for the match.
Not agreement. My body had simply found the position that looked the most like being awake.
Every time my manager finished a sentence I gave it a solemn nod, harder than anyone else in the room, like a person with opinions.
Ten minutes after we wrapped, an email landed.
Congratulations. That thing is mine now.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who nodded their way into owning a whole project
variations: That wasn't agreement. That was sleep debt keeping time.
Most engaged person in the room, and he heard exactly none of it.

items.sourceNote: 加時開打前的補給儀式；冰箱最後一罐的取捨為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
聽到要打加時的那一刻，我的第一個動作不是握拳，是走去開冰箱。
裡面剩最後一罐，冰得剛剛好。
那罐本來是留給明天早上的我的。
我扶著冰箱門想了三秒，還是把它拉開了。
明天的我一定會生氣，
可是明天的我不在這裡。這裡只有我，和還沒踢完的三十分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了加時賽，把明天早上那一罐提前喝掉的人
variations: 明天的我很重要，只是沒有這三十分鐘重要。
那不是一罐飲料，那是我跟明天預支的。

en.content:
Extra time got announced and my first move wasn't a fist pump, it was opening the fridge.
One can left, cold enough.
That can was supposed to belong to tomorrow-morning me.
I held the door open for about three seconds, then cracked it anyway.
Tomorrow me is going to be furious.
But tomorrow me isn't here. Here there's only me and thirty minutes nobody has played yet.
en.editorNote: For anyone who has spent tomorrow's energy on tonight's extra thirty minutes
variations: Tomorrow me matters. Just not more than the next thirty minutes.
That wasn't a drink. That was an advance on tomorrow.

items.sourceNote: 賽後「我早就看好」的事後諸葛心理；午餐桌四人全中的算法為原創

zh-tw.content:
隔天中午，桌上四個人，四個人都說自己早就看好那一隊。
我也講了，語氣非常有把握，還補一句「他們就是有那個氣質」。
氣質是什麼意思，我到現在還解釋不出來。
後來我默默算了一下：
我們四個「早就看好」的隊加起來，剛好把有機會贏的都看好了一遍。
原來不是這桌每個人都神準，
是昨天開賽之前，我們一個字都沒先講出口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽後才開始「我早就說了」的人，順便提醒他昨天什麼都沒說
variations: 賽前沒人敢開口，賽後每個人都是先知。
我們這桌的預測，全部都是終場哨響之後才生效的。

en.content:
Hindsight showed up at lunch the next day: all four of us claimed we'd called it.
I said it too, very confidently, and added that the team "just had the look about them."
I still cannot tell you what the look means.
Then I quietly did the math. Between the four of us, our we-knew-it teams covered basically everyone who could have won.
So it isn't that nobody at this table was wrong.
It's that the night before, not one of us said a word out loud.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose predictions only ever arrive after the final whistle
variations: Nobody predicts beforehand. Everybody predicted afterward.
Our table has a perfect forecasting record and a zero percent submission rate.

items.sourceNote: 穿戴裝置的睡眠評分與週報為公開常識；紅色格子與「分數變好卻更想念」的對照為原創

zh-tw.content:
手錶今天早上推了一份週報給我：
本週睡眠分數比上個月高了四十分，是今年最好的一週。
七月那幾格全是紅的，短、碎、東倒西歪，它每天都在勸我早點睡。
現在它終於滿意了。
可是它只量得到我睡了幾小時，量不到那幾小時裡我什麼都沒有在等。
分數最高的這一週，我反而一直在想念紅色的那幾格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個作息終於調回來、卻覺得日子突然變安靜的人
variations: 數據上我完全康復了，只有我自己知道少了什麼。
我睡得比七月好，但沒有七月那麼想醒著。

en.content:
My watch pushed me a weekly report this morning.
Sleep score up forty points from last month. Best week of the year.
July was a wall of red bars: short, broken, all over the place. It nagged me every single day.
Now it's finally happy with me.
But it only measures how many hours I slept, not whether there was anything I was staying up for.
My best week on record, and I keep thinking about the red bars.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose sleep schedule recovered before the rest of them did
variations: The data says I'm fully recovered. The data is missing something.
I sleep better than I did in July. I just want to be awake less.

items.sourceNote: 休眠型弱連結（dormant tie）的人際研究概念；四年只有兩段對話的細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
通訊軟體裡有個名字，我點進去，整個對話紀錄只有兩段。
上面那段是四年前，下面這段是這個夏天，開頭都是同一句：「醒著嗎？」
中間那四年，我們一句話都沒講，可是誰也沒有把誰刪掉。
七月十九號之後，那個對話框就沒再亮過。
我大概知道它下一次亮起來是什麼時候——
有些交情不需要常常聯絡，它只是把自己設定成四年響一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個平常沒交集、只在大賽期間半夜敲你的人
variations: 我們的對話紀錄很短，但每一句都在凌晨。
不是感情變淡，是這段友情的鬧鐘設四年一次。

en.content:
There's a name in my messages app. I opened it, and the entire thread is two conversations.
The first one is four years old. The second one is this summer. Both start with the same three words: "you up yet?"
For four years in between, neither of us said anything. Neither of us deleted the other either.
Since July 19 the thread has stayed dark.
I have a pretty good idea when it lights up next.
Some friendships don't need maintenance. They're just set to ring once every four years.
en.editorNote: For the person who only texts you at 3AM during a tournament
variations: Short thread. Every message timestamped after midnight.
We didn't drift apart. We're just on a four-year schedule.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃每場賽前奏兩隊國歌為賽事慣例；洗澡還在哼一首不會唱的歌的細節為原創

zh-tw.content:
這個夏天，我陪一支不是我國家的隊走到最後，聽了八次他們的國歌。
現在洗澡的時候，我還是會哼出那兩句——只有旋律，沒有歌詞，因為我一個字都不會念。
那個國家離我好幾千公里，我這輩子可能都不會去。
可是每次哼到中間那個轉音，我就回到那個凌晨：
客廳只開一盞燈，電視裡幾萬人在唱，我站著，跟著一起安靜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了不是自己國家的隊掉過雞皮疙瘩的人
variations: 一首我不會唱的歌，被我記了一整個夏天。
我不懂那些歌詞，但我懂那一分半鐘為什麼站著聽。

en.content:
This summer I followed a team from a country that isn't mine all the way to the end, and heard their anthem eight times.
I still hum two bars of it in the shower. Melody only, no words, because I can't pronounce a single one.
That country is thousands of miles away. I may never set foot in it.
But every time I get to that one turn in the middle, I'm back at 3AM:
one lamp on in the living room, tens of thousands of people singing on screen, and me standing up, quiet, with all of them.
en.editorNote: For anyone who got goosebumps over a country that wasn't theirs
variations: A song I can't sing, stuck in my head for an entire summer.
I don't know the words. I know exactly why I stood up for it.

items.sourceNote: 賽後整理瀏覽器分頁的日常觀察；停在七月十九號比分的最後一個分頁為原創

zh-tw.content:
今天想查個東西，打開手機瀏覽器，才發現分頁還開著三十幾個。
即時比分、球員身高體重、一張我到現在都看不懂的熱區圖，
還有一頁「三分鐘搞懂越位」，開了兩個月沒讀完。
我一個一個關，關到剩最後一個的時候停住了：
那頁停在七月十九號的比分，重新整理一百次也不會再變。
最後我還是關了。乾淨的是手機，空掉的是別的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個捨不得關掉最後一個分頁的人
variations: 分頁全部關掉的那一秒，夏天才算真的結束。
我的瀏覽器比我誠實，它整整兩個月都停在同一件事上。

en.content:
Went to look something up today, opened the browser, and found thirty-odd tabs still sitting there.
Live scores, player heights, one heat map I never learned to read,
and a page called "offside explained in three minutes" that I've had open for two months without finishing.
I closed them one by one, then stopped at the last one.
It's frozen on the July 19 scoreline. I could refresh it a hundred times and nothing would change.
I closed it anyway. The phone is clean now. Something else isn't.
en.editorNote: For the one who couldn't bring themselves to close the last tab
variations: Summer officially ended the second that last tab closed.
My browser was more honest than I was. It stayed on one thing for two months.

items.sourceNote: 賽後生活觀察：北美時區使台灣場次落在清晨，整月開冷氣看球；電費單為原創發想

zh-tw.content:
七月的電費單昨天寄到了，數字比前一期多了一截。
我看了兩秒才想通：那是我整個七月開著冷氣、開著電視撐到天亮的價錢。
上面只印了度數跟金額，我卻從那串數字裡讀出三十幾個凌晨。
我把它壓在冰箱門上，沒有馬上拿去繳。
這大概是那個夏天寄給我的最後一封信，貴是貴了點，但我看得懂它在說什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個拆開帳單先笑再嘆氣的熬夜球迷
variations: 帳單上寫的是度數，我看到的是一整排凌晨三點。
這個夏天最後的紀念品，是一張比平常厚一點的電費單。

en.content:
July's power bill showed up yesterday, and the number was noticeably bigger than last time.
Took me two seconds to work out why: that's the price of running the AC and the TV until sunrise, every night, for a month.
All it prints is kilowatt-hours and a total. I read thirty-something 3AMs in it.
I stuck it on the fridge instead of paying it right away.
It's probably the last letter that summer will ever send me. Pricey, sure, but I know exactly what it's saying.
en.editorNote: For the night-owl fan who laughed before they winced
variations: The bill says kilowatt-hours. I see a month of 3AMs.
Final souvenir of the summer: one slightly heavier electricity bill.

items.sourceNote: 家人從嫌吵到入坑、賽後仍每天追問的日常觀察；全段為原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
開賽第一週，我媽走過客廳只丟一句：「這麼晚了，吵死。」
第三週，她開始站在沙發後面看；到後來，她會指著螢幕說這個人不該被換下去。
現在比賽結束快一個月了，換她每天問我：「今天有沒有球？」
我說沒有了，下一次要等四年。
她「喔」一聲走開，隔天又問了一次。
我沒能讓她愛上足球，她捨不得的是那個每天都有事可以一起等的晚上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個中途被家人默默入坑、現在還在問今天有沒有球的人
variations: 她嫌吵嫌了一個禮拜，然後陪我看完了整個夏天。
「今天有沒有球？」——這句話我媽現在問得比我還勤。

en.content:
First week of the tournament, my mom walked past the living room and said one thing: "It's late. Keep it down."
By week three she was standing behind the couch. By the end she was pointing at the screen saying that guy should not have come off.
It's been almost a month since the final, and now she's the one asking me every day: "Is there a game tonight?"
I tell her no. Next one's in four years.
She says "oh," walks off, and asks again the next day.
I never made her love soccer. What she misses is having something to wait for together, every night.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose family got quietly hooked halfway through
variations: She complained about the noise for a week, then watched the whole summer with me.
"Is there a game tonight?" My mom asks it more often than I do now.

items.sourceNote: 賽事期間衝動購買的球具在賽後閒置的生活觀察；為原創發想

zh-tw.content:
六月一時熱血，我在運動用品店扛了一顆足球回家，說要跟著動一動。
它總共被帶出門兩次，剩下的日子都靠在鞋櫃旁邊。
現在氣消了一半，按下去軟軟的。
我每次出門經過還是會習慣性補一腳，讓它滾到牆邊，然後關門去上班。
家裡最像那個夏天的東西，就是這顆從來沒被好好踢過的球。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個買了裝備、結果只用過兩次的朋友
variations: 熱血退得比球裡的氣還快。
它沒被踢過幾次，但它確實陪我過完了那個夏天。

en.content:
Back in June I got carried away and hauled a soccer ball home from the sporting goods store, telling myself I'd get moving too.
It made it out the door exactly twice. The rest of the summer it leaned against the shoe rack.
It's half deflated now. Press it and it just gives.
I still nudge it out of habit on my way out, roll it against the wall, then lock up and head to work.
The most accurate souvenir of that summer in my apartment is a ball nobody ever really played with.
en.editorNote: For the friend who bought the gear and used it twice
variations: My motivation went flat faster than the ball did.
Barely kicked, but it sat through the whole summer with me.

items.sourceNote: 賽事期間模仿球員髮型、賽後回歸原樣的生活觀察；原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
六月的時候，我拿著手機給設計師看，說要剪成螢幕上那個人的頭。
他看了兩秒，說：「盡量。」
那顆頭陪我熬完整個夏天，洗完澡吹一吹，站遠一點還真的有幾分像。
昨天回去補剪，設計師問我：「還要留一樣的嗎？」
我對著鏡子愣了一下，最後說：「剪短就好。」
有些造型是跟著比賽走的。比賽結束了，頭髮也該回去做自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個六月剪了跟風頭、現在默默剪回來的人
variations: 頭髮長回來的速度，剛好跟熱度退掉的速度一樣。
那顆頭只適合有比賽可以看的夏天。

en.content:
Back in June I held up my phone at the salon and said I wanted the haircut from the screen.
My stylist looked at it for two seconds and said, "I'll try."
That cut got me through the whole summer. Blow-dried, from a distance, it honestly kind of worked.
Went back yesterday and he asked, "Keeping the same one?"
I stared at the mirror for a beat and said, "Just take it short."
Some looks only belong to a season. The tournament ended, and my hair went back to being mine.
en.editorNote: For everyone quietly growing out their June haircut
variations: My hair grew back at exactly the same speed the hype died.
That haircut only worked in a summer with games in it.

items.sourceNote: 把賽事當成個人時間刻度的語言習慣觀察；為原創發想

zh-tw.content:
最近講話，我才發現自己多了一個習慣。
提到任何事，我會說「那是世界盃之前買的」「那件事在決賽那個禮拜」。
這個夏天不知不覺變成一把尺，前面一段，後面一段。
同事聽不下去，說你直接講幾月幾號不行嗎。
可是幾月幾號我真的沒印象，我只記得那天晚上輪到誰上場。
有些日子被記住，不是因為它多重要，是因為那陣子你每天都在等一件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個講日期會先想到賽程的人
variations: 我的行事曆用日期，我的記憶用賽程。
那個夏天在我這裡不是一段時間，是一條分界線。

en.content:
I've picked up a habit lately and only just noticed it.
Whenever something comes up I say "I bought that before the World Cup" or "that happened during final week."
That summer quietly turned into a ruler: everything is either before it or after it.
A coworker got fed up and asked why I can't just say the date.
But I genuinely don't remember the date. I remember who was playing that night.
Some stretches of time stick, not because they mattered, but because back then you woke up with something to wait for.
en.editorNote: For the person who thinks in fixtures instead of dates
variations: My calendar runs on dates. My memory runs on kickoff times.
That summer isn't a span of time to me. It's a dividing line.

items.sourceNote: 台灣媒體的越位圖解報導，網友常說「看圖才秒懂」；本篇取「解釋規則失敗」的日常情境自行發想

zh-tw.content:
今年我試了三次，跟完全不看球的人解釋越位。
第一次講到「倒數第二名防守球員」，對方眼神就飄走了。
第二次我拿三個杯子在桌上排，排到一半杯子倒了。
第三次我畫圖，畫到一半自己停下來確認一下我有沒有記錯。
他最後說：「好像懂了。所以這樣為什麼要氣成那樣？」
這題我反而答不出來。
規則我可以講到你懂，在乎不行。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都問你「剛剛那樣算犯規嗎」的朋友
variations: 越位我可以講十分鐘。為什麼在意，我一句都湊不出來。
他懂了那條規則，還是不懂我為什麼會站起來。
有些事情你能解釋清楚，有些事情只能等對方自己也熬一次夜。

en.content:
Explained offside three times this year. Lost three times.
Attempt one died at "the second-to-last defender."
Attempt two used three cups on the table. One cup fell over.
Attempt three I drew a diagram, then stopped halfway to double-check I had it right myself.
He said, "Okay, I think I follow. So why does that make you shout?"
That's the part I couldn't answer.
The rule I can teach you. The caring, no.
en.editorNote: For the friend who asks "wait, was that a foul?" every single time
variations: Ten minutes on the offside rule. Not one sentence on why it matters to me.
He learned the rule. He still doesn't know why I stood up.
Some things you can explain. Some things you have to stay up for once.

items.sourceNote: 球衣保養指南（翻面、冷水、不用柔軟精、不可烘乾）；改寫成「對一件沒人檢查的衣服特別講究」的自嘲

zh-tw.content:
全家的衣服我都是一股腦丟進洗衣機，唯獨那一件不行。
翻面、冷水、單獨洗、不放柔軟精，晾在照不到太陽的那一角。
背後那排字現在有點裂了，我還是每次都很小心地攤平。
家人說，那件你根本半年沒穿。
我知道。
可是它撐過的那些晚上，洗衣機不知道。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把某件舊衣服當古蹟在保養的球迷朋友
variations: 衣服對我來說分兩種：可以烘的，跟那一件。
半年沒穿，還是每次都翻面手洗——講究的不是布，是那段日子。
背後的字掉得再多，我也不打算把它降級。

en.content:
Everything else in this house goes straight into the machine. Not that one.
Inside out, cold water, washed alone, no fabric softener, dried in the corner the sun never reaches.
The letters across the back are cracking now. I still flatten them out by hand every time.
Someone pointed out I haven't worn it in six months.
I know.
But the washing machine has no idea what that shirt sat through.
en.editorNote: For the fan who treats one old shirt like a listed building
variations: Two kinds of clothing in my house: tumble-dry, and that one.
Six months unworn, still hand-washed inside out. The fuss isn't about fabric.
Letters peeling off the back. Still not demoting it.

items.sourceNote: 台灣在地看球風氣報導（直播派對、學童足球）；本篇取「父子在客廳看球」的常青家庭場景自行發想

zh-tw.content:
小學的時候，我爸會在半夜把我搖醒，說：「快，要開始了。」
我根本不知道在踢什麼，就這樣坐在他旁邊，被電視的光照著。
整場他大概只出三種聲音：一聲「嘖」、一聲「哎唷」，還有偶爾很小聲的一句「好球」。
他沒解釋過任何規則，我也沒問。
隔天我在課堂上睡到流口水，他從來沒承認過是誰害的。
現在換我自己守同一個時段。
我才想通，他不是要我懂足球，他是想要有人跟他一起醒著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個和爸爸話不多、卻一起看完很多場球的人
variations: 我們家最長的一次共處，全程只有三個狀聲詞。
他從來沒教過我規則，只教會我怎麼撐到最後一分鐘。
小時候是他把我搖醒，現在是我自己設鬧鐘。

en.content:
Third grade. Dad shook me awake at midnight and said, "Quick, it's starting."
I had no idea what we were watching. I just sat beside him in the light coming off the TV.
Three sounds all night: a click of the tongue, an "oof," and once in a while a very quiet "nice one."
He never explained a single rule. I never asked.
I drooled through class the next day. He never admitted whose fault that was.
These days I keep the same hours on my own.
He didn't need me to understand football. He needed someone awake with him.
en.editorNote: For anyone who barely talks with their dad but has watched a hundred games beside him
variations: Longest stretch we ever spent together ran entirely on sound effects.
He never taught me the rules. He taught me how to make it to the final whistle.
He used to shake me awake. Now I set my own alarm.

items.sourceNote: 台灣球迷文化評論（一日球迷、透過網路認識球隊）；本篇取「因為看球而記住陌生國家」的角度自行發想

zh-tw.content:
看球以前，世界地圖對我來說就是課本上那張圖，考完就還給老師了。
後來我為了搞懂一支隊，查了那個國名在哪一塊、國旗為什麼是那三個顏色、首都到底怎麼唸。
比賽結束沒幾天我就忘了比分，那幾個字反而留下來。
現在新聞跑過那個國名，全辦公室只有我抬一下頭。
地理老師努力了三年沒做到的事，
一場我根本沒有立場的比賽，一個晚上就做到了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個因為看球而莫名記住一堆國名的人
variations: 我的世界地理，一半是老師教的，一半是熬夜看來的。
考卷上背不起來的國名，一場球看完就記住了。
地圖上有幾個地方，是我替它們緊張過之後才變熟的。

en.content:
Looked up a country at 2AM because of a football match. Never stopped after that.
Before that night, the world map was a textbook page I handed back after the exam.
I checked where the place sat, why the flag used those three colors, how you actually say the capital out loud.
The score was gone from my head within a week. Those few facts stayed.
Now the name crosses the news and I'm the only one in the office who looks up.
Three years of geography class couldn't manage that. One match I had no stake in did it overnight.
en.editorNote: For the fan who somehow memorized a dozen countries without meaning to
variations: Half my geography came from school. The other half came from staying up.
Couldn't memorize that country for an exam. Learned it in ninety minutes.
A few places on the map only got real after I spent a night nervous for them.

items.sourceNote: CNN 報導賽後球迷的情緒宿醉與日常儀式消失；本篇改寫成「還沒退掉的反射動作清單」，採條列結構

zh-tw.content:
世界盃結束一個月，我身上還沒退掉的東西：
・經過任何一片草地，眼睛會自己找有沒有球門。
・聽到哨聲會抬頭，就算那只是路口的交通指揮。
・看到有人穿條紋球衣，會多看一眼是不是那一件。
・朋友傳訊息進來，第一個念頭還是「幾比幾」。
名單有點長，我沒打算刪。
熱鬧會退，習慣不會，它只是暫時找不到地方用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 丟進球迷群組，讓大家接著往下補自己的那幾條
variations: 熱鬧退場了，習慣還在原地上班。
草地、哨聲、條紋衣：三個都還沒收到通知。
清單我留著，反正四年後還會用到。

en.content:
One month after the final, the stuff that still hasn't worn off:
- I scan every patch of grass for goalposts.
- Any whistle makes me look up, including the traffic cop's.
- Someone walks past in stripes and I check whether it's that kit.
- A text buzzes in and my first guess is a scoreline.
The list is longer than I'd like. I'm not deleting it.
The noise goes away. The habits don't. They just run out of places to happen.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the group chat and let everyone add their own line
variations: The noise clocked out. The habits still show up for work.
Grass, whistles, stripes: nobody told any of them it's over.
Keeping the list. It'll be useful again in four years.

items.sourceNote: 官方商品線上商店，賽後進入出清檔期；本篇取「賽後折扣架前買不下手」的情境，採對白結構

zh-tw.content:
週末逛到運動用品店，最裡面那區掛滿紅色的「出清」。
店員說：「這排都是上個月的活動商品，五折。」
我指了指其中一件：「冠軍那件也算？」
「算，尺寸還很齊。」
六月我為了同一件排過隊，差一點就刷下去。
現在它掛在最外面那一排，等一個不趕時間的人。
我最後空手走出來。
不是嫌貴，是那個願意用原價買它的我，已經下架了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看到賽後出清架、反而更買不下手的球迷
variations: 打折的不是球衣，是七月。
同一件衣服，六月要排隊，八月沒人跟我搶。
我不是嫌五折貴，我是嫌它太好買了。

en.content:
Wandered into a sporting goods store this weekend. The whole back corner was red: CLEARANCE.
"Everything on this rack is from last month's event," the clerk said. "Half off."
I pointed at one. "The champions' shirt too?"
"That too. We've still got every size."
In June I stood in a line for that exact shirt and nearly paid full price.
Now it hangs on the end rack, waiting for somebody who isn't in a hurry.
I walked out with nothing.
Not because it's expensive. The version of me who'd have paid full price has been discontinued.
en.editorNote: For the fan who found the clearance rack and somehow wanted it less
variations: It isn't the shirt that got marked down. It's July.
Same shirt: a line in June, all mine in August.
Half off isn't too expensive. It's too easy.

items.sourceNote: 賽後低潮的心理分析（儀式消失、多巴胺回落）；本篇濃縮成一句短語，供社群短貼文使用

zh-tw.content:
熱度是會退的，這我早就知道。
沒想到退乾淨之後留下來的不是那支球隊，是那份肯為別人的比賽醒著的力氣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 賽後空虛時拿來當個人簡介或短貼文，一句就夠
variations: 退掉的是熱鬧，留下的是還肯在乎的那股勁。
球隊會解散，為誰緊張過的力氣不會。
熱度有保存期限，在乎沒有。

en.content:
Hype fades. I knew that going in.
What I didn't expect: once it drained off, what stayed wasn't the team. It was the willingness to stay awake for somebody else's game.
en.editorNote: A one-liner for the flat weeks after a tournament ends, good as a bio or short post
variations: The noise expires. The caring doesn't.
Teams disband. The habit of pulling for something survives.
What ended was the schedule, not the appetite.

items.sourceNote: 賽後球迷靠影像與紀念物延長餘韻的報導；本篇改寫成「桌布遲遲沒換」的生活小場景

zh-tw.content:
手機桌布還停在那張舉杯的畫面，我一直沒換。
前幾天在飲料店等單，手機亮起來，店員瞄了一眼說：「你還沒換喔。」
語氣很自然，好像在提醒我冰箱有東西過期了。
回家我認真打開相簿要挑一張新的：海邊、貓、去年的生日蛋糕。
滑了一整輪，最後手指自己按回原本那張。
過期就過期吧。
有些畫面留著不是為了好看，是為了每次解鎖都提醒我：那個夏天真的發生過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個桌布還停在某個畫面、遲遲不換的人
variations: 換桌布這件事，我大概還要再拖一陣子。
相簿裡有一百張可以換，我按回了原本那張。
它不是好看，它只是能證明我沒記錯。

en.content:
My lock screen is still the trophy-lift shot. I never changed it.
The other day I was waiting on a drink order, my phone lit up, and the guy behind the counter glanced over: "Still got that up, huh."
He said it the way you'd tell someone the milk in their fridge had turned.
At home I actually opened my photos to pick a new one: the beach, the cat, last year's birthday cake.
Scrolled the whole roll, and my thumb put the old one right back.
Fine, it's expired.
Some pictures aren't there to look at. They're there so every unlock says: that summer really happened.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose lock screen is still stuck on one night
variations: Changing it is on the list. The list is not moving.
A hundred photos to choose from. My thumb chose the old one.
It isn't a good photo. It's proof I didn't make it up.

items.sourceNote: 球迷賽後失去共同儀式的觀察；本篇取「為一支陌生球隊學了一句加油詞、後來沒地方用」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
那個夏天我唯一學會的外語，是一句加油詞，四個音節，跟著轉播裡的看台喊了整整一個月。
意思我到現在也只知道大概，發音八成是錯的。
上禮拜在麵店，隔壁桌講的正好是那個語言。
我在心裡把那四個音節排練了好幾遍，
最後低頭把麵吃完，一個字都沒出口。
原來我學會的不是一句話，是一種只在那一個月才成立的膽子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了一支球隊學了幾句外語、後來完全沒地方用的人
variations: 四個音節，練了一個月，實戰零次。
會喊的時候沒人聽得懂，遇到聽得懂的又不敢喊。
那句話還在我嘴邊，只是它的季節過了。

en.content:
The only foreign language I picked up that summer was a chant. Four syllables, learned off a stadium crowd on TV, shouted along with for a solid month.
I still only half know what it means, and my pronunciation is almost certainly wrong.
Last week at a noodle place, the table next to me was speaking that exact language.
I rehearsed those four syllables in my head about six times.
Then I finished my noodles and said nothing.
What I learned wasn't a phrase. It was a kind of nerve that only worked while the tournament was on.
en.editorNote: For the fan who learned a chant in a language they'll never get to use
variations: Four syllables. A month of practice. Zero live attempts.
When I could shout it nobody understood. When someone would, I couldn't.
The chant is still right there. The season it belonged to isn't.

items.sourceNote: 辦公室抽籤指南提到「抽到隊伍後連不看球的人也開始在意」；本篇取此心理自行發想，不涉任何真實賽果

zh-tw.content:
公司抽籤，我抽到一個地圖上找不到的國家。
兩場之後有人說他們爛，我居然回嘴。
zh-tw.editorNote: 辦公室抽籤抽到冷門隊時用
variations: 抽到之前我沒意見，抽到之後我有立場了。
一張籤，就把我變成他們的人。

en.content:
The office draw gave me a country I couldn't find on a map.
Two matches later, someone called them bad and I argued.
en.editorNote: When the office pool hands you a team you've never heard of
variations: No opinion before the draw. Strong opinions after.
One slip of paper and suddenly they're my team.

items.sourceNote: 新手球迷特徵整理；本篇反過來寫「不懂規則卻最快掉眼淚」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
那個只在世界盃看球的朋友，規則不懂，球員不認識，
但每次哭都是他先哭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 介紹身邊那位限定球迷時用
variations: 他分不清位置，但認得那個表情。
規則是可以學的，眼淚不是。

en.content: My friend only watches during the World Cup. Doesn't know the rules, doesn't know the players—and he's always the first one crying.
en.editorNote: For the friend who shows up once every four years
variations: He can't name a single position, but he read the face.
Rules can be learned. That reaction can't.

items.sourceNote: 共同觀賽的情緒感染研究；本篇取「同場但訊號不同步」的日常情境自行發想

zh-tw.content:
一群人擠在客廳，只有他用手機看，訊號快個三秒。
所以每顆球我們都看兩次：一次是他跳起來，一次是真的進了。
後來我們規定他坐最遠的那張椅子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 一起看球卻有人訊號比較快時用
variations: 他不是先知，他只是網路比較快。
同一個房間，兩個時區。

en.content:
Six of us on the couch, and one guy watching on his phone, three seconds ahead.
So we saw every goal twice: once when he jumped, once when it actually went in.
Now he sits in the chair farthest from the TV.
en.editorNote: When someone's stream runs ahead of everyone else's
variations: He's not psychic, his signal is just faster.
Same room, two different time zones.

items.sourceNote: 球迷儀式與情緒感染的心理觀察；本篇取「有人來是為了人不是為了球」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
他來我家看球，整場幾乎沒看螢幕，都在看我們。
進球那一刻我們全站起來，他坐在原地笑得最開心。
他說：「我是來看你們的。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 謝謝那個只是想跟你們待著的朋友
variations: 有人看球，有人看看球的人。
他沒錯過什麼，他看的是另一場。

en.content:
He came over for the game and barely looked at the screen—he watched us.
When the goal went in and we all jumped up, he stayed seated, grinning wider than anyone.
He said he came for us.
en.editorNote: For the friend who came for the company, not the match
variations: Some people watch the game. Some watch the people watching.
He didn't miss anything—he was watching a different match.

items.sourceNote: 賽事期間陌生人之間的共同話題觀察；本篇取「電梯裡的無聲默契」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
電梯裡遇到不熟的同事，兩個人同時打了個很深的哈欠。
沒講半句話，出電梯前互相點了一下頭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個隔天早上在公司跟你對上眼的戰友
variations: 同一支球隊不重要，同一個時段醒著就夠了。
不用問，那個哈欠就是通關密語。

en.content: Rode the elevator with a coworker I barely know. We both yawned, deep, at the exact same time. No words—just a nod on the way out.
en.editorNote: For the stranger at work who was clearly up too
variations: Same team or not, we were awake at the same hour.
That yawn was the password.

items.sourceNote: 熬夜看球隔天上班的身體代價；本篇取「視訊會議關鏡頭」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
晨會我把鏡頭關了，說網路不穩。
其實是鏡頭很誠實，而我昨晚三點才躺下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個晨會永遠只出現一個灰色頭像的同事
variations: 網路很好，是我的臉需要緩衝。
關鏡頭不是害羞，是保護大家的心情。

en.content:
Kept my camera off in the morning standup and blamed the Wi-Fi.
Truth is the camera is honest, and I got to bed at three.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who is a gray circle every morning
variations: The connection is fine. My face needs buffering.
Camera off isn't shyness, it's mercy.

items.sourceNote: 錄影補看時的躲雷日常；本篇取「早餐店電視」情境自行發想

zh-tw.content:
早餐店的電視開著體育新聞，我整個背對著坐。
老闆娘要開口，我先大聲說了一句：加蛋。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了晚上補看、白天不敢抬頭的朋友
variations: 躲比分的人，走路都是低著頭的。
今天不看新聞，今天只看蛋。

en.content:
The breakfast place had sports news on, so I sat facing the wall.
The owner opened her mouth and I shouted my order over it.
en.editorNote: For the friend saving the recording for tonight
variations: People dodging the score walk with their heads down.
No news today. Just eggs.

items.sourceNote: 球迷賽後生活觀察；本篇取「辦公室咖啡機前的無聲供詞」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
早上咖啡機前排了三個人，都按最大杯。
誰也沒提昨晚，杯子已經全招了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟你在茶水間默默對到眼的同事
variations: 杯子的尺寸，就是昨晚的誠實紀錄。
不用問幾點睡，看杯子就好。

en.content: Three of us in line at the office coffee machine, all hitting the largest size. Nobody mentioned last night. The cups already confessed.
en.editorNote: For the coworker you meet at the machine every morning
variations: Cup size is the honest record of last night.
Don't ask what time they slept. Check the cup.

items.sourceNote: 決賽西班牙一比零勝阿根廷、延長賽分出勝負；本篇取「隔天失聲三天」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
決賽隔天早上，我開口跟同事講第一句話，聲音是破的。
我根本不記得自己喊了什麼，可能只是一長串的啊。
啞了三天，第四天聲音回來的時候，我居然有點捨不得。
熬了一整個夏天，最後留在身體上的證據，只有三天的份。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個決賽隔天講話沙啞、還要硬撐著開會的人
variations: 喉嚨比我誠實，它幫我把那一晚記了三天。
聲音回來的那天，夏天才算真的結束。

en.content:
The morning after the final, I said my first sentence to a coworker and my voice cracked into nothing.
I honestly don't remember what I'd been yelling. Probably just a long string of aaah.
Three days hoarse. When it came back on day four, I was weirdly sorry to see it go.
A whole summer, and the only proof left on my body had a three-day shelf life.
en.editorNote: For the friend croaking through Monday's meeting
variations: My throat was more honest than I was. It kept that night for three days.
Summer didn't end at the whistle. It ended when my voice came back.

items.sourceNote: 賽事歷時三十九天、7/19 決賽後落幕；本篇取「賽後失落像搬家」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
要怎麼跟沒在看球的人解釋這種難過，我想了很久。
最接近的說法是搬家：最累的不是搬走那天，
是接下來一個月，每次伸手都還是伸向舊房子的那個位置。
球早就踢完了，我的手還沒改過來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個賽後一直說不上來自己在悶什麼的球友
variations: 搬走只要一天，改掉伸手的方向要一個月。
難過的不是比賽收工，是身體還住在上個月。

en.content:
I spent a while trying to explain this slump to someone who never watched a single match.
Closest I got: it's like moving out. The exhausting part isn't moving day,
it's the month after, when your hand keeps reaching for where things used to be.
The football's long over. My hand hasn't updated.
en.editorNote: For the friend who can't name what's been bugging them since the final
variations: Moving out takes a day. Unlearning where you reach takes a month.
It's not the ending that stings. It's that your body still lives in last month.

items.sourceNote: 西班牙奪冠後全球球迷賽後討論；本篇取「不過就是一場球」的回應自行發想

zh-tw.content:
等哪天有人對你說「不過就是一場球，有必要嗎」，
你不用急著反駁，也不用把數據翻出來給他看。
你只要記得：那一個月，你為了一群這輩子不會認識你的人，
在一個完全不合理的時間把自己挖起來，而且沒有一次是被逼的。
會問那句話的人，多半不是不懂足球，
是還沒遇到一件他願意吃虧也想在場的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被家人念了一整個夏天、卻一場都沒漏掉的人
variations: 願意為一件事吃虧，本身就是一種運氣。
被笑的時候不用解釋，你只要知道自己沒有一次是被逼的。

en.content:
When someone tells you it was just a game, and was all that really necessary,
you don't have to argue, and you don't have to pull up the stats.
Just remember: for one month you got yourself up at an indefensible hour
for people who will never know your name, and nobody made you do it.
People who ask that usually aren't confused about soccer.
They just haven't found the thing they'd gladly lose sleep over yet.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose family complained all summer while they missed zero matches
variations: Having something worth losing out for is its own kind of luck.
You don't owe anyone an explanation. Nobody made you get up.

items.sourceNote: 決賽 7/19 於紐澤西開踢、台灣時間 7/20 凌晨三點，延長賽後才結束；本篇取「散場時天已全亮」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
七月二十號早上六點多，比賽終於踢完，我去把窗簾拉開。
外面天已經全亮了，樓下有人穿著制服在等公車，一臉正要開始上班。
我一句話也沒講，關窗、洗臉、躺下。
那大概是我這輩子唯一一次，跟太陽同時下班。
現在到了那個時間，我是被叫起來的那一個；
只有那天早上，我是走完整場才回來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完決賽直接洗把臉去上班的人
variations: 那天早上我下班，全世界剛好上班。
有些夜不是熬完的，是走完的。

en.content:
Just past six in the morning on July 20th, the match finally ended and I pulled the curtains open.
It was fully light out. Someone in a uniform was waiting for the bus downstairs, clearly about to start a shift.
I didn't say anything. Closed the window, washed my face, lay down.
That's probably the only time in my life I clocked out at the same moment as the sun.
These days at that hour I'm the one being dragged awake.
Just that one morning, I came home having gone the full distance.
en.editorNote: For the fan who watched the final and went straight to work
variations: I clocked out that morning. The rest of the world was clocking in.
Some nights you don't survive. You finish them.

items.sourceNote: 賽事已於 7/19 結束，各地球迷出現賽後戒斷；本篇取「賽後餘韻在日常對話裡冒出來」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
昨天下班太晚，我在路邊招了一台車。
上車沒多久，收音機正好在回顧決賽，司機從後照鏡看我一眼，問我那時候有沒有熬。
我說有，幾乎每一場；他笑著說他那個月都排大夜，比賽全靠聽的，只知道誰進球，不知道球是怎麼進的。
下車前我說了句你比我辛苦，他擺擺手：車上那台收音機，比乘客還會叫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一上車就能跟司機聊十分鐘足球的朋友
variations: 有些人的那個夏天沒有畫面，只有聲音，還是照樣熬完了。
同一場比賽，有人用看的，有人用聽的，累的程度倒是很公平。

en.content:
Got out of work late yesterday and flagged down a cab.
A few minutes in, the radio started replaying the final, and the driver caught my eye in the mirror and asked if I'd stayed up for it.
I said I had, almost every match — he laughed and said he pulled graveyard shifts all that month, so he only ever heard the games, knew who scored but never how.
As I paid I told him he'd had it rougher than me, and he waved it off: that radio in his car, he said, yells louder than any passenger.
en.editorNote: For the friend who can talk football with a cab driver for ten straight minutes
variations: Some people's whole summer had no picture, only sound. They still made it to the end.
One match, some watched it, some only heard it. The exhaustion came out about even.

items.sourceNote: 賽事期間球迷囤宵夜、作息全亂的普遍經驗；本篇取「囤貨吃不完」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
廚房最上面那一格，還放著六月扛回來的那箱宵夜泡麵。
昨天我踮腳去拿東西，它好像開口跟我說話：你那時候說怕不夠，一次搬了二十四碗。
我數了一下，剩十九碗，保存期限印著明年二月。
我把箱子推回原位，跟它說先放著吧，反正它等得比我久，我也不急著把那個夏天吃完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個六月囤了一整箱宵夜、現在還在慢慢消化的球友
variations: 那箱泡麵最後只被吃掉五碗，其他十九碗都是那個夏天的存檔。
囤貨的時候以為會不夠，結束了才發現，不夠的從來不是泡麵。

en.content:
The top shelf in my kitchen still holds the case of late-night instant noodles I hauled home in June.
I reached up there yesterday and the box practically spoke to me: you said you were worried it wouldn't be enough, so you bought twenty-four at once.
I counted. Nineteen left, best before February.
I pushed the box back where it was and told it to sit tight — it's waited longer than I have, and I'm in no rush to finish eating that summer.
en.editorNote: For the friend who stocked up in June and is still working through it
variations: Five got eaten. The other nineteen are just that summer, saved.
I stocked up thinking it wouldn't be enough. Turns out noodles were never the thing running out.

items.sourceNote: 賽期全球球迷入睡時間大幅後移、白天補眠；本篇取「家人誤會你在上夜班」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
六七月那陣子，我阿嬤一直以為我換了工作，改上夜班。
她白天打電話來都會先壓低聲音問一句「吵到你沒」，講不到三分鐘就急著掛。
後來我跟她從頭解釋一次，講到轉播時間全落在半夜，她喔了一聲；過幾天再打來，音量還是壓得很低。
有些人疼你的方式很笨，笨到你作息都調回來一個月了，她還在替你守著那個要安靜的白天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個整個夏天被家人默默配合、自己還沒發現的人
variations: 我沒跟她說我在看球，她也照樣把整個白天讓給我睡。
她記住的不是理由，是你那陣子白天要睡這件事。

en.content:
For most of June and July, my grandma was convinced I'd switched jobs and gone onto night shifts.
She'd call in the afternoon with her voice dropped low, ask whether she'd woken me, and hang up inside three minutes.
I finally explained the whole thing — the broadcasts, the middle-of-the-night kickoffs — and she said oh; then she called again a few days later, still half-whispering.
Some people love you in a clumsy way, clumsy enough that a month after your sleep went back to normal, she's still guarding a quiet afternoon on your behalf.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose family quietly worked around them all summer without being asked
variations: She never knew why. She gave me the whole afternoon anyway.
She didn't remember the reason. She remembered that you needed the daytime.

items.sourceNote: 賽後球迷懷念「整座城市一起醒著」的氛圍；本篇取「對面大樓的燈」自行發想

zh-tw.content:
決賽之前的那幾週，半夜我常端著杯子站到窗邊，對面那棟總有五、六扇窗是亮的。
我不知道那些人在看哪一隊，他們也不知道有人在看他們，我們就這樣各自亮著，亮到天邊發白。
昨天差不多同一個時間我醒著，再看一次，整棟只剩一盞燈，還是樓梯間被誰觸發的感應燈。
那一個月我以為自己是全社區最怪的人，後來才發現，我們是隔著一條巷子，一起把夜撐開的一群人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個半夜看球時，總會抬頭看看鄰居燈亮著沒的人
variations: 那幾週我認得每一扇亮著的窗，卻一個名字都叫不出來。
整棟樓只剩感應燈的那天，我才知道熱鬧真的散了。

en.content:
In the weeks before the final I'd stand at the window past midnight with a mug, and the building across the way always had five or six lit windows.
I never knew who they were rooting for and they never knew anyone was watching them, so we just stayed lit, all the way to first light.
I was awake around that same hour yesterday and looked again: one light left in the whole building, and it was the stairwell sensor someone had tripped.
That month I thought I was the strangest person on the block. Turns out we were a crowd, one alley apart, holding the night open together.
en.editorNote: For the fan who used to check whether the neighbors' lights were still on
variations: I knew every lit window on that block and not a single name behind them.
The night the building went dark except the stairwell, I knew it was really over.

items.sourceNote: 賽事結束後球迷的空窗與身體記憶；本篇為第二人稱寫法，自行發想

zh-tw.content:
你現在應該已經睡回正常的時間了。
白天不用再撐著眼皮，群組安安靜靜，沒有人在半夜連傳三個驚嘆號。
可是偶爾夜裡忽然醒著，你會有半秒鐘以為自己漏掉了什麼，手還會自己去摸手機。
那不是後遺症，是你的身體還記得，有一段日子它願意為了一件很開心的事醒著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個作息調回來了、卻還是會在半夜莫名醒一下的球友
variations: 半夜那半秒的慌，是身體還在等一場已經踢完的球。
作息可以調回來，身體記得的東西不用調。

en.content:
By now you've probably gotten your sleep back on schedule.
No more propping your eyes open at work, the group chat is quiet, nobody firing off three exclamation points at 3 a.m.
But some nights you surface for no reason, and for half a second you're sure you missed something, hand already reaching for the phone.
That's not a side effect. That's your body remembering there was a stretch of time when it was glad to be awake for something.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose schedule reset but whose body still wakes up anyway
variations: That half-second of panic is your body still waiting on a match that already ended.
You can reset a schedule. You can't reset what the body remembers.

items.sourceNote: 賽事七月十九日結束後的球迷生活紀錄；手機容量與截圖情節自行發想

zh-tw.content:
手機跳出容量不足，我點進去看到底是什麼把空間吃光了。
排在最前面的有三種東西：比分的截圖、對著電視錄下來的重播，還有一堆在客廳拍到糊掉的慶祝照。
我點了全選，手指停在刪除上，最後只清掉三支沒看完的開箱影片。
容量到現在還是紅的，我把那個相簿改名成「六月到七月」，繼續帶著它去上班。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個手機快爆了也捨不得刪掉那個夏天的球友
variations: 容量會滿，那幾個月不會。
手指停在刪除鍵上的那幾秒，答案就出來了。

en.content:
My phone threw up a storage warning, so I opened it to see what was actually eating the space.
Three things sat at the top: score screenshots, replays I filmed straight off the TV, and a pile of blurry celebration shots taken in my own living room.
I hit select all, hovered over delete, and ended up clearing three unboxing videos I never finished.
The bar is still red, so I renamed that album June to July and took it to work with me.
en.editorNote: For the fan who'd rather run out of storage than delete that summer
variations: Storage fills up. Those two months don't.
The few seconds my finger hung over delete told me everything.

items.sourceNote: 新球季八月下旬開打、球迷開始整理世界盃周邊；二手拍賣對話為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
那件球衣我洗乾淨、拍好三張照，放上二手拍賣，價錢開得很客氣。
半夜有人敲我：「看起來跟新的一樣，你怎麼捨得賣？」
我回他：「反正以後也用不到了。」
他隔了很久才回一句：「那你先留著，我不急，等你哪天真的用不到再說。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把球衣上架又下架好幾次的球友
variations: 有些東西下架比上架難。
遇到一個願意等你想清楚的人，很難得。

en.content:
I washed the jersey, took three photos, and listed it secondhand at a price I felt okay about.
Around midnight someone messaged me: "That looks brand new, how are you fine letting it go?"
I wrote back, "I'm not going to wear it again anyway."
He took forever to reply, then sent: "Hang on to it, I'm in no rush, message me when you really don't need it."
en.editorNote: For the fan who has listed and unlisted the same jersey more than once
variations: Taking a listing down is harder than putting one up.
A stranger who lets you think it over is rarer than the shirt.

items.sourceNote: 賽程多落在台灣凌晨時段，賽後作息回復；健檢對話為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
今年的健檢排在八月，醫生翻了兩頁報告，抬頭問我最近工作是不是特別操。
我說還好，他又問那是不是有什麼事讓我睡不好。
我搖搖頭，說沒有心事，六七月那陣子我固定天亮才躺下。
他愣了兩秒笑出來，在紙上寫下「作息已恢復」，然後跟我說那個月他也看了不少次日出。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把整個夏天寫進健檢報告裡的球友
variations: 健檢報告不會寫你是為了什麼熬夜。
同一個月醒著的人，比想像中多很多。

en.content:
My annual checkup landed in August, and the doctor flipped through two pages before asking if work had been brutal lately.
I said not really, so he asked whether something had been keeping me up.
I shook my head and told him nothing was on my mind, that back in June and July I went to bed at sunrise like clockwork.
He blinked, laughed, wrote down that my sleep was back to normal, and mentioned he caught plenty of sunrises that month too.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose summer finally showed up on a lab report two months later
variations: A checkup measures the hours, never what you were awake for.
A lot of people were up at that same hour, it turns out.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃後球季重啟、業餘球迷開始自己下場；球鞋與湊人數情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
如果沒有那個夏天，我的鞋櫃裡不會多一雙到現在還沒沾過草的球鞋。
六月下單的時候我跟自己說，看別人踢了那麼多場，總該輪到自己出門踢一次。
昨天同事在群組問週日有沒有人要湊人數，我盯著那則訊息看了半個小時。
如果今天再不回，這雙鞋大概會一直乾淨下去，所以我打了「算我一個」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個買了球鞋卻一直沒下場的球友
variations: 買鞋只要三分鐘，穿上它出門花了我兩個月。
看了一個夏天，總得換自己上場一次。

en.content:
If that summer hadn't happened, there wouldn't be a pair of cleats in my closet that has never touched grass.
When I ordered them in June I told myself that after watching that many matches, I owed myself one where I actually played.
Yesterday a coworker asked the group chat if anyone could fill a spot on Sunday, and I stared at the message for half an hour.
If I let it sit any longer those cleats stay clean forever, so I typed count me in.
en.editorNote: For the fan who bought the cleats in June and still hasn't laced them up
variations: Buying the cleats took three minutes, wearing them took two months.
After a summer of watching, somebody has to take the field.

items.sourceNote: 賽後球迷情緒空窗、最難忘的往往是比賽以外的片段；溫水與家人情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
有人問我這個夏天最記得哪一幕。
我腦子裡先冒出來的，是七月某個凌晨我媽睡眼惺忪地走出房間，把一杯溫水放在我手邊，一句話都沒說就回去睡了。
冠軍舉盃那個畫面，反而要再往後翻一下才找得到。
記憶大概有它自己的排序方式，我也管不動它。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個回想整個夏天、先想到的卻是家裡某個人的球迷
variations: 留在腦子裡的，常常是比分以外的東西。
冠軍是誰我會忘，那杯溫水不會。

en.content:
Someone asked me what I'll remember most from this summer.
The first thing that surfaced was my mom shuffling out of her room at 3am in July, setting a glass of warm water by my elbow, and going back to bed without a word.
The trophy lift takes me a couple seconds longer to find.
Memory apparently sorts things its own way, and I don't get a vote in it.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose clearest memory of the summer isn't from the pitch
variations: What sticks is usually the part that wasn't on the scoreboard.
I'll forget who won before I forget that glass of water.

items.sourceNote: 世界盃結束後球迷失去日常儀式、仍守著原本的時段；室友視角與飲料細節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
我室友那兩個月幾乎沒回自己房間睡。
他把棉被搬到客廳，音量壓到最小，進球想叫的時候會先用手摀住嘴。
八月了，他還是十一點多就坐到同一個位置，遙控器握在手上，卻沒怎麼按。
我沒問他在等什麼，反正冰箱裡那罐他六月買的飲料，我也一直沒動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個自己不看球、卻陪你熬完整個夏天的室友
variations: 陪的人，有時候比看的人記得更久。
熱鬧散掉以後，最捨不得的常常是旁邊那個人。

en.content:
My roommate barely slept in his own room for two solid months.
He dragged his blanket to the living room, kept the volume near zero, and clapped a hand over his mouth every time he wanted to yell.
It's August and he still parks in that same seat around eleven, remote in hand, hardly pressing anything.
I've never asked what he's waiting for, and I still haven't touched the drink he stuck in the fridge back in June.
en.editorNote: For the roommate who never watched a match and stayed up for all of them anyway
variations: The one keeping you company sometimes remembers it longer than you do.
When the noise clears out, the person next to you misses it too.

items.sourceNote: 報導指球迷整屆累積大量睡眠虧損、賽後作息難以回復；比喻與細節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
如果六月沒有那三十幾場凌晨開踢的比賽，我這個夏天大概會睡得很飽。十一點上床，鬧鐘響第一次就起得來，週末不用整個下午拿去補眠，冰箱裡不會有那排喝到一半的啤酒，沙發上也不會凹出一個固定的位置。
可是現在是八月，我還是在三點自己睜開眼睛，摸到手機，螢幕還停在那張賽程表，最後一場已經是一個月前的事了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個到現在還會在凌晨三點自動睜眼的同伴
variations: 沒有那幾場比賽，我這個夏天大概會睡得很飽。
三點醒來，手機螢幕還停在那張賽程表。

en.content:
If June hadn't come with thirty-odd games kicking off at 3am, I'd have slept great this summer. Bed by eleven, up on the first alarm, whole weekends not spent paying back sleep, no row of half-finished beers in the fridge, no permanent dent in the couch cushion.
Except it's August and my eyes still open at three on their own, and I reach for my phone to find it parked on the fixture list, a month after the last game was played.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose eyes still snap open at 3am for no reason
variations: Without those games I'd have slept beautifully this summer.
Wide awake at three, phone still parked on the fixture list.

items.sourceNote: 下屆世界盃於二〇三〇年六月八日開踢、七月二十一日決賽；推播與個人反應為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
四年後的六月，某個再平常不過的晚上，手機會跳出一則我從來沒訂閱過的開賽提醒。
我會愣個兩秒，然後很自然地點進去看分組表，好像中間那幾個安靜的夏天沒發生過。
到時候要熬的夜一定更難熬，隔天的班照樣要上，我還是會熬。
那些現在唸起來還很陌生的球場名字，到那個夏天會被我講得跟自家巷口一樣順。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個已經開始倒數下一屆的球迷
variations: 熬夜這件事，四年後照樣會贏過理智。
行事曆現在空著，那幾格遲早會被填滿。

en.content:
Four Junes from now, on some completely ordinary evening, my phone will push a kickoff alert I never signed up for.
I'll freeze for two seconds, then tap straight in to read the groups like the quiet summers in between never happened.
The late nights will cost me more by then, work will still start on time, and I'll stay up anyway.
Stadium names that sound foreign in my mouth today will roll off it that summer like street names from my own block.
en.editorNote: For the fan who already started the countdown to the next one
variations: Four years later, staying up will still beat good judgment.
Those calendar squares are empty now, and they won't stay empty.

items.sourceNote: CNN 報導賽會落幕後球迷的情緒空窗期；加油站的兩個地點與人物反應為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
六月那次是巷口那間加油站，油槍還在跑，我人已經先坐回駕駛座，把中場分析轉到最大聲。
昨天出門辦事，換成濱海公路上一間空得會回音的加油站，加的還是九五、還是加滿。
這回我等到油槍自己跳停，順手把擋風玻璃刷過一遍，整段時間只有引擎降溫的細碎聲響。
一樣是九十秒，那一次短得像偷來的，這一次長到我把價目表每一行都看完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個曾經為了趕上開球把每件事都做一半的人
variations: 同一支油槍，趕時間的時候連上面的數字都看不清楚。
加滿一次要九十秒，我現在終於有那九十秒了。

en.content:
In June it was the station by my corner: the pump was still running and I was already back in the driver's seat with the halftime analysis turned all the way up.
Yesterday, out running errands, it was a station on the coast road, empty enough to echo, same grade of fuel, same full tank.
This time I waited for the nozzle to click off by itself, wiped the windshield, and heard nothing but the engine ticking as it cooled.
Ninety seconds either way: the first felt stolen, and the second lasted long enough for me to read every line on the price board.
en.editorNote: For the fan who used to do everything at half speed to make kickoff
variations: Same pump, and in June I couldn't even focus on the numbers.
A full tank takes ninety seconds. I finally have the ninety seconds.

items.sourceNote: Forbes 談賽會結束後的空虛感與調適方式；停車場繳費機的時間軸與細節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
21:41　繳費機前排第四個，前面那位在包包裡找零錢，找得很久。
21:43　輪到我，機器吐出一張單子，停車費比我預估的少了一半。
21:44　我盯著單子上的進場時間，發現自己已經很久沒有為了趕上開球算過秒數。
21:46　後面有人輕輕咳了一聲，我把單子收好，讓開位置。
21:48　回車上的路上經過一台旅行車，後窗那面小旗還沒撕。
21:49　車主剛好走回來，我們互相點了個頭，誰也沒提那面旗。
21:53　閘門抬起來，車上放的是一場我完全叫不出名字的聯賽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在那種散場很久、心還沒散場的夜晚
variations: 21:44　螢幕跳出金額，我卻在算另一種時間。
那面沒撕掉的小旗，比任何一句話都好認。

en.content:
9:41 p.m. — Fourth in line at the parking kiosk; the guy ahead is still digging for coins.
9:43 p.m. — My turn. The machine prints a ticket and the fee is half of what I'd braced for.
9:44 p.m. — I stare at the entry time and realize it's been weeks since I counted seconds to make a kickoff.
9:46 p.m. — Someone behind me coughs, so I take the ticket and step aside.
