9:48 p.m. — Walking back, I pass a wagon with a small flag still taped to the rear window.
9:49 p.m. — The owner returns at the same moment. We nod at each other and neither of us mentions it.
9:53 p.m. — The gate lifts and the car speakers are playing a league I couldn't name if you asked.
en.editorNote: For the night when the crowd has gone home and you haven't
variations: 9:44 p.m. — The screen shows the fee; I'm doing a different kind of math.
That flag nobody took down says plenty.

items.sourceNote: 元氣網談熬夜看球的睡眠策略與身體負擔；理髮店的表單形式與內容為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
申請人：鏡子裡那個坐得筆直、圍著黑色圍布的人
申請項目：把作息調回白天那一版
起始日期：六月十一號，自願報名，沒有人逼我
現況說明：設計師撥開頭頂那一撮，說這裡比上次薄了一點
預計恢復期：他說三個月會長回來，我決定先相信他
其他備註：吹風機開到最大聲的時候，我沒有再想聽誰在分析誰的陣型
承辦簽章：剪刀在耳邊喀了一聲，就當作蓋章了
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配一張剪完頭髮的自拍
variations: 申請項目：把六月十一號以前的睡眠找回來
承辦簽章：喀的那一聲，我自己當作核准了

en.content:
Applicant: the person in the mirror, sitting very straight under a black cape
Request: return my schedule to the daytime version
Start date: June 11. Voluntary. Nobody made me do it.
Current condition: the stylist lifts the hair on top and says it's thinner than last time
Estimated recovery: he says three months, and I've decided to believe him
Notes: with the dryer on full blast, I no longer miss hearing anyone break down a formation
Signature: the scissors clicked once by my ear, and I'm counting that as a stamp
en.editorNote: Pair it with a fresh-haircut selfie
variations: Request: recover the sleep I had before June 11.
Signature: one click of the scissors. Approved.

items.sourceNote: 決賽期間大型集體觀賽活動的資料；火鍋桌上的動作與心情為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
湯第二次滾起來的時候，我正把那盤肉一片一片攤開，攤成剛好六份。
中間我伸手把桌上的手機翻成螢幕朝下，動作快到對面的人沒有發現。
白煙一路爬上牆，把牆上那台開著卻沒人看的電視糊掉一半。
六個人這桌坐得剛剛好，只是六月那陣子，我們沒有一次是這樣好好吃完一頓的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那頓終於湊齊人的聚餐
variations: 手機翻過去的那兩秒，我什麼都沒說出口。
煙很大，這一桌人第一次是為了吃飯來的。

en.content:
The second time the broth came to a boil, I was laying the meat out slice by slice, six portions exactly.
Somewhere in the middle I reached over and turned my phone face down, fast enough that nobody across the table caught it.
Steam climbed the wall and blurred out half of the TV that was on with nobody watching it.
The six of us fit around that table perfectly, and back in June we never once sat through a whole meal like this.
en.editorNote: For the dinner where everyone finally showed up
variations: Two seconds to flip the phone over, and I said nothing.
All that steam, and this time we came for the food.

items.sourceNote: 2026 世界盃決賽（7/19 西班牙 1-0 阿根廷）賽後報導；修鞋攤工單內容為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
單號　0822-07
品項　左腳前掌磨到見底的白色球鞋一雙
客戶陳述　六月到七月幾乎天天穿，站著看完的那幾場都算它的
師傅檢查　鞋底外側偏薄，鞋帶孔有兩個被扯到變形
處理方式　整片換底，附一副新鞋帶，舊的那副我要帶回去
報價　四百五，三天後取件
備註　師傅問我以後還踢不踢，我說先把它修好再說
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合把夏天穿壞的那雙鞋送去修的時候用
variations: 磨掉的那一層，是我站著看完的那幾場。
舊鞋帶我帶回家了，反正也沒地方擺，就跟那個夏天一起收著。

en.content:
Ticket　0822-07
Item　One pair of white sneakers, left forefoot worn through
Customer says　Wore them almost daily from June to July; the games I watched standing up are on them
Inspection　Outsole thin along the edge, two eyelets pulled out of shape
Work　Full resole, new laces included, keeping the old pair
Quote　$15, ready Thursday
Note　The cobbler asked if I still play. Told him let's fix them first.
en.editorNote: For the day you finally take the summer's shoes in for repair
variations: The layer that's gone is every game I watched on my feet.
I took the old laces home. Nowhere to keep them, so they go with the summer.

items.sourceNote: 賽事結束後球迷情緒與作息回復的報導；眼鏡行維修單細節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
受理編號　R-0822-13
送修品項　黑框眼鏡一副，右邊鏡腳外八
客人陳述　夏天常常戴著就睡著了，醒來時整副壓在臉側邊
現場檢查　螺絲鬆脫，鼻墊泛黃，右下角一道細刮痕
處理方式　鎖緊螺絲、更換鼻墊、鏡片保留原件
等候時間　十五分鐘，可坐著等
店員備註　他戴回去照鏡子，說這副撐過了一個很累的夏天
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給那個戴著眼鏡看到睡著、隔天還去上班的人
variations: 鏡腳歪掉的角度，跟我在沙發上睡著的角度一模一樣。
刮痕留著就好，它比我還記得那幾個晚上。

en.content:
Case　R-0822-13
Item　One pair of black frames, right temple splayed out
Customer says　Kept falling asleep in them all summer, woke up with them mashed against my face
Inspection　Loose hinge screw, yellowed nose pads, hairline scratch bottom right
Work　Tighten hinge, replace pads, keep the original lenses
Wait time　Fifteen minutes, seat available
Staff note　He tried them on at the mirror and said these got him through a long summer
en.editorNote: For the friend who fell asleep in their glasses and still made it to work
variations: The angle that temple bent is exactly how I slept on the couch.
Leave the scratch. It remembers those nights better than I do.

items.sourceNote: 賽事期間 6/11–7/19 的作息背景；藥局對話為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
「這罐眼藥水，你上次是什麼時候買的？」
「六月中，那陣子一個禮拜用掉一瓶。」
「現在眼睛還這麼乾嗎？」
「還好，最近都十一點就躺下了。」
「那這次拿小罐的就夠。」
「小罐的⋯⋯好，就小罐的。旁邊那排提神飲料也幫我放回去吧。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合作息終於調回來、卻有點捨不得的那天
variations: 改拿小罐的那一刻，我知道夏天真的過完了。
提神飲料放回架上，比熬夜還需要一點勇氣。

en.content:
"When did you last buy this eye drop?"
"Mid-June. I was going through a bottle a week back then."
"Eyes still that dry?"
"Not really. I've been going to bed by eleven."
"Then the small bottle is plenty."
"The small one... yeah, the small one. And put that row of energy drinks back for me too."
en.editorNote: For the day your sleep schedule finally resets and you miss it a little
variations: Downgrading to the small bottle is how I knew summer was over.
Putting the energy drinks back took more nerve than staying up did.

items.sourceNote: 決賽（7/19，費蘭·托雷斯延長賽 106 分鐘進球）相關報導；打卡機視角為自行發想

zh-tw.content: 我是門口那台每天被按上百次的機器。六月那個月，早上第一批走進來的人，指紋常常要按三次才過，掌心的溫度也比平常低。有一位固定在八點五十九分踩進來，眼睛紅得像剛哭過，其實只是硬撐。八月了，同一批人變成八點四十就到，指紋一次就過，我反而有點想念那些手忙腳亂的清晨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼給那個夏天天天壓線打卡的同事
variations: 現在大家都準時了，只有我還記得誰在八點五十九分衝進來過。
指紋一次就過的早晨，其實有點無聊。

en.content: I'm the machine by the door that gets pressed a hundred times a day. Back in June, the first wave every morning needed three tries to register a fingerprint, and their palms ran colder than usual. One of them clocked in at 8:59 without fail, eyes red like he'd been crying, when really he was just running on nothing. It's August now, the same people show up by 8:40, one press and they're through, and I sort of miss those frantic mornings.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who cut it close every morning that summer
variations: Everyone's punctual now. I'm the only one who remembers the 8:59 sprint.
Mornings where the fingerprint works first try are honestly a little dull.

items.sourceNote: 報導估算球迷整屆最多損失約 275 小時睡眠；計程車後座與時間／距離數字為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
昨晚加班到十一點，招了台計程車，回家那趟二十二分鐘，我在後座睡掉十四分鐘。
六月同樣這條路，我一次也沒閉過眼，二十二分鐘裡把比分頁面重新整理了三十幾次，還嫌紅綠燈太多。
昨天剩最後八百公尺我醒過來，手指還是先滑到螢幕右下角那個位置，滑到一半才想起來沒有球可以看。
從那一下到我下車，大概九十秒，是這個夏天最安靜的九十秒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個現在一坐上車就能睡著的球友
variations: 同一段路，六月我嫌它太慢，八月我嫌它太短。
睡得回來的是時數，補不回來的是那種捨不得閉眼的心情。

en.content:
Worked till eleven last night, flagged a cab, and slept through fourteen minutes of the twenty-two it takes to get home.
Same route in June and I never once shut my eyes — I refreshed the score page thirty-odd times in those twenty-two minutes and still resented every red light.
Last night I surfaced with maybe eight hundred meters to go, and my thumb went to that same corner of the screen before I remembered there was nothing left to check.
From that reflex to the curb was about ninety seconds, the quietest ninety seconds of my summer.
en.editorNote: For the friend who now falls asleep the second the car door shuts
variations: Same ride: in June it was too slow, in August it's too short.
You can win the hours back. You can't win back caring too much to blink.

items.sourceNote: 報導談學生在賽事期間熬夜看球與課業拉扯；圖書館自習室場景與人物為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
一件已經結束的事，到底能在一個人身上留多久？
今天下午我在圖書館的自習室，前面那個高中生把課本立起來當掩護，手機藏在後面，畫面停在夏天某一場的重播。
他每看三十秒就抬頭瞄一次牆上的鐘，那個節奏我認得，六月我也是這樣算自己還能撐多久。
我沒去提醒他，也沒去戳破，只是把自己的書往前挪了一格，讓那面掩護看起來更自然一點。
所以我到現在還是不知道——一件已經結束的事，到底能在一個人身上留多久？
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個開學了還在偷看重播的球友
variations: 課本立得再高，也擋不住那三十秒抬一次頭的節奏。
同一個節奏我在六月用過，看見有人接手的時候我沒忍心拆穿。

en.content:
How long can something that's already over keep living inside a person?
This afternoon in the library study room, the high schooler in front of me had his textbook propped up as cover and his phone tucked behind it, paused on a replay from the summer.
Every thirty seconds he'd glance up at the clock on the wall, and I knew that rhythm — I spent all of June doing the same math on how much longer I could hold out.
I didn't tap his shoulder and I didn't say a word, I just slid my own book forward an inch so his cover would look a little more convincing.
So I still don't know: how long can something that's already over keep living inside a person?
en.editorNote: For the friend still sneaking replays now that term has started
variations: You can prop the textbook as high as you want; the thirty-second glance gives you away.
I used that exact rhythm in June, so when I saw it again I let it be.

items.sourceNote: 報導整理各地球迷因開賽時間造成的睡眠損失；舊公寓信箱區紙條情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
四樓的你，那張紙條我一直留著。
六月的時候你把它貼在一樓信箱那一整排的旁邊，說深夜偶爾會有一點聲音，請大家多包涵，落款只寫了四樓兩個字。
我住三樓，那一個月我也常常在同樣的時間握著拳頭不敢出聲，看到紙條那天才知道，原來有人跟我在同一段時間醒著。
現在膠帶乾了，紙的一角翹起來，我每次開信箱都會順手把它按回去。
你哪天要是想撕掉它，請先跟我說一聲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個整個夏天都在忍住不喊出聲的鄰居
variations: 那張道歉的紙條，後來變成我那個月唯一收到的好消息。
我們從來沒講過話，卻在同樣的時間握過同樣的拳頭。

en.content:
To whoever lives on the fourth floor: I still have that note of yours.
You taped it up beside the row of mailboxes in June, saying there might be a bit of noise late at night and asking everyone to bear with it, signed with nothing but your floor.
I'm one floor under you, and all that month I was sitting in the dark with my fists clenched too, swallowing every sound — your note was how I found out someone above me was awake at the same hours.
The tape has dried out and one corner curls now, so I press it back down every time I open my box.
If you ever decide to peel it off, tell me first.
en.editorNote: For the neighbor who spent the whole summer holding in the shouting
variations: That apology on the wall turned out to be the best news I got all month.
We never spoke once, and we clenched the same fists at the same hours.

items.sourceNote: 本屆七月十九日於紐澤西決賽、為史上規模最大的一屆；二手書店與便利貼情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
現在我書架第二層放著一本封面泛黃的足球史，書頁裡還夾著別人留下的一張便利貼。
上禮拜我在二手書店最角落那排看到它，抽出來翻開，那張紙就掉在我鞋子上，鉛筆寫著一個一九九八年的比分。
再往前一個禮拜，我在同一家店問過老闆有沒有這類的書，他說那一排平常沒什麼人動。
再往前兩個月，我連那本書封面上那座球場叫什麼名字都答不出來。
再往前，就是六月十一號的凌晨，我本來只打算看十五分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個從只想看十五分鐘、看到現在開始翻書的球友
variations: 書頁裡那個一九九八年的比分，是別人也熬過一整個夏天的證據。
十五分鐘的計畫，最後長成書架上的一整層。

en.content:
There's a yellowed history of the sport on the second shelf of my bookcase now, someone else's sticky note still tucked between the pages.
I found it last week in the back row of a used bookstore; when I pulled it out and opened it, the note dropped onto my shoe with a 1998 scoreline penciled across it.
A week before that, I'd asked the owner of the same shop whether he had anything on soccer, and he told me nobody ever touches that row.
Two months before that, I couldn't have named the stadium on the cover if you'd paid me.
And before that, it's three in the morning on June 11th, and I only meant to watch fifteen minutes.
en.editorNote: For the friend who came for fifteen minutes and stayed long enough to start reading
variations: That 1998 scoreline in the margin is proof somebody else lost a summer too.
A fifteen-minute plan ended up taking a whole shelf.

items.sourceNote: TVBS 報導熬夜看球對前額葉與情緒的影響、賽事期間作息崩壞；唱歌包廂與朋友情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
八月的現在，我們五個人每隔幾週會擠進同一間小包廂，最後一首永遠留給那首沒人唱得上去的歌。
會變成這樣，是因為決賽隔天有人丟了一句「不然去唱歌」，十分鐘就湊齊了人。
而他之所以會丟那句話，是因為前一晚電視關掉以後，客廳安靜得讓大家都不知道要說什麼。
再更早，六月第一場開踢之前，我們裡面有三個人連對方的全名都拼不出來。
一場跟我們毫無關係的比賽，最後留給我們的，是一張要一起對的行程表。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個決賽隔天就把大家約出來、後來就沒斷過的朋友
variations: 那場比賽什麼也沒改變，它只是幫我們湊了一桌人。
電視關掉那晚的安靜，後來長成每隔幾週的一次相約。

en.content:
These days the five of us pile into the same little karaoke room every few weeks, and the last song is always the one nobody can hit the notes on.
It got that way because the morning after the final, somebody floated a "let's go sing" and it took ten minutes to fill the room.
He only floated it because the night before, once the TV went off, the living room got so quiet none of us knew what to say.
Go back a little further, to before the first match in June, and three of us couldn't have spelled each other's full names.
A tournament that had nothing to do with us left us with a standing date to keep.
en.editorNote: For the friend who booked the room the morning after the final and never stopped
variations: The match changed nothing. It just put five of us at the same table.
The silence after the TV went off turned into a standing invitation.

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網報導暑假血液庫存告急、中部血庫僅剩約 2.4 天；捐血車上的對話情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
「最近會不會熬夜？」捐血車上，她低頭在表格打了一個勾。
我說不會，這幾個禮拜天一黑就沒力氣，十點多就躺平了。
沒說出口的是，七月以前完全相反，一個禮拜有四天我在凌晨三點對著螢幕壓低聲音吼，隔天照樣進辦公室；現在我終於能好好睡，卻也終於沒有什麼事情值得我撐到那麼晚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個作息終於恢復正常、卻反而覺得少了一塊的自己
variations: 作息回來了，值得熬的那件事沒有回來。
我現在很好睡，好睡到有點想念那個睡不著的自己。

en.content:
"Any late nights lately?" She checked a box on the form without looking up, the blood drive bus humming around us.
I said no — these past few weeks I'm out cold by ten, useless the second it gets dark.
What I didn't say: before July it was the exact opposite, four nights a week at three in the morning, yelling into my own hands at a screen and clocking in anyway, and now that I finally sleep fine, there's finally nothing worth staying up for.
en.editorNote: For the fan whose sleep schedule healed and left a hole behind
variations: My sleep came back. The thing worth losing it for didn't.
I sleep great now — great enough to miss the version of me who couldn't.

items.sourceNote: CNN 報導賽事結束後球迷的情緒空窗與失去共同節奏；舊群組打字又刪掉的情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
看球那個群組，八月我點開過三次。
頭一回在月初，我打了「還有人在嗎」五個字，看了兩秒，一個一個字刪回去。
中間那次是上禮拜，我把六月的舊照片翻出來又關掉，訊息欄空著。
昨天深夜再點開，我沒再猶豫，直接問九月哪個週末大家有空吃飯。
三秒不到，上面跳出兩個人正在輸入，原來大家都在客氣，誰也不想當第一個開口的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在舊群組打了又刪、其實大家都在等他先講話的人
variations: 打了又刪的那五個字，第三次才終於按下去。
大家都在客氣，於是誰也沒發現我們都還想見面。

en.content:
I opened the old watch-party chat three times this month.
The first was early August: I typed "anybody still around?", stared at it for two seconds, and deleted it letter by letter.
The middle one was last week, when I scrolled back to the June photos, closed them again, and left the message box empty.
Last night I opened it once more and didn't stall — I just asked which weekend in September people were free for dinner.
Inside three seconds two typing bubbles appeared, and it turned out everyone had simply been too polite to go first.
en.editorNote: For whoever keeps typing and deleting in the group chat nobody wants to close
variations: Those five words I kept deleting finally went out on the third try.
Everybody was waiting to be second.

items.sourceNote: The Sleep Charity 談球迷的「睡眠稅」與賽後補眠；藥妝店貨架上的誤會情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
藥妝店那排眼睛保養的貨架前，我跟一個陌生男生同時伸手拿最後一盒蒸氣眼罩。
我讓給他，順口說了一句「這個夏天大家都需要」，他愣了一下才說謝謝。
走到門口我才聽見他跟同行的人說，那是要買給剛開完刀的媽媽。
那一秒我有點想笑，也有點不好意思——原來把整個七月背在身上的，只有我自己。
熱鬧是一群人的，戒斷是一個人的，這件事在那排貨架前被拆得乾乾淨淨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個還以為全世界都跟他一樣沒走出那個夏天的球迷
variations: 我以為全世界都還在講那場球，其實只剩我自己。
熱鬧散場以後才知道，捨不得從來就是一個人的事。

en.content:
At the eye-care shelf in the drugstore, a guy I'd never met and I reached for the last box of steam eye masks at the same second.
I let him take it and said something like "everybody needs these this summer." He blinked, then thanked me.
On my way out I heard him tell the person with him that it was for his mom, who'd just had surgery.
That second I wanted to laugh and also wanted to disappear — turns out I was the only one still carrying all of July around.
The noise belongs to a crowd and the comedown belongs to you, and a shelf of eye masks made that perfectly clear.
en.editorNote: For the fan who still assumes everyone else is stuck in that summer too
variations: I assumed the whole world was still talking about it. It was just me.
The crowd goes home. The missing it stays with you, alone.

items.sourceNote: 農傳媒〈資深釣客上場，帶你一窺釣蝦場的歷史與祕辛〉：釣蝦場自 1980 年代成為台灣特有的深夜休閒場所；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
如果那晚沒人提議去釣蝦場，如果最角落那台電視沒有開著重播，如果我沒有為了盯螢幕把釣竿隨手擱在旁邊，這個夏天對我來說大概就只是很熱而已。
結果一整晚蝦子一尾也沒上鉤，我卻在凌晨兩點跟隔壁桌不認識的人一起喊出聲。
現在回頭想，那晚被釣上岸的其實是我自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在那種「本來只是被朋友硬拉出門，結果變成整個夏天最記得的一晚」的貼文底下
variations: 那天蝦子一尾都沒釣到，倒是把一整個夏天釣了回來。
我以為我是去陪朋友的，後來才知道那晚是留給我自己的。

en.content:
If nobody had suggested the all-night shrimp pond that night, if the TV in the far corner hadn't been running a replay, if I hadn't leaned my rod against the tank just to stare at the screen — this summer would only be the summer it was hot.
I caught exactly zero shrimp, and at 2 AM I was shouting along with total strangers at the next tank over.
Looking back, the only thing that got hooked that night was me.
en.editorNote: For the post about the night you got dragged out and ended up remembering it all year
variations: Zero shrimp caught. One entire summer caught.
I thought I was tagging along for a friend. That night turned out to be mine.

items.sourceNote: 風傳媒生活〈台北3間室內釣蝦場推薦〉：24 小時營業、可唱歌烤肉的釣蝦場；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
如果六月我們沒有臨時起意跑去釣蝦，如果那天老闆沒有把遙控器直接丟給我們，如果池邊那排燈沒有亮到天快白，我們那串對話大概停在夏天就沒了。
五個人坐到清晨，蝦子跑掉一堆，話倒是講了一整晚。
八月的今天翻回去看，訊息最後停在一句「下次還要一起」。
釣蝦場的燈早就關了，那句話還亮著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那群夏天天天講話、現在已經一個月沒人開口的看球夥伴
variations: 燈關了、蝦子沒了，「下次還要一起」還在那裡沒被撤回。
我們沒有吵架，只是那個一起熬夜的理由過期了。

en.content:
If we hadn't gone to the shrimp pond on a whim back in June, if the owner hadn't just handed us the remote, if the lights over the tanks hadn't stayed on until the sky turned grey — that group chat would have died with the summer.
Five of us sat there till dawn. The shrimp all got away; the talking didn't.
Scrolling back today, the last message is still someone saying we should do it again.
The lights went out weeks ago. That line is still glowing.
en.editorNote: Send to the watch-party group chat that hasn't said a word in a month
variations: Nobody fell out. The reason to stay up together just expired.
Last message in the chat: 'next time.' Still unanswered, still true.

items.sourceNote: TVBS 新聞〈2026世界盃開踢！醫揭熬夜看球真相〉：本屆台灣轉播多落在上午時段、醫師談睡眠與補眠；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
八月的早晨，我還是六點就醒。
如果比賽都改回半夜開踢，如果公司那面螢幕沒有整天開著新聞台，如果我不是把早餐吃成一種儀式，我大概不會覺得那一個月上班特別好過。
今年的球全落在上午，理論上誰都不必犧牲睡眠。
可是我現在照樣坐在餐桌前，等一個不會開始的開球。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼給那些球賽結束後、生理時鐘還停在看球模式的人
variations: 鬧鐘早就關了，身體還在準時報到。
我以為我在熬夜，其實我是在等一件值得早起的事。

en.content:
It's late August and I'm still awake at six.
If the matches had all been middle-of-the-night, if the office screen hadn't been left on the news all day, if I hadn't turned breakfast into a ceremony — I'd never have called that month an easy month at work.
This year the games landed in the morning. Technically nobody had to give up any sleep.
And here I am at the table anyway, waiting on a kickoff that isn't coming.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose body clock is still running on tournament time
variations: The alarm is off. The body still clocks in.
Turns out I wasn't losing sleep. I was being given a reason to get up.

items.sourceNote: 自由電子報玩咖〈高雄24小時釣蝦場爆紅〉：釣蝦場作為全家共處的深夜場所；改寫原創

zh-tw.content:
客廳那台電視，這兩個月只剩新聞的聲音。
如果我爸當初沒有把音量開到吵醒整層樓，如果他沒有每場都問一次那個人是誰，如果我沒有嫌過他吵，我大概不會發現我們兩個能在同一張沙發上坐滿兩個鐘頭。
昨天他傳來一段十秒的進球片段，沒有配任何字。
我點開看完，回他一個讚。
被留下來的從來不是比分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合送給那種「只有在看球時才會跟爸媽同框」的家庭場景
variations: 我們家不太聊天，那兩個月是靠轉播代打的。
如果那天我沒點開那十秒，如果我連個讚都懶得回，他大概就不會再傳第二段給我了。

en.content:
For two months now the living-room TV has only had the news on it.
If my dad hadn't cranked the volume loud enough to wake the whole floor, if he hadn't asked who that player was every single match, if I hadn't complained about the noise — I'd never have learned the two of us can share a sofa for two hours straight.
Yesterday he forwarded me a ten-second goal clip with no text attached.
I watched it and sent back a thumbs up.
What stayed was never the football.
en.editorNote: For the family that only ends up in the same room when a match is on
variations: We don't talk much. For two months the broadcast did it for us.
If I hadn't opened those ten seconds, if I hadn't bothered with the thumbs up, he probably wouldn't have sent a second one.

items.sourceNote: 農業部食農教育資訊整合平臺〈灌溉排水的英雄－農田水利〉：水圳的幹線／支線／分線／給水路分級與制水閘門；場景細節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
球滾進水圳那一秒，我沒有出聲。
我沿著圳邊跑了大概二十公尺，看它在第三根水泥柱那裡打了個轉，才蹲下去把手伸進水裡。
撈上來的球比丟出去的時候重，我抵在膝蓋上壓了三次，水從縫線那邊出來，一次比一次少。
擦乾以後我把它放回地上，用腳背碰了兩下，確認它還會滾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合配一張夏天結束後、球場只剩自己一個人的照片
variations: 壓了三次，水才停。第四次我沒再壓，直接把球放回腳邊。
那顆球在水裡待了十秒，我擦了兩分鐘。

en.content:
The ball went into the irrigation canal and I didn't make a sound.
I ran maybe twenty meters along the bank, watched it spin once at the third concrete post, then crouched and put my hand in.
It came up heavier than it went down. I braced it on my knee and pressed three times; water came out of the seam, less with every press.
Once it was dry I set it back on the ground and tapped it twice with my instep to check that it still rolled.
en.editorNote: For the photo of an empty pitch after the tournament, with only you still on it
variations: Three presses and the water stopped. I didn't try a fourth; I just put it back by my foot.
Ten seconds in the water. Two minutes drying it off.

items.sourceNote: 自由時報〈活寶！百年灌溉水圳 見證古老「水甲制度」〉：苗栗大湖水尾坪手鑿暗渠水圳、七十多名農戶分水巡水；球門與踢球情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
他從圳溝邊搬了四塊石頭上來，兩塊一組，擺成一個球門。
擺好又蹲回去看，把左邊那塊往外挪了半個手掌，再往回挪三根手指。
退到五步外踢過去，石頭沒有動，球從中間穿出去，滾進草裡。
他走過去撿，路過球門的時候再蹲了一次，這次只是把石頭上的土撥掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個沒有球場、還是每個週末都去把球門擺出來的朋友
variations: 他挪了三次石頭，踢了一球，就把整個下午用完了。
球門寬度是他自己量的，五步，每個週末都一樣寬。

en.content:
He hauled four stones up from the ditch, two to a side, and set them out as a goal.
Then he crouched back down and moved the left one out half a palm's width, then back in by three fingers.
He stepped off five paces and struck it. The stones didn't move; the ball went straight through and rolled off into the grass.
He walked over to get it, crouched at the goal one more time on the way past, and this time only brushed the dirt off the stone.
en.editorNote: Send it to the friend with no real pitch who still sets up the goal every weekend
variations: He adjusted the stones three times, took one shot, and that was the whole afternoon.
He paced out the goal himself. Five steps. Same width every weekend.

items.sourceNote: 中研院人社中心「臺灣水圳文化網」：台灣各地水圳的圳路、水利與地方生活資料；刷鞋情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
刷子在鞋底那排凸起中間來回，一格刷十二下，泥掉進圳溝裡，散開，跟著水走。
刷到第四格他停下來，把鞋子翻過來對著光看，然後回頭把上一格再刷一次。
整雙刷完花了四十分鐘，比那場球的下半場還久。
鞋帶抽出來單獨洗，在水裡拉直，甩了三次才搭到石頭上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合搭配「球季結束了，但保養沒有」的那種收操貼文
variations: 一格十二下，二十四格，他從天亮刷到影子變短。
鞋子刷完是乾淨的，鞋帶還在石頭上滴水。

en.content:
The brush went back and forth between the studs, twelve strokes per gap, and the dirt dropped into the ditch, broke apart, and went with the water.
At the fourth gap he stopped, turned the shoe over to the light, then went back and did the one before it again.
The pair took him forty minutes, longer than the second half had.
He pulled the laces out and washed them separately, straightened them in the water, and shook them three times before laying them on a stone.
en.editorNote: For the end-of-season post where the football stops but the upkeep doesn't
variations: Twelve strokes a gap, twenty-four gaps. He started at sunrise and finished when his shadow got short.
The shoes came out clean. The laces were still dripping on the stone.

items.sourceNote: 自由體育〈世界盃擴軍帶來無限希望 台灣男足仍有根本問題待解〉：談台灣足球人口在國高中階段的斷層；打氣情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
打氣筒的頭卡進氣嘴，他按著球，手臂上下十五回，停，捏一捏，再十五回。
第三輪之後把球放在地上按下去，凹進去大約一個指節，於是又補了七回。
氣嘴拔出來會漏一點，他用大拇指壓住，數到十才放開。
球擺回鐵架最上層，打氣筒收進袋子，拉鍊拉到底又拉開，把那包螺絲塞了進去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個球季都結束了、還是每個禮拜把球打飽的人
variations: 十五回、十五回、七回，然後他才肯把打氣筒收起來。
球擺在鐵架最上層，那層原本放的是別的東西。

en.content:
The pump head clicked onto the valve. He held the ball down, fifteen strokes, stopped, gave it a squeeze, then fifteen more.
After the third round he set it on the ground and pressed: it gave about a knuckle's depth, so he added seven more.
Pulling the head off lets a little air out, so he clamped his thumb over the valve and counted to ten before letting go.
The ball went back on the top shelf of the rack, the pump into the bag, and he zipped it shut, opened it again, and pushed the little packet of screws inside.
en.editorNote: For the person who keeps the ball inflated every week even though the season is over
variations: Fifteen, fifteen, seven. Only then would he put the pump away.
The ball lives on the top shelf now. Something else used to live there.

items.sourceNote: Marie Claire〈2026世界盃公播地圖整理〉：全台餐廳、酒吧、小店公播授權與觀賽地點；麵攤情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
冠軍隊那顆球進的時候，我人在麵攤，湯已經涼了一半。
隔壁桌的先生沒有喊，只把筷子放下，轉過來問我「你那碗要不要再加麵」。
我搖頭，他就轉回去看重播，之後兩個人沒再講過話。
現在只要看到有人在球賽中間把筷子放下，我就會想起那句要不要再加麵。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看完球連歡呼都省下來、只是默默吃完的人
variations: 短版：他沒喊，只問我那碗要不要再加麵。
延伸版：那碗麵我沒加，那句話倒是留下來了。

en.content:
When the winning goal went in I was at a noodle stand, and half my soup had already gone cold.
The man at the next table didn't shout. He just set his chopsticks down, turned to me and asked, "You want more noodles in that bowl?"
I shook my head, he turned back to the replay, and neither of us said another word.
Now whenever I see someone set their chopsticks down mid-match, I hear him asking about the noodles again.
en.editorNote: For the fan who skips the cheering and just finishes the bowl
variations: Short version: He didn't cheer. He asked if I wanted more noodles.
Longer version: I said no to the noodles. The question stayed anyway.

items.sourceNote: NOWnews〈2026世界盃免費看！3000間門市進店就能看〉：談店家轉播與觀賽門市；麵攤與老闆對白為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
小組賽第二場開踢那晚，我加班完才走進麵攤，老闆正在收醬料罐。
他頭沒抬，一邊擦桌子一邊說「電視我幫你轉大聲」。
那台電視畫面偏藍，聲音一大整條街都聽得見，他就站在鍋子後面看完上半場。
那家店後來收了，我經過那個位置，還是會聽見他說要幫我轉大聲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個因為一句『轉大聲』就把整季比賽都看完的人
variations: 短版：他沒問我要看哪一台，只說要幫我轉大聲。
延伸版：畫面偏藍的那台電視，比後來所有的大螢幕都清楚。

en.content:
The night the second group match kicked off, I got out of work late and walked into the noodle stand while the owner was putting his sauce jars away.
He didn't look up. Wiping down a table, he said, "I'll turn the TV up for you."
That set ran blue, the sound carried down the whole street, and he watched the first half standing behind his pot.
The place closed a few years later, and passing that spot I still hear him offering to turn it up.
en.editorNote: For the fan who stayed for a whole tournament because someone offered to turn the sound up
variations: Short version: He never asked which channel. He just offered to turn it up.
Longer version: That blue-tinted set beat every big screen that came after it.

items.sourceNote: 中嘉寬頻〈2026世足冠軍賽哪裡看〉：整理賽程與台灣觀賽時段落在清晨；家人情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
那年八強賽排在凌晨三點，我媽起來上廁所，經過客廳。
她從來不看球，只往電視瞄了一眼，說「你要看就看，記得把燈關掉」。
她回房間，門沒關緊，走廊那條光一直留到終場。
那場輸了，隔天同事問我比數我想不起來，倒是記得她講的關燈。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個家裡沒人陪看球、卻總有人半夜經過客廳的人
variations: 短版：她不看球，只交代我記得把燈關掉。
延伸版：比數忘了，走廊那條光還在。

en.content:
The quarterfinal that year kicked off at three in the morning, and my mom got up for the bathroom and passed through the living room.
She has never watched a match. She glanced at the screen and said, "Watch if you want, just remember to shut the light off."
She went back to her room, left the door ajar, and that strip of hallway light stayed on until the final whistle.
We lost that one. The next day a coworker asked me the score and I had nothing, but I still had her line about the light.
en.editorNote: For the fan who watches alone while someone else drifts through the room at 3AM
variations: Short version: She doesn't watch soccer. She just told me to shut the light off.
Longer version: The score is gone. The hallway light is still on.

items.sourceNote: Marie Claire〈2026世界盃足球賽直播哪裡看？賽程時間懶人包〉：多數場次落在台灣時間上午；辦公室情節為自行發想

zh-tw.content:
那天早上九點開賽，我坐在會議室靠牆的位子偷看比分。
主管走過來，瞄了一眼我的手機，說「幫我看一下現在幾比幾」。
他沒有問是哪兩隊，散會前又問了一次，聲音比上一次小。
中午一群人去麵攤，沒有人再提那場球，我卻一直想著他問第二次的樣子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在會議室裡跟主管共享同一個比分的上班族
variations: 短版：他沒問是哪兩隊，只問現在幾比幾。
延伸版：第二次問的時候，他把聲音壓低了。

en.content:
Kickoff was nine in the morning, and I was in the meeting room against the wall, sneaking looks at the score.
My manager came over, glanced at my phone, and said, "Tell me what it is right now."
He never asked who was playing. He asked again before we broke, quieter than the first time.
At lunch a bunch of us went to the noodle stand, nobody brought the match up, and I kept thinking about the way he asked the second time.
en.editorNote: For the office worker sharing one live score with the boss across a meeting table
variations: Short version: He never asked who was playing. Only what it was right now.
Longer version: The second time he asked, he dropped his voice.
